text:
Bukhari Sharif mein hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain Surah Anfal Ghazwa-e-Badr ke bare mein utri hai. Farmate hain Anfal se murad ghanimatein hain jo sirf Rasool Allah ﷺ ke liye hi thin, un mein se koi cheez kisi aur ke liye na thi. Aap ﷺ ne ek sawal ke jawab mein farmaya ghoda bhi Anfal mein se hai aur saman bhi. Sail ne phir poocha, Aap ﷺ ne phir yahi jawab diya, usne phir poocha ke jis Anfal ka zikr Kitabullah mein hai us se kya murad hai? Garz poochte poochte aap ko tang kardiya to aap ne farmaya is ka yeh kartoot is se kam nahin jise Hazrat Umar R.A ne mara tha. Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A se jab sawal hota to aap farmate na tujhe hukum deta hoon na mana karta hoon. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain wallah Haq Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ﷺ ko daant dapat karne wala, hukum farmane wala, halal haram ki wazahat karne wala hi bana kar bheja hai. Aap ﷺ ne us sail ko jawab diya ke kisi kisi ko bator-e-nafal (maal-e-ghanimat) ghoda bhi milta aur hathiyar bhi. Do teen dafa usne yahi sawal kiya jis se aap ghazabnak ho gaye aur farmane lage yeh to aisa hi shakhs hai jise Hazrat Umar R.A ne kode lagaye the yahan tak ke us ki ediyan aur takhne khoon-alood ho gaye the. Is par sail kehne laga ke khair aap se to Allah ne Umar ka badla le hi liya. Al-garz Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ke nazdeek to yahan nafal se murad panchwein hisse ke alawa woh inaami cheezein hain jo Imam apne sipahiyon ko ata farmaye. Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain ke logon ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se us panchwein hisse ka masla poocha jo char aise hi hisson ke baad reh jaye. Pas yeh aayat utri. Ibn-e-Masood R.A wagaira farmate hain ladai wale din is se zyada Imam nahin de sakta balkeh ladai ke shuru se pehle agar chahe de de. Ata R.H farmate hain ke yahan murad mushrikon ka woh maal hai jo be-lade bhide mil jaye khwah janwar ho khwah londi ghulam ya asbaab ho, pas woh Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ke liye hi tha, aap ko ikhtiyar tha ke jis kaam mein chahein laga lein to goya un ke nazdeek maal-e-fai Anfal hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is se murad lashkar ke kisi risale ko ba-iwaz un ki karkardagi ya hosla afzai ke Imam unhein aam taqseem se kuch zyada de, ise Anfal kaha jata hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Saad bin Abi Waqqas R.A se marwi hai ke Badr wale din jab mere bhai Umair R.A qatl kiye gaye, main ne Saeed bin Aas ko qatl kiya aur us ki talwar le li jise Zul-Kutaifa kaha jata tha, use le kar Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas pahuncha to aap ﷺ ne farmaya jao ise baqi maal ke sath rakh aao. Main ne hukum ki tameel to kar li lekin Allah hi ko maloom hai ke us waqt mere dil par kya guzri. Ek taraf bhai ke qatl ka sadma, dusri taraf apna hasil karda saman wapas hone ka sadma. Abhi main chand qadam hi chala hoon ga ke Surah Anfal nazil hui aur Rasool Allah ﷺ ne mujh se farmaya jao aur woh talwar jo tum daal aaye ho le jao.

Musnad mein Hazrat Sa'ad bin Malik (R.A) se marwi hai ke main ne Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se arz kiya ke aaj ke din Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe mushrikon se bacha liya, ab aap yeh talwar mujhe de dijiye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya suno na yeh tumhari hai na meri hai. Ise Bait-ul-Maal mein dakhil kar do. Main ne rakh di aur mere dil mein khayal aaya ke aaj jis ne mujh jaisi mehnat nahin ki use yeh inaam mil jayega. Yeh kehta hua ja hi raha tha jo aawaz aayi ke koi mera naam le kar mere peeche se mujhe pukar raha hai. Lota aur poocha ke Huzoor kahin mere bare mein koi wahi nahin utri? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan, tum ne mujh se talwar mangi thi us waqt woh meri na thi, ab woh mujhe de di gayi aur main tumhein de raha hoon. Pas aayat (يَسْــــَٔـلُوْنَكَ عَنِ الْاَنْفَالِ ۭقُلِ الْاَنْفَالُ لِلّٰهِ وَالرَّسُوْلِ ۚ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَاَصْلِحُوْا ذَاتَ بَيْنِكُمْ ۠ وَاَطِيْعُوا اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗٓ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ) (8. Al-Anfal: 1) is bare mein utri hai. Jo Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein inhi se marwi hai ke mere bare mein chaar aayatein nazil hui hain. Mujhe Badr wale din ek talwar mili, main use le kar Sarkar-e-Risalat Ma'ab (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein hazir hua aur arz kiya ke yeh talwar aap mujhe inayat farmayiye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jao jahan se li hai wahin rakh do. Main ne phir talab ki, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne phir yahi jawab diya. Main ne phir manga, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne phir yahi farmaya. Isi waqt yeh aayat utri. Yeh poori hadith hum ne aayat (وَوَصَّيْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حُسْـنًا ۭ وَاِنْ جَاهَدٰكَ لِتُشْرِكَ بِيْ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهٖ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا ۭ اِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَاُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ) (29. Al-Ankabut: 8) ki tafsir mein warid ki hai. Pas ek to yeh aayat, dusri aayat (وَوَصَّيْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ ۚ حَمَلَتْهُ اُمُّهٗ وَهْنًا عَلٰي وَهْنٍ وَّفِصٰلُهٗ فِيْ عَامَيْنِ اَنِ اشْكُرْ لِيْ وَلِوَالِدَيْكَ ۭ اِلَيَّ الْمَصِيْرُ) (31. Luqman: 14), teesri aayat (يٰٓاَيُّھَاالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْٓا اِنَّمَا الْخَمْرُ وَالْمَيْسِرُ وَالْاَنْصَابُ وَالْاَزْلَامُ رِجْسٌ مِّنْ عَمَلِ الشَّيْطٰنِ فَاجْتَنِبُوْهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُوْنَ) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 90), chauthi aayat wasiyat (Sahih Muslim Sharif). Sirat-e-Ibn Ishaq mein hai Hazrat Abu Saeed Malik bin Rabia (R.A) farmate hain ke Badr ki ladai mein mujhe Saif bin Aand ki talwar mili jise Marzban kaha jata tha. Jab Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko hukum diya ke jo kuch jis kisi ke paas ho woh jama kara de, main bhi gaya aur woh talwar rakh aaya. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke agar koi aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kuch mangta to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) inkar na karte. Hazrat Arqam bin Arqam Khuzai (R.A) ne is talwar ko dekh kar aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se isi ka sawal kiya, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein ata farma di.

Is aayat ke nuzool ka sabab Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Umamah ne Hazrat Ubadah se Anfal ki babat sawal kiya toh aap ne farmaya hum Badriyon ke bare mein hai jabke hum maal-e-kuffar ke bare mein baham ikhtilaf karne lage aur jhagde badh gaye toh yeh aayat utri aur yeh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke supurd ho gayi aur Huzoor ne is maal ko barabari se taqseem farmaya. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke hum Ghazwa-e-Badr mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath nikle Allah Ta'ala ne kafiron ko shikast di hamari ek jamaat ne toh un ka ta'aqub kiya ke poori hazimat de de dusri jamaat ne maal-e-ghaneemat maidan-e-jang se sametna shuru kiya aur ek jamaat Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke gird-o-pesh khadi ho gayi ke kahin koi dushman aap ko koi eeza na pahunchaye. Raat ko sab log jama hue aur har jamaat apna haq is maal par jatane lagi. Pehli jamaat ne kaha dushmanon ko hum ne hi haraya hai. Dusri jamaat ne kaha maal-e-ghaneemat hamara hi sameta hua hai. Teesri jamaat ne kaha hum ne Huzoor ki chaukidari ki hai pas yeh aayat utri aur Huzoor ne khud is maal ko hum mein taqseem farmaya. Aap ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke hamle ki maujudgi mein chauthai baant-te aur laut-te waqt tihai aap Anfal ko makrooh samajhte. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke Badr wale din Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne irshad farmaya tha ke jo aisa kare use yeh inaam aur jo aisa kare use yeh inaam. Ab naujawan toh daud pade aur kaar-e-numayan anjam diye. Budhon ne morche thame aur jhandon tale rahe. Ab jawanon ka mutalba tha ke kul maal hamein milna chahiye budhe kehte the ke lashkar-gah ko hum ne mehfooz rakha tum agar shikast uthate toh yahin aate. Isi jhagde ke faisle mein yeh aayat utri. Marwi hai ke Huzoor ka elaan ho gaya tha ke jo kisi kafir ko qatl kare use itna milega aur jo kisi kafir ko qaid kare use itna milega. Hazrat Abu Al-Yasar (R.A) do qaidi pakad laye aur Hazrat ko wada yaad dilaya is par Hazrat Sa'ad bin Ubadah ne kaha ke phir toh hum sab yunhi reh jayenge. Buzdili ya be-taqati ki wajah se hum aage na badhe hon yeh baat nahin balki is liye ke pichli janib se kuffar na aapadein, Huzoor ko koi takleef na pahunche is liye hum aap ke gird-o-pesh rahe, isi jhagde ke faisle mein yeh aayat utri aur aayat (Wa'lamu annama ghanimtum min shai'in fa-anna lillahi khumsahu wa lir-rasooli wa lizil-qurba wal-yatama wal-masakeeni wabnis-sabeeli in kuntum amantum billahi wa ma anzalna 'ala 'abdina yaumal-furqani yaumal-taqal-jam'ani wallahu 'ala kulli shai'in qadeer) (8:41).

(Al-Anfal: 41) bhi utri, Imam Abu Ubaidullah Qasim bin Salam ne apni kitab Ahwal-ush-Shari'ah mein likha hai ke Anfal ghanimat hai aur harbi kafiron ke jo maal musalmanon ke qabze mein aayen woh sab hain. Pas Anfal An-Hazrat ﷺ ki malkiyat mein thay, Badr wale din baghair panchwan hissa nikale jis tarah Allah ne aap ko samjhaya aap ne mujahideen mein taqseem kiya, is ke baad panchwan hissa nikalne ke hukum ki aayat utri aur yeh pehla hukum mansookh ho gaya lekin Ibn Zaid waghera ise mansookh nahin batlate balkay muhkam kehte hain. Anfal ghanimat ki jama hai magar is mein se panchwan hissa makhsoos hai. Is ki ahl ke liye jaise ke Kitabullah mein hukum hai aur jaise ke Sunnat-e-Rasoolullah jari hui hai. Anfal ke ma'ani kalam-e-Arab mein har us ehsan ke hain jise koi baghair kisi pabandi ya wajah ke dusre ke sath kare. Pehle ki tamam ummaton par yeh maal haram thay, is ummat par Allah ne raham farmaya aur maal-e-ghanimat in ke liye halal kiya. Chunancha Bukhari o Muslim mein hai, Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain mujhe panch cheezein di gayi hain jo mujh se pehle kisi ko nahin di gayin, phir un ke zikr mein ek yeh hai ke aap ne farmaya mere liye ghanimatein halal ki gayin, mujh se pehle kisi ko halal na thin. Imam Abu Ubaid farmate hain ke Imam jin lashkariyon ko koi inaam de jo us ke muqarrara hissa ke ilawa ho use nafal kehte hain, ghanimat ke andaaz aur us ke karnamay ke silay ke barabar yeh milta hai. Is nafal ki char suratein hain: Ek to maqtool ka maal asbaab waghera jis mein se panchwan hissa nahin nikala jata. Dusre woh nafal jo panchwan hissa alaihda karne ke baad diya jata hai, maslan Imam ne koi chota sa lashkar kisi dushman par bhej diya, woh ghanimat ya maal le kar palta to Imam is mein se use chauthai ya tihai bant de. Teesri surat yeh ke jo panchwan hissa nikal kar baqi ka taqseem ho chuka hai, ab Imam ba-qadr-e-khazana aur ba-qadr-e-shakhsi jurrat ke is mein se jise jitna chahe de. Chauthi surat yeh ke Imam panchwan hissa nikalne se pehle hi kisi ko kuch de, maslan charwahon ko, sa'eeson ko, bahishti-on ko waghera. Phir har surat mein bohat kuch ikhtilaf hai. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) farmate hain ke maal-e-ghanimat mein se panchwan hissa nikalne se pehle jo saman asbaab maqtooleen ka mujahideen ko diya jaye woh Anfal mein dakhil hai. Dusri wajah yeh hai ke An-Hazrat ﷺ ka apna hissa panchwein hisse mein se panchwan jo tha is mein se aap jise chahein jitna chahein ata farmayen yeh nafal hai. Pas Imam ko chahiye ke dushmanon ki kasrat, musalmanon ki qillat aur aise hi zaroori waqton mein is sunnat ki tabe'dari kare. Haan jab aisa mauqa na ho to nafal zaroori nahin. Teesri wajah yeh hai ke Imam ek choti si jamaat kahin bhejta hai aur un se keh deta hai ke jo shakhs jo kuch hasil kare panchwan hissa nikal kar baqi sab usi ka hai to woh sab unhi ka hai kyunke unhon ne isi shart par ghazwa kiya hai aur yeh razamandi se tay ho chuki hai. Lekin un ke is bayan mein jo kaha gaya hai ke Badr ki ghanimat ka panchwan hissa nahin nikala gaya, is mein zara kalam hai.

Hazrat Ali R.A ne farmaya tha ke do oontniyan woh hain jo unhein Badr ke din paanchwein hissay mein mili thin, main ne is ka poora bayan Kitab-us-Seerah mein kar diya hai. Falhamdulillah. Tum apne kaamon mein Allah ka darr rakho, aapas mein sulh-o-safai rakho, zulm, jhagray aur mukhalifat se baaz aa jao. Jo hidayat-o-ilm Allah ki taraf se tumhein mila hai us ki qadr karo. Allah aur us ke Rasool ki farmanbardari karte raho, adl-o-insaf se in maalon ko taqseem karo. Parhezgari aur salahiyat apne andar paida karo. Musnad Abu Ya'la mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ bethay bethay ek martaba muskuraye aur phir hans diye. Hazrat Umar R.A ne daryaft kiya ke aap par mere maa baap fida hon, kaisay hans diye? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya meri ummat ke do shakhs Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat ke samnay ghutnon ke bal kharay ho gaye. Ek ne kaha Allah mere bhai se mere zulm ka badla le. Allah ne us se farmaya theek hai isay badla de. Us ne kaha Allah mere paas to nekiyan ab baqi nahin rahin. Us ne kaha phir Allah meri buraiyan is par laadh de. Is waqt Huzoor ﷺ ke aansu nikal aaye aur farmanay lagay woh din bara hi sakht hai, log chahtay honge, talash mein honge ke kisi par un ka bojh laadh diya jaye. Is waqt Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga ke ae talib apni nigah utha aur in jannatiyon ko dekh. Woh dekhay ga aur kahay ga chandi ke qil'ay aur sonay ke mehal main dekh raha hoon jo lu'lu aur motiyon se jurao kiye huye hain. Parwardigar mujhe bataya jaye ke yeh makanat aur yeh darjay kisi Nabi ke hain ya kisi Siddiq ke ya kisi Shaheed ke? Allah farmaye ga yeh us ke hain jo in ki qeemat ada kar de. Woh kahay ga Allah kis se in ki qeemat ada ho sakay gi? Farmaye ga tere paas to is ki qeemat hai. Woh khush ho kar poochay ga ke Parwardigar kya? Allah farmaye ga yahi ke tera jo haq is musalman par hai tu isay maaf kar de. Bohat jald kahay ga ke Allah main ne maaf kiya. Allah Ta'ala ka irshad hoga ke ab is ka haath thaam le aur tum dono jannat mein chalay jao. Phir Rasool Allah ﷺ ne is aayat ka aakhri hissa tilawat farmaya ke Allah se daro aur aapas ki islah karo, dekho Allah Ta'ala khud Qayamat ke din mominon mein sulh karaye ga.

Iman se khali log aur haqeeqat-e-iman. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain munafiqon ke dilon mein na fareezay ki adaigi ke waqt zikr-e-Allah hota hai na kisi aur waqt par. Na un ke dilon mein iman ka noor hota hai na Allah par bharosa hota hai. Na tanhai mein namazi rehte hain na apne maal ki zakat dete hain, aise log iman se khali hote hain, lekin imandar un ke bar-aks hote hain. Un ke dil yaad-e-khaliq se kapkapate rehte hain, faraiz ada karte hain, ayat-e-Ilahi sun kar iman chamak uthte hain, tasdeeq mein barh jate hain, Rabb ke siwa kisi par bharosa nahin karte, Allah ki yaad se thartharate rehte hain, Allah ka darr un mein samaya hua hota hai, isi wajah se na toh hukum ka khilaf karte hain na mana kiye hue kaam ko karte hain. Jaise farman hai ke un se agar koi burai sarzad ho bhi jati hai toh yaad-e-Allah karte hain phir apne gunah se istighfar karte hain, haqeeqat mein siwaye Allah ke koi gunahon ka bakshne wala bhi nahin. Yeh log bawajood ilm ke kisi gunah par israr nahin karte. Aur ayaton mein hai ayat (Wa amma man khafa maqama Rabbihi...), jo shakhs apne Rabb ke paas khara hone se dara aur apne nafs ko khwahishon se roka us ka thikana jannat hai. Suddi farmate hain yeh woh log hain ke un ke jee mein zulm karne ki ya gunah karne ki aati hai lekin agar un se kaha jaye ke Allah se darr ja wohin un ka dil kanpne lagta hai. Umm-e-Darda (R.A) farmati hain ke dil Allah ke khauf se harkat karne lagte hain, aise waqt insan ko Allah Azza-wa-Jal se dua mangni chahiye. Imani halat bhi un ki roz-ba-roz ziyadati mein rehti hai, idhar Qurani ayatein sunin aur iman barha. Jaise aur jagah hai ke jab koi surat utarti hai toh ek dusre se puchte hain ke is ne tum mein se kis ka iman barha diya? Baat yeh hai ke iman walon ke iman barh jate hain aur woh khush ho jate hain. Is ayat se aur is jaisi aur ayaton se Hazrat Imam-ul-Aimma Imam Bukhari (R.H) waghera aimma-e-kiram ne istidlal kiya hai ke iman ki ziyadati se murad hai ke dilon mein iman kam ya zyada hota rehta hai, yahi mazhab-e-jumhoor-e-ummat ka hai, balkay kayi ek ne is par ijma naqal kiya hai jaise Shafai, Ahmad bin Hanbal, Abu Ubaida waghera, jaise ke hum ne Sharh-e-Bukhari ke shuru mein puri tarah bayan kar diya hai. Walhamdulillah. Un ka bharosa sirf apne Rabb par hota hai, na us ke siwa kisi se woh umeed rakhein, na us ke siwa koi un ka maqsood, na us ke siwa kisi se woh panah chahein, na us ke siwa kisi se muradein mangein, na kisi aur ki taraf jhukein. Woh jante hain ke qudraton wala wahi hai, jo woh chahta hai hota hai, jo nahin chahta hargiz nahin hota. Tamam mulk mein usi ka hukum chalta hai, mulk sirf wahi hai, woh akela hai, us ka koi shareek nahin, na us ke kisi hukum ko koi taal sake, woh jald hi hisab lene wala hai. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmate hain Allah par tawakkul karna hi pura iman hai. In mominon ke iman aur etiqad ki halat bayan farma kar ab un ke aamal ka zikr ho raha hai ke woh namazon ke paband hote hain.

Waqt ki, wazu ki, ruku ki, sajde ki, kamil pakeezgi ki, Quran ki tilawat, tashahhud, durood, sab cheezon ki hifazat-o-nigrani karte hain. Allah ke is haq ki adaigi ke sath hi bandon ke haq bhi nahin bhoolte. Wajib kharch yani Zakat, mustahab kharch yani lillah fi-Allah khairat barabar dete hain, chunke tamam makhlooq Allah ki ayal hai is liye Allah ko sab se zyada pyara woh hai jo us ki makhlooq ki sab se zyada khidmat kare. Allah ke diye hue ko Allah ki rah mein dete raho, yeh maal tumhare paas Allah ki amanat hai, bahut jald tum ise chhod kar rukhsat hone wale ho. Phir farmata hai ke jin mein yeh ausaf hon woh sachche momin hain. Tabrani mein hai ke Harith bin Malik Ansari (R.A) Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas se guzre to Aap (ﷺ) ne un se daryaft farmaya ke tumhari subah kis haal mein hui? Unhon ne jawab diya ke sachche momin hone ki halat mein. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke samajh lo ke kya keh rahe ho? Har cheez ki haqeeqat hua karti hai. Jaante ho haqeeqat-e-iman kya hai? Jawab diya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main ne apni khwahishein duniya se alag kar lin, raatein yaad-e-Allah mein jaag kar, din Allah ki rah mein bhooke pyase reh kar guzarta hoon. Goya main Allah ke Arsh ko apni nigahon ke samne dekhta rehta hoon aur goya ke main Ahl-e-Jannat ko dekh raha hoon ke woh aapas mein hansi khushi ek dusre se mil-jul rahe hain aur goya ke main Ahl-e-Dozakh ko dekh raha hoon ke woh dozakh mein jal-bhun rahe hain. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Haritha! Tu ne haqeeqat jaan li, pas is haal par hamesha qaim rehna." Teen martaba yahi farmaya. Pas ayat mein bilkul muhawara-e-Arab ke mutabiq hai, jaise woh kaha karte hain ke go falan qoum mein sardar bahut se hain lekin sahih ma'non mein sardar falan hai, ya falan qabeelay mein tajir bahut hain lekin sahih taur par tajir falan hai, falan logon mein shair hain lekin sachcha shair falan hai. Un ke martabey Allah ke haan bade bade hain, Allah un ke a'maal dekh raha hai, woh un ki laghzishon se darguzar farmayega, un ki nekiyon ki qadardani karega. Goya yeh darjay oonche neeche honge lekin kisi buland martaba shakhs ke dil mein yeh khayal na hoga ke main falan se a'la hoon aur na kisi adna darjay walon ko yeh khayal hoga ke main falan se kam hoon. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ) farmate hain ke Illiyeen walon ko neeche ke darjay ke log is tarah dekhenge jaise tum aasman ke kinaron ke sitaron ko dekhte ho. Sahaba ne poocha yeh martabey to Anbiya (A.S) ke honge? Koi aur to is martabay par na pahunch sake ga? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Kyun nahin? Us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai, woh log bhi jo Allah par iman layein aur Rasoolon ko sach jaanein." Ahl-e-Sunan ki hadith mein hai ke Ahl-e-Jannat buland darja jannatiyon ko aise dekhenge jaise tum aasman ke kinaron ke chamkeele sitaron ko dekha karte ho, yaqeenan Abu Bakr aur Umar (R.A) inhi mein hain aur bahut achche hain.

Iman se khali log aur haqeeqat-e-iman. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain munafiqon ke dilon mein na fareezay ki adaigi ke waqt zikr-e-Allah hota hai na kisi aur waqt par. Na un ke dilon mein iman ka noor hota hai na Allah par bharosa hota hai. Na tanhai mein namazi rehte hain na apne maal ki zakat dete hain, aise log iman se khali hote hain, lekin imandar un ke bar-aks hote hain. Un ke dil yaad-e-khaliq se kapkapate rehte hain, faraiz ada karte hain, ayat-e-Ilahi sun kar iman chamak uthte hain, tasdeeq mein barh jate hain, Rabb ke siwa kisi par bharosa nahin karte, Allah ki yaad se thartharate rehte hain, Allah ka darr un mein samaya hua hota hai, isi wajah se na toh hukum ka khilaf karte hain na mana kiye hue kaam ko karte hain. Jaise farman hai ke un se agar koi burai sarzad ho bhi jati hai toh yaad-e-Allah karte hain phir apne gunah se istighfar karte hain, haqeeqat mein siwaye Allah ke koi gunahon ka bakshne wala bhi nahin. Yeh log bawajood ilm ke kisi gunah par israr nahin karte. Aur ayaton mein hai ayat (Wa amma man khafa maqama Rabbihi...), jo shakhs apne Rabb ke paas khara hone se dara aur apne nafs ko khwahishon se roka us ka thikana jannat hai. Suddi farmate hain yeh woh log hain ke un ke jee mein zulm karne ki ya gunah karne ki aati hai lekin agar un se kaha jaye ke Allah se darr ja wohin un ka dil kanpne lagta hai. Umm-e-Darda (R.A) farmati hain ke dil Allah ke khauf se harkat karne lagte hain, aise waqt insan ko Allah Azza-wa-Jal se dua mangni chahiye. Imani halat bhi un ki roz-ba-roz ziyadati mein rehti hai, idhar Qurani ayatein sunin aur iman barha. Jaise aur jagah hai ke jab koi surat utarti hai toh ek dusre se puchte hain ke is ne tum mein se kis ka iman barha diya? Baat yeh hai ke iman walon ke iman barh jate hain aur woh khush ho jate hain. Is ayat se aur is jaisi aur ayaton se Hazrat Imam-ul-Aimma Imam Bukhari (R.H) waghera aimma-e-kiram ne istidlal kiya hai ke iman ki ziyadati se murad hai ke dilon mein iman kam ya zyada hota rehta hai, yahi mazhab-e-jumhoor-e-ummat ka hai, balkay kayi ek ne is par ijma naqal kiya hai jaise Shafai, Ahmad bin Hanbal, Abu Ubaida waghera, jaise ke hum ne Sharh-e-Bukhari ke shuru mein puri tarah bayan kar diya hai. Walhamdulillah. Un ka bharosa sirf apne Rabb par hota hai, na us ke siwa kisi se woh umeed rakhein, na us ke siwa koi un ka maqsood, na us ke siwa kisi se woh panah chahein, na us ke siwa kisi se muradein mangein, na kisi aur ki taraf jhukein. Woh jante hain ke qudraton wala wahi hai, jo woh chahta hai hota hai, jo nahin chahta hargiz nahin hota. Tamam mulk mein usi ka hukum chalta hai, mulk sirf wahi hai, woh akela hai, us ka koi shareek nahin, na us ke kisi hukum ko koi taal sake, woh jald hi hisab lene wala hai. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmate hain Allah par tawakkul karna hi pura iman hai. In mominon ke iman aur etiqad ki halat bayan farma kar ab un ke aamal ka zikr ho raha hai ke woh namazon ke paband hote hain.

Waqt ki, wazu ki, ruku ki, sajde ki, kamil pakeezgi ki, Quran ki tilawat, tashahhud, durood, sab cheezon ki hifazat-o-nigrani karte hain. Allah ke is haq ki adaigi ke sath hi bandon ke haq bhi nahin bhoolte. Wajib kharch yani Zakat, mustahab kharch yani lillah fi-Allah khairat barabar dete hain, chunke tamam makhlooq Allah ki ayal hai is liye Allah ko sab se zyada pyara woh hai jo us ki makhlooq ki sab se zyada khidmat kare. Allah ke diye hue ko Allah ki rah mein dete raho, yeh maal tumhare paas Allah ki amanat hai, bahut jald tum ise chhod kar rukhsat hone wale ho. Phir farmata hai ke jin mein yeh ausaf hon woh sachche momin hain. Tabrani mein hai ke Harith bin Malik Ansari (R.A) Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas se guzre to Aap (ﷺ) ne un se daryaft farmaya ke tumhari subah kis haal mein hui? Unhon ne jawab diya ke sachche momin hone ki halat mein. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke samajh lo ke kya keh rahe ho? Har cheez ki haqeeqat hua karti hai. Jaante ho haqeeqat-e-iman kya hai? Jawab diya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main ne apni khwahishein duniya se alag kar lin, raatein yaad-e-Allah mein jaag kar, din Allah ki rah mein bhooke pyase reh kar guzarta hoon. Goya main Allah ke Arsh ko apni nigahon ke samne dekhta rehta hoon aur goya ke main Ahl-e-Jannat ko dekh raha hoon ke woh aapas mein hansi khushi ek dusre se mil-jul rahe hain aur goya ke main Ahl-e-Dozakh ko dekh raha hoon ke woh dozakh mein jal-bhun rahe hain. Shama-e-Risalat ke jaan-nisaron ki duayein ek matlab to is ka yeh hai ke jaise tum ne maal-e-ghanimat mein ikhtilaf kiya aakhir Allah Ta'ala ne ise apne haath mein le liya aur apne Nabi ko is ki taqseem ka ikhtiyar de diya aur apne adl-o-insaf ke saath ise tum mein baant diya dar-haqiqat tumhare liye isi mein bhalayi thi isi tarah us ne bawajood tumhari is chahat ke ke Quraish ka tijarati qafila tumhein mil jaye aur jangi jama'at se muqabla na ho us ne tumhara muqabla baghair kisi waade ke ek pur-shikoh jama'at se kara diya aur tumhein is par ghalib kardiya ke Allah ki baat buland hojaye aur tumhein fatah, nusrat, ghalba aur shan-o-shaukat ata ho. Jaise farman hai ayat (Kutiba alaikumul qitalu wa huwa kurhul lakum ilakh), tum par jihad farz kiya gaya halanke tum ise bura jaante ho bahut mumkin hai ke ek cheez ko apne haq mein achhi na jaano aur dar-haqiqat wahi tumhare haq mein behtar ho aur haq mein woh badtar ho. Dar-asl haqaiq ka ilm Allah hi ko hai tum mahaz be-ilm ho. Dusra matlab yeh hai ke jaise momino ke ek giroh ki chahat ke khilaf tujhe tere Rab ne shehar se bahar ladayi ke liye nikala aur natija isi ka achha hua aise hi jo log jihad ke liye nikalna bojh samajh rahe hain dar-asl yahi un ke haq mein behtar hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke maal-e-ghanimat mein in ka ikhtilaf bilkul Badr wale din ke ikhtilaf ke mushaba tha. Kehne lage thay aap ne humein qafile ka farmaya tha lashkar ka nahin hum jangi tayyari kar ke nikle hi nahin. Mein kehta hoon ke Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine se isi irade se nikle thay ke Abu Sufyan ke is qafile ko rokein jo Shaam se Madina ko Quraishiyon ke bahut se maal-o-asbab le kar aa raha tha. Huzoor ne logon ko tayyar kiya aur teen sau das se kuch upar logon ko le kar aap Madine se chale aur samundar ke kinare ke raste ki taraf se Badr ke maqam se chale. Abu Sufyan ko chunke aap ke nikalne ki khabar pahunch chuki thi us ne apna rasta badal diya aur ek tez-ro qasid ko Makkah daudaya. Wahan se Quraish qareeb ek hazar ke lashkar-e-jarrar le kar lohe mein doobe hue Badr ke maidan mein pahunch gaye pas yeh dono jama'atein takra gayin ek ghamsan ki ladayi hui aur Allah Ta'ala ne haq ko fatah dilwayi apna deen buland kiya aur apne Nabi ki madad ki aur Islam ko kufr par ghalib kiya jaise ke ab bayan hoga Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Yahan maqsad-e-bayan sirf itna hi hai ke jab Huzoor ko yeh pata chala ke mushrikeen ki jangi muhim Makkah se aa rahi hai us waqt Allah Ta'ala ne aap se bazariya-e-wahyi ke waada kiya ke ya to qafila aap ko milega ya lashkar-e-kuffar. Aksar Musalman jee se chahte thay ke qafila mil jaye kyunke yeh nisbatan halki cheez thi lekin Allah ka irada tha ke isi waqt baghair zyada tayyari aur ehtimam ke aur aapas ke qaul-o-qarar ke mud-bhed hojaye aur haq-o-baatil ki tameez hojaye kuffar ki himmat toot jaye aur deen-e-haq nikhar aaye.

Tafsir Ibn Marduwayh mein hai Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain ke Madine mein humein Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke mujhe khabar pahunchi hai ke Abu Sufyan ka qafila laut raha hai to kya tum is ke liye tayyar ho ke hum is qafile ki taraf badhein? Bohat mumkin hai ke Allah Ta'ala humein maal-e-ghanimat dilwa de. Hum sab ne tayyari zahir ki Aap humein le kar chale ek din ya do din ka safar kar ke Aap ne hum se farmaya ke Quraishiyon se jihad ke bare mein kya khayal hai? Unhein tumhare chalne ka ilm ho gaya hai aur woh tum se ladne ke liye chal pade hain. Hum ne jawab diya ke Wallah hum mein un se muqable ki taqat nahin hum to sirf qafile ke irade se nikle hain. Aap ne phir yehi sawal kiya aur hum ne phir yehi jawab diya. Ab Hazrat Miqdad bin Amr (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne kaha ke Ya Rasoolullah hum is waqt Aap ko woh na kahein ge jo Musa ki qaum ne Hazrat Musa se kaha tha ke tu aur tera Rabb ja kar kafiron se lade, hum to yahan baithe hue hain. Ab to humein bada hi ranj hone laga ke kash yehi jawab hum bhi dete to humein maal ke milne se achha tha, pas yeh ayat utri. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Badr ki janib chalte hue Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Rauha mein pahunche to Aap ne logon ko khutba diya aur is mein farmaya ke batao tumhari kya raye hai? Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar ne farmaya ke haan humein bhi maloom hua hai ke woh log falan falan jagah hain. Aap ne phir khutba diya aur yehi farmaya ab ki martaba Hazrat Umar Farooq ne yehi jawab diya Aap ne phir teesre khutbe mein yehi farmaya is par Hazrat Sa'd bin Mu'adh ne jawab diya ke Ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya Aap hum se daryaft farma rahe hain? Is Allah ki qasam jis ne Aap ko izzat-o-buzurgi inayat farmai hai aur Aap par apni Kitab nazil farmai hai na mein in raston mein kabhi chala hoon aur na mujhe is lashkar ka ilm hai haan itna mein keh sakta hoon ke agar Aap Bark-ul-Ghimad tak bhi chadhayi karein to Wallah hum Aap ki rikab thame Aap ke peeche honge hum un ki tarah nahin jinhone Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) se keh diya tha ke tu apne saath apne Parvardigar ko le kar chala ja aur tum donon un se lad lo hum to yahan baithe hain. Nahin nahin balki ae Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Aap chaliye Allah Aap ka saath de hum to Aap ke zer-e-hukm kuffar se jihad ke liye sidq-e-dil se tayyar hain. Ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) go Aap kisi kaam ko zer-e-nazar rakh kar nikle hon lekin is waqt koi aur naya kaam pesh-e-nigah ho to Bismillah kijiye, hum tabedari se munh pherne wale nahin. Aap jis se chahein nata tod lijiye aur jis se chahein jod lijiye jis se chahein adawat kijiye aur jis se chahein mohabbat kijiye hum isi mein Aap ke saath hain. Ya Rasoolullah hamari janon ke saath hamare maal bhi hazir hain, Aap ko jis qadar zaroorat ho lijiye aur kaam mein lagaiye. Pas Hazrat Sa'd ke is farman par Quran ki yeh ayatein utri hain.

Ibn Abbas farmate hain jab Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dushman se Badr mein jang karne ki babat Sahaba se mashwara kiya aur Hazrat Sa'd bin Ubadah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne jawab diya aur Huzoor ne mujahideen ko kamar bandi ka hukm de diya us waqt baaz Musalmanon ko yeh zara guran guzra is par yeh aayatein utrein. Pas haq mein jhagadne se murad Jihad mein ikhtilaf karna hai aur mushrikon ke lashkar se mud-bhed hone aur un ki taraf chalne ko napasand karna hai. Is ke baad un ke liye wazeh ho gaya yaani yeh amr ke Huzoor baghair hukm-e-Rabb-ul-Izzat ke koi hukm nahin dete. Dusri tafsir mein hai ke is se murad mushrik log hain jo haq mein rode atkate hain. Islam ka maanna un ke nazdeek aisa hai jaise dekhte hue maut ke munh mein koodna. Yeh wasf mushrikon ke siwa aur kisi ka nahin ahl-e-kufr ki pehli alamat yahi hai Ibn Zaid ka yeh qaul waarid kar ke Imam Ibn Jarir (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmate hain ke yeh qaul bilkul be-maani hai is liye ke is se pehle ka qaul ayat (Yujadilunaka fil-haqqi ba'da ma tabayyana ka-annama yusaquna ilal-mauti wa hum yanzurun) (8: Al-Anfal: 6) ahl-e-iman ki khabar hai to is se muttasil khabar bhi unhi ki hai. Ibn Abbas aur Ibn Ishaq hi ka qaul is bare mein theek hai ke yeh khabar mominon ki hai na ke kafiron ki. Haq baat yahi hai jo Imam sahab ne kahi. Siyaq-e-kalam ki dalalat bhi isi par hai (Wallahu A'lam). Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Badr ki ladayi ki fatah ke baad baaz Sahaba ne Huzoor se arz kiya ke ab chaliye qafle ko bhi daba lein ab koi rok nahin hai. Us waqt Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib kuffar se qaid ho kar aaye hue zanjeeron se jakde hue thay oonchi awaz se kehne lage ke Huzoor aisa na kijiye. Aap ne daryaft farmaya kyun? Unhon ne jawab diya is liye ke Allah Ta'ala ne aap se do jama'aton mein se ek ka wa'da kiya tha woh Allah ne poora kiya ek jama'at aap ko mil gayi. Musalmanon ki chahat thi ke ladayi wale giroh se to mud-bhed na ho albatta qafle wale mil jayein aur Allah ki chahat thi ke shaukat-o-shan wali quwwat-o-ghamand wali ladayi bhidayi wali jama'at se tumhara muqabla ho jaye taake Allah Ta'ala un par tumhein ghalib kar ke tumhari madad kare, apne deen ko zahir kar de aur apne kalme ko buland kar de aur apne deen ko dusre tamam deenon par ooncha kar de pas anjam ki bhalayi is ke siwa koi nahin jaanta woh apni umdah tadbeer se tumhein sambhaal raha hai tumhari marzi ke khilaf karta hai aur isi mein tumhari maslahat aur bhalayi hoti hai jaise farmaya ke Jihad tum par likha gaya aur woh tumhein napasand hai lekin ho sakta hai ke tumhari napasandidagi ki cheez mein hi anjam ke lihaz se tumhare liye behtari ho aur yeh bhi mumkin hai ke tum kisi cheez ko pasand karo aur woh dar-haqiqat tumhare haq mein buri ho. Ab jang-e-Badr ka mukhtasar sa waqia ba-zaban-e-Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) suniye.

Jab Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne suna ke Abu Sufyan Sham se ma'a qafle ke aur ma'a asbab ke aa raha hai to Aap ne Musalmanon ko farmaya ke chalo un ka rasta roko mumkin hai ke Allah Ta'ala un ke yeh asbab tumhein dilwa de chunke kisi larane wali jama'at se larai karne ka khayal bhi na tha. Is liye log baghair kisi khas tayyari ke jaise thay waise hi halke phulke nikal khare hue. Abu Sufyan bhi ghafil na tha us ne jasoos chhor rakhe thay aur aate jaaton se bhi daryaft-e-haal kar raha tha ek qafle se usay maloom hogaya ke Huzoor apne sathiyon ko le kar tere aur tere qafle ki taraf chal pare hain. Us ne Zaigham bin Amr Ghafari ko inaam de dila kar isi waqt Quraish-e-Makkah ke paas yeh paigham de kar rawana kiya ke tumhare maal khatre mein hain. Huzoor ma'a apne ashab ke is taraf aa rahe hain tumhein chahiye ke poori tayyari se fauran hamari madad ko aao us ne bahut jald wahan pahunch kar khabar di to Quraishiyon ne zabardast hamle ki tayyari karli aur nikal khare hue Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab Zafran waadi mein pahunche to Aap ko Quraish ke lashkaron ka saaz-o-saman se nikalna maloom hogaya. Aap ne Sahaba se mashwara liya aur yeh khabar bhi kardi. Hazrat Abu Bakr ne khare ho kar jawab diya aur bahut achha kaha. Phir Hazrat Umar khare hue aur Aap ne bhi maqool jawab diya. Phir Hazrat Miqdad khare hue aur kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah Ta'ala ka jo hukm ho usay anjam dijiye hum jaan-o-maal se Aap ke saath hain aur har tarah farmanbardar hain hum Bani Israel ki tarah nahin ke apne Nabi se keh dein ke Aap aur Aap ka Rab ja kar lar lo hum tamasha dekhte hain nahin balkay hamara yeh qaul hai ke Allah ki madad ke saath chaliye jung kijiye hum Aap ke saath hain us Allah ki qasam jis ne Aap ko Nabi-e-Barhaq bana kar bheja hai ke agar Aap Birk-e-Ghamad tak yaani Habsha ke mulk tak bhi chalein to hum saath se munh na morein ge aur wahan pahunchaye aur pahunche baghair kisi tarah na rahein ge Aap ne unhein bahut achha kaha aur un ko bari duaein dein lekin phir bhi yehi farmate rahe ke logo mujhe mashwara do meri baat ka jawab do is se murad Aap ki Ansariyon ke giroh se thi ek to is liye ke ginti mein yehi zyada thay. Doosre is liye bhi ke Aqba mein jab Ansar ne bai'at ki thi to is baat par ki thi ke jab Aap Makkah se nikal kar Madine mein pahunch jayein phir hum Aap ke saath hain jo bhi dushman Aap par charhai kar ke aaye hum us ke muqable mein seena-sipar ho jayein ge is mein chunke yeh wa'ada na tha ke khud Aap agar kisi par charh kar jayein to bhi hum Aap ka saath dein ge is liye Aap chahte thay ke ab un ka irada maloom karlein. Yeh samajh kar Hazrat Sa'ad bin Mu'az (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) khare hogaye aur arz kiya ke shayad Aap hum se jawab talab farma rahe hain? Aap ne farmaya haan yehi baat hai to Hazrat Sa'ad ne arz kiya Ya Rasool Allah hamara Aap par iman hai hum Aap ko sacha jaante hain aur jo kuch Aap laye hain usay bhi haq maante hain hum Aap ka farman sunne aur us par amal karne ki bai'at kar chuke hain.

Ae Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jo hukm Allah Ta'ala ka Aap ko hua hai usay poora kijiye, hum Aap ki ham-rikabi se na hatein ge. Us Allah ki qasam jis ne Aap ko apna sacha Rasool bana kar bheja hai ke agar samundar ke kinare par khare ho kar Aap us mein ghora daal dein to hum bhi bila-ta'ammul us mein kood parein ge hum mein se ek ko bhi Aap aisa na payein ge jisay zara sa bhi ta'ammul ho hum us par ba-khushi razamand hain ke Aap humein dushmano ke muqable par chhor dein. Hum laraiyon mein bahaduri karne wale museebat ke jheelne wale aur dushman ke dil par sikka jama dene wale hain Aap hamare kaam dekh kar Insha'Allah khush hon ge chaliye Allah ka naam le kar charhai kijiye Allah barkat de. Un ke is jawab se Aap bahut hi masroor hue usi waqt kooch ka hukm diya ke chalo Allah ki barkat par khush ho jao. Rabb mujh se wa'da kar chuka hai ke do jama'aton mein se ek jama'at hamare hath lage gi Wallah mein to in logon ke girne ki jagah abhi yahin se goya apni aankhon dekh raha hoon.

Shama-e-Risalat ke jaan-nisaron ki duayein ek matlab to is ka yeh hai ke jaise tum ne maal-e-ghanimat mein ikhtilaf kiya aakhir Allah Ta'ala ne ise apne haath mein le liya aur apne Nabi ko is ki taqseem ka ikhtiyar de diya aur apne adl-o-insaf ke saath ise tum mein baant diya dar-haqiqat tumhare liye isi mein bhalayi thi isi tarah us ne bawajood tumhari is chahat ke ke Quraish ka tijarati qafila tumhein mil jaye aur jangi jama'at se muqabla na ho us ne tumhara muqabla baghair kisi waade ke ek pur-shikoh jama'at se kara diya aur tumhein is par ghalib kardiya ke Allah ki baat buland hojaye aur tumhein fatah, nusrat, ghalba aur shan-o-shaukat ata ho. Jaise farman hai ayat (Kutiba alaikumul qitalu wa huwa kurhul lakum ilakh), tum par jihad farz kiya gaya halanke tum ise bura jaante ho bahut mumkin hai ke ek cheez ko apne haq mein achhi na jaano aur dar-haqiqat wahi tumhare haq mein behtar ho aur haq mein woh badtar ho. Dar-asl haqaiq ka ilm Allah hi ko hai tum mahaz be-ilm ho. Dusra matlab yeh hai ke jaise momino ke ek giroh ki chahat ke khilaf tujhe tere Rab ne shehar se bahar ladayi ke liye nikala aur natija isi ka achha hua aise hi jo log jihad ke liye nikalna bojh samajh rahe hain dar-asl yahi un ke haq mein behtar hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke maal-e-ghanimat mein in ka ikhtilaf bilkul Badr wale din ke ikhtilaf ke mushaba tha. Kehne lage thay aap ne humein qafile ka farmaya tha lashkar ka nahin hum jangi tayyari kar ke nikle hi nahin. Mein kehta hoon ke Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine se isi irade se nikle thay ke Abu Sufyan ke is qafile ko rokein jo Shaam se Madina ko Quraishiyon ke bahut se maal-o-asbab le kar aa raha tha. Huzoor ne logon ko tayyar kiya aur teen sau das se kuch upar logon ko le kar aap Madine se chale aur samundar ke kinare ke raste ki taraf se Badr ke maqam se chale. Abu Sufyan ko chunke aap ke nikalne ki khabar pahunch chuki thi us ne apna rasta badal diya aur ek tez-ro qasid ko Makkah daudaya. Wahan se Quraish qareeb ek hazar ke lashkar-e-jarrar le kar lohe mein doobe hue Badr ke maidan mein pahunch gaye pas yeh dono jama'atein takra gayin ek ghamsan ki ladayi hui aur Allah Ta'ala ne haq ko fatah dilwayi apna deen buland kiya aur apne Nabi ki madad ki aur Islam ko kufr par ghalib kiya jaise ke ab bayan hoga Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Yahan maqsad-e-bayan sirf itna hi hai ke jab Huzoor ko yeh pata chala ke mushrikeen ki jangi muhim Makkah se aa rahi hai us waqt Allah Ta'ala ne aap se bazariya-e-wahyi ke waada kiya ke ya to qafila aap ko milega ya lashkar-e-kuffar. Aksar Musalman jee se chahte thay ke qafila mil jaye kyunke yeh nisbatan halki cheez thi lekin Allah ka irada tha ke isi waqt baghair zyada tayyari aur ehtimam ke aur aapas ke qaul-o-qarar ke mud-bhed hojaye aur haq-o-baatil ki tameez hojaye kuffar ki himmat toot jaye aur deen-e-haq nikhar aaye.

Tafsir Ibn Marduwayh mein hai Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain ke Madine mein humein Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke mujhe khabar pahunchi hai ke Abu Sufyan ka qafila laut raha hai to kya tum is ke liye tayyar ho ke hum is qafile ki taraf badhein? Bohat mumkin hai ke Allah Ta'ala humein maal-e-ghanimat dilwa de. Hum sab ne tayyari zahir ki Aap humein le kar chale ek din ya do din ka safar kar ke Aap ne hum se farmaya ke Quraishiyon se jihad ke bare mein kya khayal hai? Unhein tumhare chalne ka ilm ho gaya hai aur woh tum se ladne ke liye chal pade hain. Hum ne jawab diya ke Wallah hum mein un se muqable ki taqat nahin hum to sirf qafile ke irade se nikle hain. Aap ne phir yehi sawal kiya aur hum ne phir yehi jawab diya. Ab Hazrat Miqdad bin Amr (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne kaha ke Ya Rasoolullah hum is waqt Aap ko woh na kahein ge jo Musa ki qaum ne Hazrat Musa se kaha tha ke tu aur tera Rabb ja kar kafiron se lade, hum to yahan baithe hue hain. Ab to humein bada hi ranj hone laga ke kash yehi jawab hum bhi dete to humein maal ke milne se achha tha, pas yeh ayat utri. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Badr ki janib chalte hue Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Rauha mein pahunche to Aap ne logon ko khutba diya aur is mein farmaya ke batao tumhari kya raye hai? Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar ne farmaya ke haan humein bhi maloom hua hai ke woh log falan falan jagah hain. Aap ne phir khutba diya aur yehi farmaya ab ki martaba Hazrat Umar Farooq ne yehi jawab diya Aap ne phir teesre khutbe mein yehi farmaya is par Hazrat Sa'd bin Mu'adh ne jawab diya ke Ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya Aap hum se daryaft farma rahe hain? Is Allah ki qasam jis ne Aap ko izzat-o-buzurgi inayat farmai hai aur Aap par apni Kitab nazil farmai hai na mein in raston mein kabhi chala hoon aur na mujhe is lashkar ka ilm hai haan itna mein keh sakta hoon ke agar Aap Bark-ul-Ghimad tak bhi chadhayi karein to Wallah hum Aap ki rikab thame Aap ke peeche honge hum un ki tarah nahin jinhone Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) se keh diya tha ke tu apne saath apne Parvardigar ko le kar chala ja aur tum donon un se lad lo hum to yahan baithe hain. Nahin nahin balki ae Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Aap chaliye Allah Aap ka saath de hum to Aap ke zer-e-hukm kuffar se jihad ke liye sidq-e-dil se tayyar hain. Ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) go Aap kisi kaam ko zer-e-nazar rakh kar nikle hon lekin is waqt koi aur naya kaam pesh-e-nigah ho to Bismillah kijiye, hum tabedari se munh pherne wale nahin. Aap jis se chahein nata tod lijiye aur jis se chahein jod lijiye jis se chahein adawat kijiye aur jis se chahein mohabbat kijiye hum isi mein Aap ke saath hain. Ya Rasoolullah hamari janon ke saath hamare maal bhi hazir hain, Aap ko jis qadar zaroorat ho lijiye aur kaam mein lagaiye. Pas Hazrat Sa'd ke is farman par Quran ki yeh ayatein utri hain.

Mein kehta hoon ke Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine se isi irade se nikle thay ke Abu Sufyan ke is qafile ko rokein jo Shaam se Madina ko Quraishiyon ke bahut se maal-o-asbab le kar aa raha tha. Huzoor ne logon ko tayyar kiya aur teen sau das se kuch upar logon ko le kar aap Madine se chale aur samundar ke kinare ke raste ki taraf se Badr ke maqam se chale. Abu Sufyan ko chunke aap ke nikalne ki khabar pahunch chuki thi us ne apna rasta badal diya aur ek tez-ro qasid ko Makkah daudaya. Wahan se Quraish qareeb ek hazar ke lashkar-e-jarrar le kar lohe mein doobe hue Badr ke maidan mein pahunch gaye pas yeh dono jama'atein takra gayin ek ghamsan ki ladayi hui aur Allah Ta'ala ne haq ko fatah dilwayi apna deen buland kiya aur apne Nabi ki madad ki aur Islam ko kufr par ghalib kiya jaise ke ab bayan hoga Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Yahan maqsad-e-bayan sirf itna hi hai ke jab Huzoor ko yeh pata chala ke mushrikeen ki jangi muhim Makkah se aa rahi hai us waqt Allah Ta'ala ne aap se bazariya-e-wahyi ke waada kiya ke ya to qafila aap ko milega ya lashkar-e-kuffar. Aksar Musalman jee se chahte thay ke qafila mil jaye kyunke yeh nisbatan halki cheez thi lekin Allah ka irada tha ke isi waqt baghair zyada tayyari aur ehtimam ke aur aapas ke qaul-o-qarar ke mud-bhed hojaye aur haq-o-baatil ki tameez hojaye kuffar ki himmat toot jaye aur deen-e-haq nikhar aaye.

Tafsir Ibn Marduwayh mein hai Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain ke Madine mein humein Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke mujhe khabar pahunchi hai ke Abu Sufyan ka qafila laut raha hai to kya tum is ke liye tayyar ho ke hum is qafile ki taraf badhein? Bohat mumkin hai ke Allah Ta'ala humein maal-e-ghanimat dilwa de. Hum sab ne tayyari zahir ki Aap humein le kar chale ek din ya do din ka safar kar ke Aap ne hum se farmaya ke Quraishiyon se jihad ke bare mein kya khayal hai? Unhein tumhare chalne ka ilm ho gaya hai aur woh tum se ladne ke liye chal pade hain. Hum ne jawab diya ke Wallah hum mein un se muqable ki taqat nahin hum to sirf qafile ke irade se nikle hain. Aap ne phir yehi sawal kiya aur hum ne phir yehi jawab diya. Ab Hazrat Miqdad bin Amr (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne kaha ke Ya Rasoolullah hum is waqt Aap ko woh na kahein ge jo Musa ki qaum ne Hazrat Musa se kaha tha ke tu aur tera Rabb ja kar kafiron se lade, hum to yahan baithe hue hain. Ab to humein bada hi ranj hone laga ke kash yehi jawab hum bhi dete to humein maal ke milne se achha tha, pas yeh ayat utri. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Badr ki janib chalte hue Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Rauha mein pahunche to Aap ne logon ko khutba diya aur is mein farmaya ke batao tumhari kya raye hai? Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar ne farmaya ke haan humein bhi maloom hua hai ke woh log falan falan jagah hain. Aap ne phir khutba diya aur yehi farmaya ab ki martaba Hazrat Umar Farooq ne yehi jawab diya Aap ne phir teesre khutbe mein yehi farmaya is par Hazrat Sa'd bin Mu'adh ne jawab diya ke Ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya Aap hum se daryaft farma rahe hain? Is Allah ki qasam jis ne Aap ko izzat-o-buzurgi inayat farmai hai aur Aap par apni Kitab nazil farmai hai na mein in raston mein kabhi chala hoon aur na mujhe is lashkar ka ilm hai haan itna mein keh sakta hoon ke agar Aap Bark-ul-Ghimad tak bhi chadhayi karein to Wallah hum Aap ki rikab thame Aap ke peeche honge hum un ki tarah nahin jinhone Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) se keh diya tha ke tu apne saath apne Parvardigar ko le kar chala ja aur tum donon un se lad lo hum to yahan baithe hain. Nahin nahin balki ae Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Aap chaliye Allah Aap ka saath de hum to Aap ke zer-e-hukm kuffar se jihad ke liye sidq-e-dil se tayyar hain. Ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) go Aap kisi kaam ko zer-e-nazar rakh kar nikle hon lekin is waqt koi aur naya kaam pesh-e-nigah ho to Bismillah kijiye, hum tabedari se munh pherne wale nahin. Aap jis se chahein nata tod lijiye aur jis se chahein jod lijiye jis se chahein adawat kijiye aur jis se chahein mohabbat kijiye hum isi mein Aap ke saath hain. Ya Rasoolullah hamari janon ke saath hamare maal bhi hazir hain, Aap ko jis qadar zaroorat ho lijiye aur kaam mein lagaiye. Pas Hazrat Sa'd ke is farman par Quran ki yeh ayatein utri hain.

Ibn Abbas farmate hain jab Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dushman se Badr mein jang karne ki babat Sahaba se mashwara kiya aur Hazrat Sa'd bin Ubadah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne jawab diya aur Huzoor ne mujahideen ko kamar bandi ka hukm de diya us waqt baaz Musalmanon ko yeh zara guran guzra is par yeh aayatein utrein. Pas haq mein jhagadne se murad Jihad mein ikhtilaf karna hai aur mushrikon ke lashkar se mud-bhed hone aur un ki taraf chalne ko napasand karna hai. Is ke baad un ke liye wazeh ho gaya yaani yeh amr ke Huzoor baghair hukm-e-Rabb-ul-Izzat ke koi hukm nahin dete. Dusri tafsir mein hai ke is se murad mushrik log hain jo haq mein rode atkate hain. Islam ka maanna un ke nazdeek aisa hai jaise dekhte hue maut ke munh mein koodna. Yeh wasf mushrikon ke siwa aur kisi ka nahin ahl-e-kufr ki pehli alamat yahi hai Ibn Zaid ka yeh qaul waarid kar ke Imam Ibn Jarir (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmate hain ke yeh qaul bilkul be-maani hai is liye ke is se pehle ka qaul ayat (Yujadilunaka fil-haqqi ba'da ma tabayyana ka-annama yusaquna ilal-mauti wa hum yanzurun) (8: Al-Anfal: 6) ahl-e-iman ki khabar hai to is se muttasil khabar bhi unhi ki hai. Ibn Abbas aur Ibn Ishaq hi ka qaul is bare mein theek hai ke yeh khabar mominon ki hai na ke kafiron ki. Haq baat yahi hai jo Imam sahab ne kahi. Siyaq-e-kalam ki dalalat bhi isi par hai (Wallahu A'lam). Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Badr ki ladayi ki fatah ke baad baaz Sahaba ne Huzoor se arz kiya ke ab chaliye qafle ko bhi daba lein ab koi rok nahin hai. Us waqt Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib kuffar se qaid ho kar aaye hue zanjeeron se jakde hue thay oonchi awaz se kehne lage ke Huzoor aisa na kijiye. Aap ne daryaft farmaya kyun? Unhon ne jawab diya is liye ke Allah Ta'ala ne aap se do jama'aton mein se ek ka wa'da kiya tha woh Allah ne poora kiya ek jama'at aap ko mil gayi. Musalmanon ki chahat thi ke ladayi wale giroh se to mud-bhed na ho albatta qafle wale mil jayein aur Allah ki chahat thi ke shaukat-o-shan wali quwwat-o-ghamand wali ladayi bhidayi wali jama'at se tumhara muqabla ho jaye taake Allah Ta'ala un par tumhein ghalib kar ke tumhari madad kare, apne deen ko zahir kar de aur apne kalme ko buland kar de aur apne deen ko dusre tamam deenon par ooncha kar de pas anjam ki bhalayi is ke siwa koi nahin jaanta woh apni umdah tadbeer se tumhein sambhaal raha hai tumhari marzi ke khilaf karta hai aur isi mein tumhari maslahat aur bhalayi hoti hai jaise farmaya ke Jihad tum par likha gaya aur woh tumhein napasand hai lekin ho sakta hai ke tumhari napasandidagi ki cheez mein hi anjam ke lihaz se tumhare liye behtari ho aur yeh bhi mumkin hai ke tum kisi cheez ko pasand karo aur woh dar-haqiqat tumhare haq mein buri ho. Ab jang-e-Badr ka mukhtasar sa waqia ba-zaban-e-Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) suniye.

Jab Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne suna ke Abu Sufyan Sham se ma'a qafle ke aur ma'a asbab ke aa raha hai to Aap ne Musalmanon ko farmaya ke chalo un ka rasta roko mumkin hai ke Allah Ta'ala un ke yeh asbab tumhein dilwa de chunke kisi larane wali jama'at se larai karne ka khayal bhi na tha. Is liye log baghair kisi khas tayyari ke jaise thay waise hi halke phulke nikal khare hue. Abu Sufyan bhi ghafil na tha us ne jasoos chhor rakhe thay aur aate jaaton se bhi daryaft-e-haal kar raha tha ek qafle se usay maloom hogaya ke Huzoor apne sathiyon ko le kar tere aur tere qafle ki taraf chal pare hain. Us ne Zaigham bin Amr Ghafari ko inaam de dila kar isi waqt Quraish-e-Makkah ke paas yeh paigham de kar rawana kiya ke tumhare maal khatre mein hain. Huzoor ma'a apne ashab ke is taraf aa rahe hain tumhein chahiye ke poori tayyari se fauran hamari madad ko aao us ne bahut jald wahan pahunch kar khabar di to Quraishiyon ne zabardast hamle ki tayyari karli aur nikal khare hue Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab Zafran waadi mein pahunche to Aap ko Quraish ke lashkaron ka saaz-o-saman se nikalna maloom hogaya. Aap ne Sahaba se mashwara liya aur yeh khabar bhi kardi. Hazrat Abu Bakr ne khare ho kar jawab diya aur bahut achha kaha. Phir Hazrat Umar khare hue aur Aap ne bhi maqool jawab diya. Phir Hazrat Miqdad khare hue aur kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah Ta'ala ka jo hukm ho usay anjam dijiye hum jaan-o-maal se Aap ke saath hain aur har tarah farmanbardar hain hum Bani Israel ki tarah nahin ke apne Nabi se keh dein ke Aap aur Aap ka Rab ja kar lar lo hum tamasha dekhte hain nahin balkay hamara yeh qaul hai ke Allah ki madad ke saath chaliye jung kijiye hum Aap ke saath hain us Allah ki qasam jis ne Aap ko Nabi-e-Barhaq bana kar bheja hai ke agar Aap Birk-e-Ghamad tak yaani Habsha ke mulk tak bhi chalein to hum saath se munh na morein ge aur wahan pahunchaye aur pahunche baghair kisi tarah na rahein ge Aap ne unhein bahut achha kaha aur un ko bari duaein dein lekin phir bhi yehi farmate rahe ke logo mujhe mashwara do meri baat ka jawab do is se murad Aap ki Ansariyon ke giroh se thi ek to is liye ke ginti mein yehi zyada thay. Doosre is liye bhi ke Aqba mein jab Ansar ne bai'at ki thi to is baat par ki thi ke jab Aap Makkah se nikal kar Madine mein pahunch jayein phir hum Aap ke saath hain jo bhi dushman Aap par charhai kar ke aaye hum us ke muqable mein seena-sipar ho jayein ge is mein chunke yeh wa'ada na tha ke khud Aap agar kisi par charh kar jayein to bhi hum Aap ka saath dein ge is liye Aap chahte thay ke ab un ka irada maloom karlein. Yeh samajh kar Hazrat Sa'ad bin Mu'az (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) khare hogaye aur arz kiya ke shayad Aap hum se jawab talab farma rahe hain? Aap ne farmaya haan yehi baat hai to Hazrat Sa'ad ne arz kiya Ya Rasool Allah hamara Aap par iman hai hum Aap ko sacha jaante hain aur jo kuch Aap laye hain usay bhi haq maante hain hum Aap ka farman sunne aur us par amal karne ki bai'at kar chuke hain.

Ae Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jo hukm Allah Ta'ala ka Aap ko hua hai usay poora kijiye, hum Aap ki ham-rikabi se na hatein ge. Us Allah ki qasam jis ne Aap ko apna sacha Rasool bana kar bheja hai ke agar samundar ke kinare par khare ho kar Aap us mein ghora daal dein to hum bhi bila-ta'ammul us mein kood parein ge hum mein se ek ko bhi Aap aisa na payein ge jisay zara sa bhi ta'ammul ho hum us par ba-khushi razamand hain ke Aap humein dushmano ke muqable par chhor dein. Hum laraiyon mein bahaduri karne wale museebat ke jheelne wale aur dushman ke dil par sikka jama dene wale hain Aap hamare kaam dekh kar Insha'Allah khush hon ge chaliye Allah ka naam le kar charhai kijiye Allah barkat de. Un ke is jawab se Aap bahut hi masroor hue usi waqt kooch ka hukm diya ke chalo Allah ki barkat par khush ho jao. Rabb mujh se wa'da kar chuka hai ke do jama'aton mein se ek jama'at hamare hath lage gi Wallah mein to in logon ke girne ki jagah abhi yahin se goya apni aankhon dekh raha hoon.

Shama-e-Risalat ke jaan-nisaron ki duayein ek matlab to is ka yeh hai ke jaise tum ne maal-e-ghanimat mein ikhtilaf kiya aakhir Allah Ta'ala ne ise apne haath mein le liya aur apne Nabi ko is ki taqseem ka ikhtiyar de diya aur apne adl-o-insaf ke saath ise tum mein baant diya dar-haqiqat tumhare liye isi mein bhalayi thi isi tarah us ne bawajood tumhari is chahat ke ke Quraish ka tijarati qafila tumhein mil jaye aur jangi jama'at se muqabla na ho us ne tumhara muqabla baghair kisi waade ke ek pur-shikoh jama'at se kara diya aur tumhein is par ghalib kardiya ke Allah ki baat buland hojaye aur tumhein fatah, nusrat, ghalba aur shan-o-shaukat ata ho. Jaise farman hai ayat (Kutiba alaikumul qitalu wa huwa kurhul lakum ilakh), tum par jihad farz kiya gaya halanke tum ise bura jaante ho bahut mumkin hai ke ek cheez ko apne haq mein achhi na jaano aur dar-haqiqat wahi tumhare haq mein behtar ho aur haq mein woh badtar ho. Dar-asl haqaiq ka ilm Allah hi ko hai tum mahaz be-ilm ho. Dusra matlab yeh hai ke jaise momino ke ek giroh ki chahat ke khilaf tujhe tere Rab ne shehar se bahar ladayi ke liye nikala aur natija isi ka achha hua aise hi jo log jihad ke liye nikalna bojh samajh rahe hain dar-asl yahi un ke haq mein behtar hai. Is liye log baghair kisi khas tayyari ke jaise thay waise hi halke phulke nikal khare hue. Abu Sufyan bhi ghafil na tha us ne jasoos chhor rakhe thay aur aate jaaton se bhi daryaft-e-haal kar raha tha ek qafle se usay maloom hogaya ke Huzoor apne sathiyon ko le kar tere aur tere qafle ki taraf chal pare hain. Us ne Zaigham bin Amr Ghafari ko inaam de dila kar isi waqt Quraish-e-Makkah ke paas yeh paigham de kar rawana kiya ke tumhare maal khatre mein hain. Huzoor ma'a apne ashab ke is taraf aa rahe hain tumhein chahiye ke poori tayyari se fauran hamari madad ko aao us ne bahut jald wahan pahunch kar khabar di to Quraishiyon ne zabardast hamle ki tayyari karli aur nikal khare hue Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab Zafran waadi mein pahunche to Aap ko Quraish ke lashkaron ka saaz-o-saman se nikalna maloom hogaya. Aap ne Sahaba se mashwara liya aur yeh khabar bhi kardi. Hazrat Abu Bakr ne khare ho kar jawab diya aur bahut achha kaha. Phir Hazrat Umar khare hue aur Aap ne bhi maqool jawab diya. Phir Hazrat Miqdad khare hue aur kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah Ta'ala ka jo hukm ho usay anjam dijiye hum jaan-o-maal se Aap ke saath hain aur har tarah farmanbardar hain hum Bani Israel ki tarah nahin ke apne Nabi se keh dein ke Aap aur Aap ka Rab ja kar lar lo hum tamasha dekhte hain nahin balkay hamara yeh qaul hai ke Allah ki madad ke saath chaliye jung kijiye hum Aap ke saath hain us Allah ki qasam jis ne Aap ko Nabi-e-Barhaq bana kar bheja hai ke agar Aap Birk-e-Ghamad tak yaani Habsha ke mulk tak bhi chalein to hum saath se munh na morein ge aur wahan pahunchaye aur pahunche baghair kisi tarah na rahein ge Aap ne unhein bahut achha kaha aur un ko bari duaein dein lekin phir bhi yehi farmate rahe ke logo mujhe mashwara do meri baat ka jawab do is se murad Aap ki Ansariyon ke giroh se thi ek to is liye ke ginti mein yehi zyada thay. Doosre is liye bhi ke Aqba mein jab Ansar ne bai'at ki thi to is baat par ki thi ke jab Aap Makkah se nikal kar Madine mein pahunch jayein phir hum Aap ke saath hain jo bhi dushman Aap par charhai kar ke aaye hum us ke muqable mein seena-sipar ho jayein ge is mein chunke yeh wa'ada na tha ke khud Aap agar kisi par charh kar jayein to bhi hum Aap ka saath dein ge is liye Aap chahte thay ke ab un ka irada maloom karlein. Yeh samajh kar Hazrat Sa'ad bin Mu'az (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) khare hogaye aur arz kiya ke shayad Aap hum se jawab talab farma rahe hain? Aap ne farmaya haan yehi baat hai to Hazrat Sa'ad ne arz kiya Ya Rasool Allah hamara Aap par iman hai hum Aap ko sacha jaante hain aur jo kuch Aap laye hain usay bhi haq maante hain hum Aap ka farman sunne aur us par amal karne ki bai'at kar chuke hain.

Ae Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jo hukm Allah Ta'ala ka Aap ko hua hai usay poora kijiye, hum Aap ki ham-rikabi se na hatein ge. Us Allah ki qasam jis ne Aap ko apna sacha Rasool bana kar bheja hai ke agar samundar ke kinare par khare ho kar Aap us mein ghora daal dein to hum bhi bila-ta'ammul us mein kood parein ge hum mein se ek ko bhi Aap aisa na payein ge jisay zara sa bhi ta'ammul ho hum us par ba-khushi razamand hain ke Aap humein dushmano ke muqable par chhor dein. Hum laraiyon mein bahaduri karne wale museebat ke jheelne wale aur dushman ke dil par sikka jama dene wale hain Aap hamare kaam dekh kar Insha'Allah khush hon ge chaliye Allah ka naam le kar charhai kijiye Allah barkat de. Un ke is jawab se Aap bahut hi masroor hue usi waqt kooch ka hukm diya ke chalo Allah ki barkat par khush ho jao. Rabb mujh se wa'da kar chuka hai ke do jama'aton mein se ek jama'at hamare hath lage gi Wallah mein to in logon ke girne ki jagah abhi yahin se goya apni aankhon dekh raha hoon.

Sab se pehla ghazwa-e-Badr bunyad La Ilaha Illallah. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Badr wale din Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne as-haab ki taraf nazar dali, woh teen sau se kuch oopar thay, phir mushrikeen ko dekha, un ki tadaad ek hazaar se zyada thi. Isi waqt aap Qibla ki taraf mutawajja hue, chadar orhay hue thay aur tehband bandhay hue thay. Aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua mangna shuru ki ke Ilahi! Jo tera wada hai use ab poora farma. Ilahi! Jo wada tu ne mujh se kiya hai wahi kar. Ae Allah! Ahl-e-Islam ki yeh thori si jamaat agar halak ho jayegi to phir kabhi bhi teri tauheed ke sath zameen par ibadat na hogi. Yunhi aap dua aur faryad mein lagay rahay yahan tak ke chadar-e-mubarak kandhon par se utar gayi. Isi waqt Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) aagay barhay, aap ki chadar utha kar aap ke jism-e-mubarak par daal kar (peeche se aap ko apni bahon mein le kar) aap ko wahan se hatane lagay aur arz karne lagay ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Ab bas kijiye, aap ne apne Rab se jee bhar kar dua mang li, woh apne wade ko zaroor poora karega. Isi waqt yeh aayat utri.

Is ke baad mushrik aur musalman aapas mein larai mein gutham-gutha ho gaye. Allah Ta'ala ne mushrikon ko shikast di, un mein se sattar shakhs to qatl hue aur sattar qaid hue. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un qaydi kuffar ke baray mein Hazrat Abu Bakr, Hazrat Umar, Hazrat Ali (R.A) se mashwara kiya. Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ne to farmaya: Rasool Allah! Aakhir yeh hamaray kunbay baradari ke khwesh-o-aqarib hain. Aap in se fidiya le kar chor dijiye, maal hamain kaam aayega aur kya ajab ke Allah Ta'ala kal inhein hidayat de de aur yeh hamaray quwwat-o-bazu ban jayain. Ab aap ne Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) se daryaft kiya. Aap ne farmaya: Meri raye to is baray mein Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ki raye ke khilaf hai. Mere nazdeek to in mein se falan jo mera Quraishi rishtedar hai mujhe sonp dijiye ke main is ki gardan maroon aur Aqeel ko Hazrat Ali ke supurd kijiye ke woh is ka kaam tamam karain aur Hazrat Hamza (R.A) ke supurd un ka falan bhai kijiye ke woh isay saaf kar dain. Hum chahte hain ke Allah Ta'ala ke samne yeh zahir kar dain ke hamaray dil in mushrikon ki mohabbat se khali hain, Allah Rabbul Izzat ke naam par inhein chor chukay hain aur rishtedariyan in se tor chukay hain. Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Yeh log sardaran-e-kufr hain aur kafiron ke giroh hain. Inhein zinda chorna munasib nahin.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Abu Bakr (R.A) ka mashwara qabool kiya aur Hazrat Umar (R.A) ki baat ki taraf mail na hue. Hazrat Umar (R.A) farmatay hain ke doosre din subh hi se Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua to dekha ke aap aur Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ro rahay hain. Main ne poocha ke aakhir is ronay ka kya sabab hai? Agar koi aisa hi ba'is ho to main bhi sath doon warna takalluf se hi ronay lagoon kyunke aap dono buzurgon ko rota dekhta hoon. Aap ne farmaya: Yeh rona ba-wajah us azab ke hai jo tere sathiyon par fidiya le lene ke ba'is pesh hua.

Aap ne apne paas ke ek darakht ki taraf ishara kar ke farmaya dekho Allah ka azab is darakht tak pahunch chuka hai isi ka bayan aayat (Ma kana linabiyyin ay yakuna lahu asra hatta yuskhina fil-ard, turiduna aradad-dunya, wallahu yuridul-akhirah, wallahu Azizun Hakim) (Surah Al-Anfal: 67) se (Fakulu mimma ghanimtum halalan tayyiban, wattaqullah, innallaha Ghafurur-Rahim) (Surah Al-Anfal: 69) tak hai. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne maal-e-ghanimat halal farmaya phir agle saal jang-e-Uhud ke mauqa par fidiya lene ke badle un ki saza tay hui, sattar musalman sahaba shaheed hue, lashkar-e-Islam mein bhagdar mach gayi, An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne ke chaar daant shaheed hue, aap ke sar par jo khud tha woh toot gaya, chehra khoon-alooda ho gaya. Pas yeh aayat utri (Awa lamma asabatkum musibatun qad asabtum mislayha, qultum anna haza, qul huwa min indi anfusikum, innallaha ala kulli shayin Qadir) (Surah Al-Imran: 165), yani jab tumhein musibat pahunchi to kehne lage ke yeh kahan se aa gayi? Jawab de ke yeh khud tumhari apni taraf se hai. Tum is se pehle is se dugni rahat bhi to pa chuke ho, yaqeen mano ke Allah har cheez par Qadir hai, matlab yeh hai ke yeh fidiya lene ka badal hai, yeh hadith Muslim Sharif wagaira mein bhi hai. Ibn Abbas wagaira ka farman hai ke yeh aayat An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dua ke bare mein hai aur riwayat mein hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dua mein apna pura mubalagha kiya to Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne kaha ya Rasool Allah ab munajat khatam kijiye, Allah ki qasam Allah Ta'ala ne jo wada aap se kiya hai woh use zaroor pura karega. Is aayat ki tafsir mein Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) se marwi hai ke Hazrat Miqdad bin Aswad ne ek aisa kaam kiya ke agar main karta to mujhe apne aur tamam aamal se zyada pasandida hota. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab mushrikon par bad-dua kar rahe the to aap aaye aur kehne lage hum aap se woh nahin kahenge jo qaum-e-Musa (A.S) ne kaha tha ke khud apne Rab ko sath le kar ja aur lad bhid lo, balkeh hum jo kehte hain woh kar ke bhi dikhayenge, chaliye hum aap ke dayen bayen barabar kuffar se jihad karenge, aage peeche bhi hum hi hum nazar aayenge, main ne dekha ke un ke is qaul se Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khush ho gaye aur aap ka chehra mubarak chamakne laga. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke is dua ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh kehte hue tashreef laye ke anqareeb mushrikeen shikast khayenge aur peeth dikhayenge (Nasa'i wagaira). Irshad hua ke ek hazar farishton se tumhari imdad ki jayegi jo barabar ek dusre ke peeche silsila-war aayenge aur tumhari madad karenge, ek ke baad ek aata rahega. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain ke Hazrat Jibra'eel (A.S) ek hazar farishton ke sath An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke lashkar ke dayen hisse mein aaye the jis par kamaan Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ki thi aur bayen hisse par Hazrat Mika'eel (A.S) ek hazar farishton ki fauj ke sath utre the.

Is taraf meri kamaan thi, ek qira'at mein murdifin bhi hai. Mashhoor yeh hai ke in dono farishton ke saath paanch paanch sau farishtay thay jo bator-e-imdad aasman se ba-hukm-e-Ilahi utray thay. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka bayan hai ke ek musalman ek kafir par hamla karne ke liye uska ta'aqub kar raha tha ke achanak ek kora maangne ki aawaz aur saath hi ek ghudsawar ki aawaz aayi ke "Ae Khayroom aagay barh", wahin dekha ke woh mushrik chit gira hua hai, uska munh kore ke lagne se bigar gaya hai aur haddiyan pasliyan choor choor ho gayi hain. Is Ansari sahabi ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh waqia bayan kiya to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Tu sacha hai, yeh teri aasmani madad thi." Pas us din sattar kafir qatl hue aur sattar qaid hue. Imam Bukhari R.H ne baab bandha hai ke "Badr wale din farishton ka utarna", phir hadith laye hain ke Jibraeel A.S Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur poocha ke Badri sahaba ka darja aap mein kaisa samjha jata hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Aur musalmanon se bahut afzal." Hazrat Jibraeel A.S ne farmaya: "Is tarah Badr mein aane wale farishtay bhi aur farishton mein afzal gine jate hain." Bukhari aur Muslim mein hai ke jab Hazrat Umar R.A ne Hazrat Hatib bin Abu Balta'ah R.A ke qatl ka mashwara Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko diya to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Woh to Badri sahabi hain, tum nahin jante Allah Ta'ala ne Badriyon par nazar daali aur farmaya tum jo chahe karo, maine tumhein bakhsh diya." Phir farmata hai ke farishton ka bhejna aur tumhein is ki khushkhabri dena sirf tumhari khushi aur itminan-e-dil ke liye tha, warna Allah Ta'ala inko bheje baghair bhi is par qadir hai jis ki chahe madad kare aur use ghalib kar de. Baghair nusrat-e-Parwardigar ke koi fath pa nahin sakta, Allah hi ki taraf se madad hoti hai. Jaise farman hai aayat: (Fa-idha laqitumul-ladhina kafaroo fadarb ar-riqabi, hatta idha athkhantumuhum fashuddul-wathaqa, fa-imma mannan ba'du wa-imma fida'an hatta tada'al-harbu awzariha, dhalika, wa law yasha'ullahu lantasara minhum wa lakin liyabluwa ba'dakum bi-ba'din, walladhina qutiloo fi sabilillahi falan yudilla a'malahum) (47. Muhammad: 4). Kafiron se jab maidan ho to gardan marna hai, jab is mein kamyabi ho jaye to phir qaid karna hai. Is ke baad ya ehsan ke taur par chhor dena ya fidiya le lena hai, yahan tak ke larai mauqoof ho jaye. Yeh zahiri surat hai, agar Rabb chahe to aap hi in se badle le le lekin woh ek se ek ko aazma raha hai. Allah ki raah mein shaheed hone walon ke a'maal akaarat nahin jayenge. Inhein Allah Ta'ala raah dikhayega aur inhein khush-haal kar dega aur jaan pehchan ki jannat mein le jayega. Aur aayat mein hai: (Wa tilkal-ayyamu nudawiluha bainan-nasi, wa liya'lamallahul-ladhina aamanoo wa yattakhidha minkum shuhada'a, wallahu la yuhibbuz-zalimin) (3. Aali-Imran: 140).

(Aal-e-Imran: 140) Yeh din hum logon mein ghumate rehte hain taake Allah Ta'ala jaanch le aur shaheedon ko alag kar le zalimon se. Allah na-khush rehta hai, is mein imandaron ka imtiyaz ho jata hai aur yeh kuffar ke mitane ki surat hai. Jihad ka shar'i falsafa yahi hai ke Allah Ta'ala mushrikon ko muwahidon ke hathon saza deta hai. Is se pehle aam aasmani azabon se woh halak kar diye jate thay jaise Qaum-e-Nuh par toofan aaya, Aad wale aandhi mein tabah hue, Samudi cheekh se gharat kar diye gaye, Qaum-e-Lut par patthar bhi barse, zameen mein bhi dhansaye gaye aur un ki bastiyan ulat di gayin, Qaum-e-Shuaib par abr ka azab aaya. Phir Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ke zamane mein dushmanan-e-deen ma'a Firaun aur us ki qaum aur us ke lashkaron ke dobo diye gaye. Allah ne Taurat utari aur us ke baad se Allah ka hukm jari ho gaya jaise farman hai aayat (Wa laqad aatayna Musal-kitaba mim ba'di ma ahlaknal-qurunal-oola basaa'ira lin-nasi wa hudan wa rahmatal-la'allahum yatadhakkaroon) (28. Al-Qasas: 43). Pehli bastiyon ko halak karne ke baad hum ne Musa ko kitab di jo sochne samajhne ki baat thi. Phir se Allah Ta'ala ne musalmanon ke hathon kafiron ko saza dena shuru kar diya taake musalmanon ke dil saaf ho jayen aur kafiron ki zillat aur barh jaye jaise is ummat ko Allah Jalla Shanahu ka hukm hai aayat (Qatiloohum yu'adhdhibhumullahu bi-aydikum wa yukhzihim wa yansurkum 'alaihim wa yashfi sudoora qawmim-mu'mineen) (9. At-Tawbah: 14), Ae momino! In se jihad karo, Allah inhe tumhare hathon saza dega, inhe zaleel karega aur tumhein un par madad ata farma kar mominon ke seene saaf kar dega. Isi maidan-e-Badr mein ghamand-o-nakhwat ke putlon ka, kufr ke sardaron ka un musalmanon ke hath qatl hona jin par hamesha un ki nazrein zillat-o-haqarat ke sath parti rahin kuch kam na tha. Abu Jahl agar apne ghar mein Allah ke kisi azab se halak ho jata to is mein woh shaan na thi jo ma'arka-e-qital mein musalmanon ke hathon tukre hone mein hai. Jaise ke Abu Lahab ki maut isi tarah ki waqay hui thi ke Allah ke azab mein aisa sara ke maut ke baad kisi ne na to use nehlaya na dafnaya balkay door se pani daal kar logon ne patthar phenkne shuru kiye aur unhi mein woh dab gaya. Allah izzat wala hai, phir us ka Rasool aur imandar. Dunya-o-akhirat mein izzat aur bhalai in hi ke hisse ki cheez hai jaise irshad hai aayat (Inna lanansuru rusulana walladhina aamanoo fil-hayatid-dunya wa yawma yaqoomul-ash-haad) (40. Ghafir: 51), Hum zaroor-ba-zaroor apne rasoolon ki, imandar bandon ki is jahan mein aur us jahan mein madad farmayenge. Allah Hakeem hai, go woh qadir tha ke baghair tumhare lare bhare kuffar ko miliameet kar de lekin is mein bhi us ki hikmat hai jo woh tumhare hathon inhe dher kar raha hai.
