Pas Allah Ta'ala ne maal-e-ghanimat halal farmaya phir agle saal jang-e-Uhud ke mauqa par fidiya lene ke badle un ki saza tay hui, sattar musalman sahaba shaheed hue, lashkar-e-Islam mein bhagdar mach gayi, An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne ke chaar daant shaheed hue, aap ke sar par jo khud tha woh toot gaya, chehra khoon-alooda ho gaya. Pas yeh aayat utri (Awa lamma asabatkum musibatun qad asabtum mislayha, qultum anna haza, qul huwa min indi anfusikum, innallaha ala kulli shayin Qadir) (Surah Al-Imran: 165), yani jab tumhein musibat pahunchi to kehne lage ke yeh kahan se aa gayi? Jawab de ke yeh khud tumhari apni taraf se hai. Tum is se pehle is se dugni rahat bhi to pa chuke ho, yaqeen mano ke Allah har cheez par Qadir hai, matlab yeh hai ke yeh fidiya lene ka badal hai, yeh hadith Muslim Sharif wagaira mein bhi hai. Ibn Abbas wagaira ka farman hai ke yeh aayat An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dua ke bare mein hai aur riwayat mein hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dua mein apna pura mubalagha kiya to Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne kaha ya Rasool Allah ab munajat khatam kijiye, Allah ki qasam Allah Ta'ala ne jo wada aap se kiya hai woh use zaroor pura karega. Is aayat ki tafsir mein Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) se marwi hai ke Hazrat Miqdad bin Aswad ne ek aisa kaam kiya ke agar main karta to mujhe apne aur tamam aamal se zyada pasandida hota. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab mushrikon par bad-dua kar rahe the to aap aaye aur kehne lage hum aap se woh nahin kahenge jo qaum-e-Musa (A.S) ne kaha tha ke khud apne Rab ko sath le kar ja aur lad bhid lo, balkeh hum jo kehte hain woh kar ke bhi dikhayenge, chaliye hum aap ke dayen bayen barabar kuffar se jihad karenge, aage peeche bhi hum hi hum nazar aayenge, main ne dekha ke un ke is qaul se Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khush ho gaye aur aap ka chehra mubarak chamakne laga. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke is dua ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh kehte hue tashreef laye ke anqareeb mushrikeen shikast khayenge aur peeth dikhayenge (Nasa'i wagaira). Irshad hua ke ek hazar farishton se tumhari imdad ki jayegi jo barabar ek dusre ke peeche silsila-war aayenge aur tumhari madad karenge, ek ke baad ek aata rahega. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain ke Hazrat Jibra'eel (A.S) ek hazar farishton ke sath An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke lashkar ke dayen hisse mein aaye the jis par kamaan Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ki thi aur bayen hisse par Hazrat Mika'eel (A.S) ek hazar farishton ki fauj ke sath utre the.

Is taraf meri kamaan thi, ek qira'at mein murdifin bhi hai. Mashhoor yeh hai ke in dono farishton ke saath paanch paanch sau farishtay thay jo bator-e-imdad aasman se ba-hukm-e-Ilahi utray thay. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka bayan hai ke ek musalman ek kafir par hamla karne ke liye uska ta'aqub kar raha tha ke achanak ek kora maangne ki aawaz aur saath hi ek ghudsawar ki aawaz aayi ke "Ae Khayroom aagay barh", wahin dekha ke woh mushrik chit gira hua hai, uska munh kore ke lagne se bigar gaya hai aur haddiyan pasliyan choor choor ho gayi hain. Is Ansari sahabi ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh waqia bayan kiya to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Tu sacha hai, yeh teri aasmani madad thi." Pas us din sattar kafir qatl hue aur sattar qaid hue. Imam Bukhari R.H ne baab bandha hai ke "Badr wale din farishton ka utarna", phir hadith laye hain ke Jibraeel A.S Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur poocha ke Badri sahaba ka darja aap mein kaisa samjha jata hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Aur musalmanon se bahut afzal." Hazrat Jibraeel A.S ne farmaya: "Is tarah Badr mein aane wale farishtay bhi aur farishton mein afzal gine jate hain." Bukhari aur Muslim mein hai ke jab Hazrat Umar R.A ne Hazrat Hatib bin Abu Balta'ah R.A ke qatl ka mashwara Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko diya to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Woh to Badri sahabi hain, tum nahin jante Allah Ta'ala ne Badriyon par nazar daali aur farmaya tum jo chahe karo, maine tumhein bakhsh diya." Phir farmata hai ke farishton ka bhejna aur tumhein is ki khushkhabri dena sirf tumhari khushi aur itminan-e-dil ke liye tha, warna Allah Ta'ala inko bheje baghair bhi is par qadir hai jis ki chahe madad kare aur use ghalib kar de. Baghair nusrat-e-Parwardigar ke koi fath pa nahin sakta, Allah hi ki taraf se madad hoti hai. Jaise farman hai aayat: (Fa-idha laqitumul-ladhina kafaroo fadarb ar-riqabi, hatta idha athkhantumuhum fashuddul-wathaqa, fa-imma mannan ba'du wa-imma fida'an hatta tada'al-harbu awzariha, dhalika, wa law yasha'ullahu lantasara minhum wa lakin liyabluwa ba'dakum bi-ba'din, walladhina qutiloo fi sabilillahi falan yudilla a'malahum) (47. Muhammad: 4). Kafiron se jab maidan ho to gardan marna hai, jab is mein kamyabi ho jaye to phir qaid karna hai. Is ke baad ya ehsan ke taur par chhor dena ya fidiya le lena hai, yahan tak ke larai mauqoof ho jaye. Yeh zahiri surat hai, agar Rabb chahe to aap hi in se badle le le lekin woh ek se ek ko aazma raha hai. Allah ki raah mein shaheed hone walon ke a'maal akaarat nahin jayenge. Inhein Allah Ta'ala raah dikhayega aur inhein khush-haal kar dega aur jaan pehchan ki jannat mein le jayega. Aur aayat mein hai: (Wa tilkal-ayyamu nudawiluha bainan-nasi, wa liya'lamallahul-ladhina aamanoo wa yattakhidha minkum shuhada'a, wallahu la yuhibbuz-zalimin) (3. Aali-Imran: 140).

(Aal-e-Imran: 140) Yeh din hum logon mein ghumate rehte hain taake Allah Ta'ala jaanch le aur shaheedon ko alag kar le zalimon se. Allah na-khush rehta hai, is mein imandaron ka imtiyaz ho jata hai aur yeh kuffar ke mitane ki surat hai. Jihad ka shar'i falsafa yahi hai ke Allah Ta'ala mushrikon ko muwahidon ke hathon saza deta hai. Is se pehle aam aasmani azabon se woh halak kar diye jate thay jaise Qaum-e-Nuh par toofan aaya, Aad wale aandhi mein tabah hue, Samudi cheekh se gharat kar diye gaye, Qaum-e-Lut par patthar bhi barse, zameen mein bhi dhansaye gaye aur un ki bastiyan ulat di gayin, Qaum-e-Shuaib par abr ka azab aaya. Phir Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ke zamane mein dushmanan-e-deen ma'a Firaun aur us ki qaum aur us ke lashkaron ke dobo diye gaye. Allah ne Taurat utari aur us ke baad se Allah ka hukm jari ho gaya jaise farman hai aayat (Wa laqad aatayna Musal-kitaba mim ba'di ma ahlaknal-qurunal-oola basaa'ira lin-nasi wa hudan wa rahmatal-la'allahum yatadhakkaroon) (28. Al-Qasas: 43). Pehli bastiyon ko halak karne ke baad hum ne Musa ko kitab di jo sochne samajhne ki baat thi. Phir se Allah Ta'ala ne musalmanon ke hathon kafiron ko saza dena shuru kar diya taake musalmanon ke dil saaf ho jayen aur kafiron ki zillat aur barh jaye jaise is ummat ko Allah Jalla Shanahu ka hukm hai aayat (Qatiloohum yu'adhdhibhumullahu bi-aydikum wa yukhzihim wa yansurkum 'alaihim wa yashfi sudoora qawmim-mu'mineen) (9. At-Tawbah: 14), Ae momino! In se jihad karo, Allah inhe tumhare hathon saza dega, inhe zaleel karega aur tumhein un par madad ata farma kar mominon ke seene saaf kar dega. Isi maidan-e-Badr mein ghamand-o-nakhwat ke putlon ka, kufr ke sardaron ka un musalmanon ke hath qatl hona jin par hamesha un ki nazrein zillat-o-haqarat ke sath parti rahin kuch kam na tha. Abu Jahl agar apne ghar mein Allah ke kisi azab se halak ho jata to is mein woh shaan na thi jo ma'arka-e-qital mein musalmanon ke hathon tukre hone mein hai. Jaise ke Abu Lahab ki maut isi tarah ki waqay hui thi ke Allah ke azab mein aisa sara ke maut ke baad kisi ne na to use nehlaya na dafnaya balkay door se pani daal kar logon ne patthar phenkne shuru kiye aur unhi mein woh dab gaya. Allah izzat wala hai, phir us ka Rasool aur imandar. Dunya-o-akhirat mein izzat aur bhalai in hi ke hisse ki cheez hai jaise irshad hai aayat (Inna lanansuru rusulana walladhina aamanoo fil-hayatid-dunya wa yawma yaqoomul-ash-haad) (40. Ghafir: 51), Hum zaroor-ba-zaroor apne rasoolon ki, imandar bandon ki is jahan mein aur us jahan mein madad farmayenge. Allah Hakeem hai, go woh qadir tha ke baghair tumhare lare bhare kuffar ko miliameet kar de lekin is mein bhi us ki hikmat hai jo woh tumhare hathon inhe dher kar raha hai.

Ta'eed-e-Ilahi ke baad fath-o-kamrani. Allah Ta'ala apne ehsanat bayan farmata hai ke is Jang-e-Badr mein jabke apni kami aur kafiron ki ziyadati, apni besaro-samani aur kafiron ke pur-shaukat sar-o-saman dekh kar musalmanon ke dilon par bura asar pad raha tha, Parwardigar ne unke dilon ke itminan ke liye un par oongh daal di. Jang-e-Uhud mein bhi yahi haal hua tha jaise farman hai aayat (Thumma anzala alaikum min ba'dil ghammi amanatan nu'asan yaghsha ta'ifatan minkum wa ta'ifatun qad ahammathum anfusuhum yazunnoona billahi ghairal haqqi zannal jahiliyyati yaqooloona hal lana minal amri min shai'in qul innal amra kullahu lillahi yukhfoona fee anfusihim ma la yubdoona laka yaqooloona lau kana lana minal amri shai'un ma qutilna hahuna qul lau kuntum fee buyootikum labarazallazeena kutiba alaihimul qatlu ila madaji'ihim waliyabtaliyal lahu ma fee sudoorikum waliyumahhis ma fee quloobikum wallahu aleemun bizatis sudoor) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 154), yani poore gham-o-ranj ke baad Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein aman diya jo oongh ki soorat mein tumhein dhanke hue tha, ek jama'at isi mein mashghool thi. Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) ka bayan hai ke main bhi un logon mein se tha jin par Uhud wale din oongh ghalib aa gayi thi, us waqt main neend mein jhoom raha tha, meri talwar mere haath se gir padti thi aur main uthata tha, main ne jab nazar dali to dekha ke log dhalen saron par rakhe hue neend ke jhoole le rahe hain. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka bayan hai ke Badr wale din hamare poore lashkar mein ghudsawar sirf ek hi Hazrat Miqdad (R.A) the, main ne nigah bhar kar dekha ke sara lashkar neend mein mast hai, sirf Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jaag rahe the, aap ek darakht tale namaz mein mashghool the, rote jaate the aur namaz padhte jaate the, subah tak aap isi tarah munajat mein mashghool rahe. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain ke maidan-e-jang mein oongh ka aana Allah ki taraf se aman ka milna hai aur namaz mein oongh ka aana shaitani harkat hai, oongh sirf aankhon mein hi hoti hai aur neend ka ta'alluq dil se hai. Yeh yaad rahe ke oongh aane ka mashhoor waqia to Jang-e-Uhud ka hai lekin is aayat mein jo Badr ke waqia ke qisse ke bayan mein oongh ka utarna maujood hai, pas sakht ladai ke waqt yeh waqia hua aur mominon ke dil Allah ke ata karda aman se mutma'in ho gaye, yeh bhi mominon par Allah ka fazl-o-karam aur uska lutf-o-reham tha, sach hai sakhti ke baad aasani hai. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ke saath Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek chhappar tale dua mein mashghool the jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) oonghne lage.

Thori der mein jaage aur tabassum farma kar Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar se farmaya khush ho yeh hain Jibraeel (A.S) gard-aalood phir aayat-e-Qurani (Sayuhzamul jam'u wa yuwallunad dubur) parhte hue jhonpri ke darwaze se bahar tashreef laye. Ya'ni abhi abhi yeh lashkar shikast khaye ga aur peeth pher kar bhage ga. Dusra ehsan is jang ke mauqa par yeh hua ke barish baras gayi. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke mushrikon ne maidan-e-Badr ke pani par qabza kar liya tha, musalmanon ke aur pani ke darmiyan woh hail ho gaye the, musalman kamzori ki halat mein the, shaitan ne unke dilon mein waswasa dalna shuru kiya ke tum toh apne tayein Allah wale samajhte ho aur Allah ke Rasool ko apne mein maujood mante ho aur halat yeh hai ke pani tak tumhare qabze mein nahin, mushrikeen ke hath mein pani hai, tum namaz bhi junubi hone ki halat mein parh rahe ho. Aise waqt aasman se meenh barasna shuru hua aur pani ki rail-pel ho gayi. Musalmanon ne pani piya bhi, pilaya bhi, naha dho kar paki bhi hasil kar li aur pani bhar bhi liya aur shaitani waswasa bhi zail ho gaya aur jo chikni mitti pani ke raste mein thi dhul kar wahan ki sakht zameen nikal aayi aur ret jam gayi ke us par aamad-o-raft aasan ho gayi aur farishton ki imdad aasman se aa gayi, paanch sau farishte toh Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ki ma-tahti mein aur paanch sau Hazrat Mikaeel (A.S) ki ma-tahti mein. Mashhoor yeh hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab Badr ki taraf tashreef le chale toh sab se pehle jo pani tha wahan thehre. Hazrat Hubab bin Munzir (R.A) ne Aap (ﷺ) se arz kiya ke agar Aap ko Allah ka hukm yahan parao karne ka hua tab toh khair aur agar jangi maslahat ke sath parao yahan kiya ho toh Aap aur aage chaliye, aakhri pani par qabza kijiye, wahin hauz bana kar yahan ke sab pani wahan jama kar lein toh pani par hamara qabza rahe ga aur dushman pani baghair reh jaye ga aur Aap (ﷺ) ne yahi kiya bhi. Maghazi-e-Umawi mein hai ke is raye ke baad Jibraeel (A.S) ki maujudgi mein ek farishte ne aa kar Aap (ﷺ) ko salam pahunchaya aur Allah ka hukm bhi ke yahi raye theek hai. Aap (ﷺ) ne us waqt Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) se pucha ke aap inhe jante hain? Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ne farmaya main aasman ke tamam farishton se waqif nahin hoon, haan hain yeh farishte shaitan nahin. Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein hai ke mushrikeen dhalwan ki taraf the aur musalman unchai ki taraf the, barish hone se musalmanon ki taraf toh zameen dhul kar saaf ho gayi aur pani se unhein nafa pahuncha lekin mushrikeen ki taraf pani khara ho gaya. Keechar aur phisalan ho gayi ke unhein chalna phirna do-bhar ho gaya. Barish is se pehle hui thi, ghubar jam gaya tha, zameen sakht ho gayi thi, dilon mein khushi paida ho gayi thi, sabit qadmi mayassar ho chuki thi, ab oongh aane lagi aur musalman taza-dam ho gaye. Subah larai hone wali hai, raat ko halki si barish ho gayi, hum darakhton tale ja chhupe, Huzoor (ﷺ) musalmanon ko jihad ki raghbat dilate rahe.

Yeh is liye ke Allah tumhein paak kar de, wuzu bhi kar lo aur ghusl bhi. Is zahiri paaki ke saath hi baatini pakeezgi bhi hasil hui, shaitani waswasay bhi door ho gaye, dil mutma'in ho gaye. Jaise ke jannatiyon ke baare mein farman hai ke, (Aali-him thiyabu sundusin khudrun) (76:21), un ke badan par hareem aur motay reshmi kapray honge aur unhein chandi ke kangan pehnaye jayenge aur unhein un ka Rabb paak aur paak karne wala sharbat pilaye ga. Pas libas aur zevar toh zahiri zeenat ki cheez hui aur paak karne wala pani jis se dilon ki pakeezgi aur hasad-o-bughz ki doori ho jaye. Yeh thi baatini zeenat. Phir farmata hai ke is se maqsood dilon ki mazbooti bhi thi ke sabr-o-bardasht paida ho, shuja'at-o-bahaduri ho, dil barh jaye, sabit qadmi zahir ho jaye aur hamlay mein istiqamat paida ho jaye, Wallahu A'lam. Phir apni ek baatini ne'mat ka izhar farma raha hai taake musalman is par bhi Allah ka shukr baja layein ke Allah Ta'ala Tabarak-o-Taqaddus-o-Tamajjud ne farishton ko hukum diya ke tum jao musalmanon ki madad-o-nusrat karo, un ke saath mil kar hamare dushmanon ko neecha dikhao. Un ki ginti ghatao aur hamare doston ki tadaad barhao. Kaha gaya hai ke farishta kisi musalman ke paas aata aur kehta ke mushrikon mein ajeeb baddili phaili hui hai. Woh toh keh rahe hain ke agar musalmanon ne hamla kar diya toh hamare qadam nahin tik sakte, hum toh bhaag kharay honge. Ab har ek dusre se kehta, dusra teesre se, phir Sahaba ke dil barh jate aur samajh lete ke mushrikon mein taqat-o-quwwat nahin. Phir farmata hai ke tum ae farishton is kaam mein lago, udhar main mushrikon ke dilon mein musalmanon ki dhaak bitha doon ga, main un ke dilon mein zillat aur haqarat daal doon ga, mere hukum ke na manne walon ka, mere Rasool ke munkiron ka yahi haal hota hai. Phir tum un ke saron par waar laga kar dimagh nikal do, gardanon par talwar maar ke sar aur dhar mein judai kar do. Haath paon aur jor-jor, poor-poor ko taak-taak kar zakhm lagao. Pas gardanon ke upar se ba'az ke nazdeek murad toh sar hain aur ba'az ke nazdeek khud gardan murad hai, chunancha aur jagah hai, (Fadribu-r-riqab) (47:4) gardanein maaro. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain main qudrati azabon se logon ko halak karne ke liye nahin bheja gaya, balkay gardan maarne aur qaid karne ke liye bheja gaya hoon. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) farmate hain ke gardan par aur sar par waar karne ka istidlal is se ho sakta hai. Maghazi-e-Umawi mein hai ke maqtooleen-e-Badr ke paas se jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) guzray toh ek sher ka ibtidai tukra aap ne parh diya, Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne poora sher parh diya. Aap ko na sher yaad thay na aap ke laiq. Is sher ka matlab yahi hai ke jo log zalim aur baghi thay aur aaj tak ghalbay aur shaukat se thay, aaj un ke sar tootay hue aur un ke dimagh bikhray hue hain. Kehte hain ke jo mushrik log farishton ke haath qatl hue thay unhein musalman is tarah pehchan lete thay ke un ki gardanon ke upar aur haath pairon ke jor aisay zakhm zada thay jaise aag se jalay honay ke nishanat. Banan jama hai banantah ki.

Arabi sheron mein 'banan' ka istemaal majood hai pas har jor aur har hissay ko banan kehte hain. Auza'i R.H kehte hain munh par aankh par aag ke koray barsao haan jab unhein giraftar karlo phir na marna. Abu Jahl maloon ne kaha tha ke jahan tak ho sakay musalmanon ko zinda giraftar karlo taake hum unhein is baat ka maza zyada der tak chakhayen ke woh hamaray deen ko bura kehte thay, hamaray deen se hat gaye thay, Laat-o-Uzza ki parastish chor bethay thay. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne musalmanon aur farishton ko yeh hukum diya. Chunancha jo sattar aadmi un kafiron ke qatl huay un mein ek yeh paaji bhi tha aur jo sattar aadmi qaid huay un mein ek Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait bhi tha la'anahu Allah Ta'ala, us ko qaid mein hi qatl kiya gaya aur us samet maqtooleen mushrikeen ki tadaad sattar hi thi. Allah Ta'ala aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ) ki mukhalifat ka natija aur badla yeh hai. Shiqaq makhooz hai 'shaq' se. Shaq kehte hain phaarne cheerne aur do tukray karne ko. Pas un logon ne goya shariyat, imaan aur farman-bardari ko ek taraf kiya aur dusri janib khud rahay. Lakri ke phaarne ko bhi Arab yahi kehte hain jabke lakri ke do tukray kardein. Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke khilaf chal kar koi bach nahin saka. Kaun hai jo Allah se chup jaye? Aur us ke be-panah aur sakht azabon se bach jaye? Na koi us ke muqablay ka na kisi ko us ke azabon ki taqat na us se koi bach niklay. Na us ka ghazab koi seh sakay. Woh buland-o-bala woh ghalib aur inteqam wala hai. Us ke siwa koi mabood aur Rab nahin. Woh apni zaat mein, apni sifaton mein yakta aur la-shareek hai. Aye kafiro! Dunya ke yeh azab uthao aur abhi aakhirat mein dozakh ka azab baqi hai.

Ta'eed-e-Ilahi ke baad fath-o-kamrani. Allah Ta'ala apne ehsanat bayan farmata hai ke is Jang-e-Badr mein jabke apni kami aur kafiron ki ziyadati, apni besaro-samani aur kafiron ke pur-shaukat sar-o-saman dekh kar musalmanon ke dilon par bura asar pad raha tha, Parwardigar ne unke dilon ke itminan ke liye un par oongh daal di. Jang-e-Uhud mein bhi yahi haal hua tha jaise farman hai aayat (Thumma anzala alaikum min ba'dil ghammi amanatan nu'asan yaghsha ta'ifatan minkum wa ta'ifatun qad ahammathum anfusuhum yazunnoona billahi ghairal haqqi zannal jahiliyyati yaqooloona hal lana minal amri min shai'in qul innal amra kullahu lillahi yukhfoona fee anfusihim ma la yubdoona laka yaqooloona lau kana lana minal amri shai'un ma qutilna hahuna qul lau kuntum fee buyootikum labarazallazeena kutiba alaihimul qatlu ila madaji'ihim waliyabtaliyal lahu ma fee sudoorikum waliyumahhis ma fee quloobikum wallahu aleemun bizatis sudoor) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 154), yani poore gham-o-ranj ke baad Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein aman diya jo oongh ki soorat mein tumhein dhanke hue tha, ek jama'at isi mein mashghool thi. Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) ka bayan hai ke main bhi un logon mein se tha jin par Uhud wale din oongh ghalib aa gayi thi, us waqt main neend mein jhoom raha tha, meri talwar mere haath se gir padti thi aur main uthata tha, main ne jab nazar dali to dekha ke log dhalen saron par rakhe hue neend ke jhoole le rahe hain. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka bayan hai ke Badr wale din hamare poore lashkar mein ghudsawar sirf ek hi Hazrat Miqdad (R.A) the, main ne nigah bhar kar dekha ke sara lashkar neend mein mast hai, sirf Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jaag rahe the, aap ek darakht tale namaz mein mashghool the, rote jaate the aur namaz padhte jaate the, subah tak aap isi tarah munajat mein mashghool rahe. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain ke maidan-e-jang mein oongh ka aana Allah ki taraf se aman ka milna hai aur namaz mein oongh ka aana shaitani harkat hai, oongh sirf aankhon mein hi hoti hai aur neend ka ta'alluq dil se hai. Yeh yaad rahe ke oongh aane ka mashhoor waqia to Jang-e-Uhud ka hai lekin is aayat mein jo Badr ke waqia ke qisse ke bayan mein oongh ka utarna maujood hai, pas sakht ladai ke waqt yeh waqia hua aur mominon ke dil Allah ke ata karda aman se mutma'in ho gaye, yeh bhi mominon par Allah ka fazl-o-karam aur uska lutf-o-reham tha, sach hai sakhti ke baad aasani hai. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ke saath Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek chhappar tale dua mein mashghool the jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) oonghne lage.

Thori der mein jaage aur tabassum farma kar Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar se farmaya khush ho yeh hain Jibraeel (A.S) gard-aalood phir aayat-e-Qurani (Sayuhzamul jam'u wa yuwallunad dubur) parhte hue jhonpri ke darwaze se bahar tashreef laye. Ya'ni abhi abhi yeh lashkar shikast khaye ga aur peeth pher kar bhage ga. Dusra ehsan is jang ke mauqa par yeh hua ke barish baras gayi. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke mushrikon ne maidan-e-Badr ke pani par qabza kar liya tha, musalmanon ke aur pani ke darmiyan woh hail ho gaye the, musalman kamzori ki halat mein the, shaitan ne unke dilon mein waswasa dalna shuru kiya ke tum toh apne tayein Allah wale samajhte ho aur Allah ke Rasool ko apne mein maujood mante ho aur halat yeh hai ke pani tak tumhare qabze mein nahin, mushrikeen ke hath mein pani hai, tum namaz bhi junubi hone ki halat mein parh rahe ho. Aise waqt aasman se meenh barasna shuru hua aur pani ki rail-pel ho gayi. Musalmanon ne pani piya bhi, pilaya bhi, naha dho kar paki bhi hasil kar li aur pani bhar bhi liya aur shaitani waswasa bhi zail ho gaya aur jo chikni mitti pani ke raste mein thi dhul kar wahan ki sakht zameen nikal aayi aur ret jam gayi ke us par aamad-o-raft aasan ho gayi aur farishton ki imdad aasman se aa gayi, paanch sau farishte toh Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ki ma-tahti mein aur paanch sau Hazrat Mikaeel (A.S) ki ma-tahti mein. Mashhoor yeh hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab Badr ki taraf tashreef le chale toh sab se pehle jo pani tha wahan thehre. Hazrat Hubab bin Munzir (R.A) ne Aap (ﷺ) se arz kiya ke agar Aap ko Allah ka hukm yahan parao karne ka hua tab toh khair aur agar jangi maslahat ke sath parao yahan kiya ho toh Aap aur aage chaliye, aakhri pani par qabza kijiye, wahin hauz bana kar yahan ke sab pani wahan jama kar lein toh pani par hamara qabza rahe ga aur dushman pani baghair reh jaye ga aur Aap (ﷺ) ne yahi kiya bhi. Maghazi-e-Umawi mein hai ke is raye ke baad Jibraeel (A.S) ki maujudgi mein ek farishte ne aa kar Aap (ﷺ) ko salam pahunchaya aur Allah ka hukm bhi ke yahi raye theek hai. Aap (ﷺ) ne us waqt Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) se pucha ke aap inhe jante hain? Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ne farmaya main aasman ke tamam farishton se waqif nahin hoon, haan hain yeh farishte shaitan nahin. Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein hai ke mushrikeen dhalwan ki taraf the aur musalman unchai ki taraf the, barish hone se musalmanon ki taraf toh zameen dhul kar saaf ho gayi aur pani se unhein nafa pahuncha lekin mushrikeen ki taraf pani khara ho gaya. Keechar aur phisalan ho gayi ke unhein chalna phirna do-bhar ho gaya. Barish is se pehle hui thi, ghubar jam gaya tha, zameen sakht ho gayi thi, dilon mein khushi paida ho gayi thi, sabit qadmi mayassar ho chuki thi, ab oongh aane lagi aur musalman taza-dam ho gaye. Subah larai hone wali hai, raat ko halki si barish ho gayi, hum darakhton tale ja chhupe, Huzoor (ﷺ) musalmanon ko jihad ki raghbat dilate rahe.

Yeh is liye ke Allah tumhein paak kar de, wuzu bhi kar lo aur ghusl bhi. Is zahiri paaki ke saath hi baatini pakeezgi bhi hasil hui, shaitani waswasay bhi door ho gaye, dil mutma'in ho gaye. Jaise ke jannatiyon ke baare mein farman hai ke, (Aali-him thiyabu sundusin khudrun) (76:21), un ke badan par hareem aur motay reshmi kapray honge aur unhein chandi ke kangan pehnaye jayenge aur unhein un ka Rabb paak aur paak karne wala sharbat pilaye ga. Un ki ginti ghatao aur hamare doston ki tadaad barhao. Kaha gaya hai ke farishta kisi musalman ke paas aata aur kehta ke mushrikon mein ajeeb baddili phaili hui hai. Woh toh keh rahe hain ke agar musalmanon ne hamla kar diya toh hamare qadam nahin tik sakte, hum toh bhaag kharay honge. Ab har ek dusre se kehta, dusra teesre se, phir Sahaba ke dil barh jate aur samajh lete ke mushrikon mein taqat-o-quwwat nahin. Phir farmata hai ke tum ae farishton is kaam mein lago, udhar main mushrikon ke dilon mein musalmanon ki dhaak bitha doon ga, main un ke dilon mein zillat aur haqarat daal doon ga, mere hukum ke na manne walon ka, mere Rasool ke munkiron ka yahi haal hota hai. Us ke siwa koi mabood aur Rab nahin. Woh apni zaat mein, apni sifaton mein yakta aur la-shareek hai. Aye kafiro! Dunya ke yeh azab uthao aur abhi aakhirat mein dozakh ka azab baqi hai.

Ta'eed-e-Ilahi ke baad fath-o-kamrani. Allah Ta'ala apne ehsanat bayan farmata hai ke is Jang-e-Badr mein jabke apni kami aur kafiron ki ziyadati, apni besaro-samani aur kafiron ke pur-shaukat sar-o-saman dekh kar musalmanon ke dilon par bura asar pad raha tha, Parwardigar ne unke dilon ke itminan ke liye un par oongh daal di. Jang-e-Uhud mein bhi yahi haal hua tha jaise farman hai aayat (Thumma anzala alaikum min ba'dil ghammi amanatan nu'asan yaghsha ta'ifatan minkum wa ta'ifatun qad ahammathum anfusuhum yazunnoona billahi ghairal haqqi zannal jahiliyyati yaqooloona hal lana minal amri min shai'in qul innal amra kullahu lillahi yukhfoona fee anfusihim ma la yubdoona laka yaqooloona lau kana lana minal amri shai'un ma qutilna hahuna qul lau kuntum fee buyootikum labarazallazeena kutiba alaihimul qatlu ila madaji'ihim waliyabtaliyal lahu ma fee sudoorikum waliyumahhis ma fee quloobikum wallahu aleemun bizatis sudoor) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 154), yani poore gham-o-ranj ke baad Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein aman diya jo oongh ki soorat mein tumhein dhanke hue tha, ek jama'at isi mein mashghool thi. Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) ka bayan hai ke main bhi un logon mein se tha jin par Uhud wale din oongh ghalib aa gayi thi, us waqt main neend mein jhoom raha tha, meri talwar mere haath se gir padti thi aur main uthata tha, main ne jab nazar dali to dekha ke log dhalen saron par rakhe hue neend ke jhoole le rahe hain. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka bayan hai ke Badr wale din hamare poore lashkar mein ghudsawar sirf ek hi Hazrat Miqdad (R.A) the, main ne nigah bhar kar dekha ke sara lashkar neend mein mast hai, sirf Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jaag rahe the, aap ek darakht tale namaz mein mashghool the, rote jaate the aur namaz padhte jaate the, subah tak aap isi tarah munajat mein mashghool rahe. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain ke maidan-e-jang mein oongh ka aana Allah ki taraf se aman ka milna hai aur namaz mein oongh ka aana shaitani harkat hai, oongh sirf aankhon mein hi hoti hai aur neend ka ta'alluq dil se hai. Yeh yaad rahe ke oongh aane ka mashhoor waqia to Jang-e-Uhud ka hai lekin is aayat mein jo Badr ke waqia ke qisse ke bayan mein oongh ka utarna maujood hai, pas sakht ladai ke waqt yeh waqia hua aur mominon ke dil Allah ke ata karda aman se mutma'in ho gaye, yeh bhi mominon par Allah ka fazl-o-karam aur uska lutf-o-reham tha, sach hai sakhti ke baad aasani hai. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ke saath Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek chhappar tale dua mein mashghool the jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) oonghne lage.

Thori der mein jaage aur tabassum farma kar Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar se farmaya khush ho yeh hain Jibraeel (A.S) gard-aalood phir aayat-e-Qurani (Sayuhzamul jam'u wa yuwallunad dubur) parhte hue jhonpri ke darwaze se bahar tashreef laye. Ya'ni abhi abhi yeh lashkar shikast khaye ga aur peeth pher kar bhage ga. Dusra ehsan is jang ke mauqa par yeh hua ke barish baras gayi. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke mushrikon ne maidan-e-Badr ke pani par qabza kar liya tha, musalmanon ke aur pani ke darmiyan woh hail ho gaye the, musalman kamzori ki halat mein the, shaitan ne unke dilon mein waswasa dalna shuru kiya ke tum toh apne tayein Allah wale samajhte ho aur Allah ke Rasool ko apne mein maujood mante ho aur halat yeh hai ke pani tak tumhare qabze mein nahin, mushrikeen ke hath mein pani hai, tum namaz bhi junubi hone ki halat mein parh rahe ho. Aise waqt aasman se meenh barasna shuru hua aur pani ki rail-pel ho gayi. Musalmanon ne pani piya bhi, pilaya bhi, naha dho kar paki bhi hasil kar li aur pani bhar bhi liya aur shaitani waswasa bhi zail ho gaya aur jo chikni mitti pani ke raste mein thi dhul kar wahan ki sakht zameen nikal aayi aur ret jam gayi ke us par aamad-o-raft aasan ho gayi aur farishton ki imdad aasman se aa gayi, paanch sau farishte toh Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ki ma-tahti mein aur paanch sau Hazrat Mikaeel (A.S) ki ma-tahti mein. Mashhoor yeh hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab Badr ki taraf tashreef le chale toh sab se pehle jo pani tha wahan thehre. Hazrat Hubab bin Munzir (R.A) ne Aap (ﷺ) se arz kiya ke agar Aap ko Allah ka hukm yahan parao karne ka hua tab toh khair aur agar jangi maslahat ke sath parao yahan kiya ho toh Aap aur aage chaliye, aakhri pani par qabza kijiye, wahin hauz bana kar yahan ke sab pani wahan jama kar lein toh pani par hamara qabza rahe ga aur dushman pani baghair reh jaye ga aur Aap (ﷺ) ne yahi kiya bhi. Maghazi-e-Umawi mein hai ke is raye ke baad Jibraeel (A.S) ki maujudgi mein ek farishte ne aa kar Aap (ﷺ) ko salam pahunchaya aur Allah ka hukm bhi ke yahi raye theek hai. Aap (ﷺ) ne us waqt Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) se pucha ke aap inhe jante hain? Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ne farmaya main aasman ke tamam farishton se waqif nahin hoon, haan hain yeh farishte shaitan nahin. Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein hai ke mushrikeen dhalwan ki taraf the aur musalman unchai ki taraf the, barish hone se musalmanon ki taraf toh zameen dhul kar saaf ho gayi aur pani se unhein nafa pahuncha lekin mushrikeen ki taraf pani khara ho gaya. Keechar aur phisalan ho gayi ke unhein chalna phirna do-bhar ho gaya. Barish is se pehle hui thi, ghubar jam gaya tha, zameen sakht ho gayi thi, dilon mein khushi paida ho gayi thi, sabit qadmi mayassar ho chuki thi, ab oongh aane lagi aur musalman taza-dam ho gaye. Subah larai hone wali hai, raat ko halki si barish ho gayi, hum darakhton tale ja chhupe, Huzoor (ﷺ) musalmanon ko jihad ki raghbat dilate rahe.

Yeh is liye ke Allah tumhein paak kar de, wuzu bhi kar lo aur ghusl bhi. Is zahiri paaki ke saath hi baatini pakeezgi bhi hasil hui, shaitani waswasay bhi door ho gaye, dil mutma'in ho gaye. Jaise ke jannatiyon ke baare mein farman hai ke, (Aali-him thiyabu sundusin khudrun) (76:21), un ke badan par hareem aur motay reshmi kapray honge aur unhein chandi ke kangan pehnaye jayenge aur unhein un ka Rabb paak aur paak karne wala sharbat pilaye ga. Pas libas aur zevar toh zahiri zeenat ki cheez hui aur paak karne wala pani jis se dilon ki pakeezgi aur hasad-o-bughz ki doori ho jaye. Yeh thi baatini zeenat. Phir farmata hai ke is se maqsood dilon ki mazbooti bhi thi ke sabr-o-bardasht paida ho, shuja'at-o-bahaduri ho, dil barh jaye, sabit qadmi zahir ho jaye aur hamlay mein istiqamat paida ho jaye, Wallahu A'lam. Phir apni ek baatini ne'mat ka izhar farma raha hai taake musalman is par bhi Allah ka shukr baja layein ke Allah Ta'ala Tabarak-o-Taqaddus-o-Tamajjud ne farishton ko hukum diya ke tum jao musalmanon ki madad-o-nusrat karo, un ke saath mil kar hamare dushmanon ko neecha dikhao. Un ki ginti ghatao aur hamare doston ki tadaad barhao. Kaha gaya hai ke farishta kisi musalman ke paas aata aur kehta ke mushrikon mein ajeeb baddili phaili hui hai. Woh toh keh rahe hain ke agar musalmanon ne hamla kar diya toh hamare qadam nahin tik sakte, hum toh bhaag kharay honge. Ab har ek dusre se kehta, dusra teesre se, phir Sahaba ke dil barh jate aur samajh lete ke mushrikon mein taqat-o-quwwat nahin. Phir farmata hai ke tum ae farishton is kaam mein lago, udhar main mushrikon ke dilon mein musalmanon ki dhaak bitha doon ga, main un ke dilon mein zillat aur haqarat daal doon ga, mere hukum ke na manne walon ka, mere Rasool ke munkiron ka yahi haal hota hai. Phir tum un ke saron par waar laga kar dimagh nikal do, gardanon par talwar maar ke sar aur dhar mein judai kar do. Haath paon aur jor-jor, poor-poor ko taak-taak kar zakhm lagao. Pas gardanon ke upar se ba'az ke nazdeek murad toh sar hain aur ba'az ke nazdeek khud gardan murad hai, chunancha aur jagah hai, (Fadribu-r-riqab) (47:4) gardanein maaro. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain main qudrati azabon se logon ko halak karne ke liye nahin bheja gaya, balkay gardan maarne aur qaid karne ke liye bheja gaya hoon. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) farmate hain ke gardan par aur sar par waar karne ka istidlal is se ho sakta hai. Maghazi-e-Umawi mein hai ke maqtooleen-e-Badr ke paas se jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) guzray toh ek sher ka ibtidai tukra aap ne parh diya, Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne poora sher parh diya. Aap ko na sher yaad thay na aap ke laiq. Is sher ka matlab yahi hai ke jo log zalim aur baghi thay aur aaj tak ghalbay aur shaukat se thay, aaj un ke sar tootay hue aur un ke dimagh bikhray hue hain. Kehte hain ke jo mushrik log farishton ke haath qatl hue thay unhein musalman is tarah pehchan lete thay ke un ki gardanon ke upar aur haath pairon ke jor aisay zakhm zada thay jaise aag se jalay honay ke nishanat. Banan jama hai banantah ki.

Arabi sheron mein 'banan' ka istemaal majood hai pas har jor aur har hissay ko banan kehte hain. Auza'i R.H kehte hain munh par aankh par aag ke koray barsao haan jab unhein giraftar karlo phir na marna. Abu Jahl maloon ne kaha tha ke jahan tak ho sakay musalmanon ko zinda giraftar karlo taake hum unhein is baat ka maza zyada der tak chakhayen ke woh hamaray deen ko bura kehte thay, hamaray deen se hat gaye thay, Laat-o-Uzza ki parastish chor bethay thay. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne musalmanon aur farishton ko yeh hukum diya. Chunancha jo sattar aadmi un kafiron ke qatl huay un mein ek yeh paaji bhi tha aur jo sattar aadmi qaid huay un mein ek Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait bhi tha la'anahu Allah Ta'ala, us ko qaid mein hi qatl kiya gaya aur us samet maqtooleen mushrikeen ki tadaad sattar hi thi. Allah Ta'ala aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ) ki mukhalifat ka natija aur badla yeh hai. Shiqaq makhooz hai 'shaq' se. Shaq kehte hain phaarne cheerne aur do tukray karne ko. Pas un logon ne goya shariyat, imaan aur farman-bardari ko ek taraf kiya aur dusri janib khud rahay. Lakri ke phaarne ko bhi Arab yahi kehte hain jabke lakri ke do tukray kardein. Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke khilaf chal kar koi bach nahin saka. Kaun hai jo Allah se chup jaye? Aur us ke be-panah aur sakht azabon se bach jaye? Na koi us ke muqablay ka na kisi ko us ke azabon ki taqat na us se koi bach niklay. Na us ka ghazab koi seh sakay. Woh buland-o-bala woh ghalib aur inteqam wala hai. Us ke siwa koi mabood aur Rab nahin. Woh apni zaat mein, apni sifaton mein yakta aur la-shareek hai. Aye kafiro! Dunya ke yeh azab uthao aur abhi aakhirat mein dozakh ka azab baqi hai.

Shaheedan-e-Wafa ke qisse: Jihad ke maidan mein jo Musalman bhi bhaag khara hua us ki saza Allah ke haan Jahannam ki aag hai. Jab lashkar-e-kuffar se mudbher ho jaye us waqt peeth pherna haram hai, haan us shakhs ke liye jo fan-e-jang ke taur par paintra badle ya dushman ko apne peeche laga kar mauqa par waar karne ke liye bhage ya is tarah lashkar peeche hate aur dushman ko ghaat mein le kar phir un par achanak chapa maar de to beshak us ke liye peeth pherna jaiz hai. Dusri surat yeh hai ke ek lashkar mein se dusre lashkar mein jana ho jahan chhote se lashkar se bade lashkar ka takrao ho ya Imam-e-Azam se milna ho to woh bhi is mein dakhil hai.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) farmate hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek chhota sa lashkar bheja tha, main bhi us mein hi tha. Logon mein bhagdar machi, main bhi bhaga. Hum log bahut hi nadim hue ke hum Allah ki raah se bhage hain, Allah ka gazab hum par hai. Hum ab Madine jayen aur wahan raat guzar kar An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne pesh hon, agar hamari tauba ki koi surat nikal aaye to khair, warna hum jangon mein nikal jayen. Chunancha namaz-e-fajr se pehle hum ja kar baith gaye. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye to aap ne daryaft farmaya ke tum kaun log ho? Hum ne kaha bhagne wale. Aap ne farmaya nahin balki tum lautne wale ho, main tumhari jamaat hoon aur main tamam Musalmanon ki jamaat hoon. Hum ne besakhta aage badh kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke haath choom liye. Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan keh kar farmate hain hum ise Ibn-e-Abi Ziyad ke ilawa kisi ki hadith se nahin pehchante. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke is farman ke baad aap ka is aayat ki tilawat karna bhi mazkoor hai.

Hazrat Abu Ubaidah (R.A) jang-e-Fars mein ek pul par gher liye gaye, Majusiyon ke tiddi dal lashkaron ne charon taraf se aap ko gher liya. Mauqa tha ke aap un mein se bach kar nikal aate lekin aap ne mardana-war Allah ki raah mein jaam-e-shahadat nosh farmaya. Jab Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko yeh waqia maloom hua to aap ne farmaya agar woh wahan se mere paas chale aate to un ke liye jaiz tha kyunke main Musalmanon ki jamaat hoon, mujh se mil jane mein koi harj nahin. Aur riwayat mein hai main tamam Musalmanon ki jamaat hoon. Aur riwayat mein hai ke tum is aayat ka galat matlab na lena, yeh waqia Badr ke mutaliq hai. Ab tamam Musalmanon ke liye woh fi'at (jamaat) jis ki taraf panah lene ke liye wapas murna jaiz hai, main hoon.

Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se Nafi ne sawal kiya ke hum log dushman ki ladai ke waqt sabit qadam nahin reh sakte aur hamain yeh maloom nahin ke fi'at se murad Imam-e-Lashkar hai ya Musalmanon ka jangi markaz? Aap ne farmaya fi'at Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) the. Main ne is aayat ki tilawat ki to aap ne farmaya yeh aayat Badr ke din utri hai, na is se pehle na is ke baad. Zahhak farmate hain lashkar-e-kuffar se bhag kar An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap ke Sahaba ke paas panah le, us ke liye jaiz hai. Aaj bhi Ameer aur Salar-e-Lashkar ke paas ya apne markaz mein jo bhi aaye us ke liye yahi hukm hai.

Haan is surat ke siwa namardi aur buzdili ke taur par lashkar-gah se jo bhaag khara ho larai mein pusht dikhaye woh jahannami hai aur us par Allah ka ghazab hai woh hurmat ke kabira gunah ka murtakib hai. Bukhari Muslim ki hadith mein hai saat gunahon se jo muhlik hain bachte raho, pucha gaya ke woh kya kya hain? Farmaya Allah ke sath shirk karna, jadu, kisi ko na-haq maar dalna, sood khori, yateem ka maal khana, maidan-e-jihad se peeth dikha kar bhaag khara hona, imandar paak daman be-aib aurton par tohmat lagana. Farman hai ke aisa karne wala Allah Ta'ala ka ghazab-o-ghussa le kar laut-ta hai, uski lautne aur rehne sehne ki jagah jahannam hai jo bahut hi badtar hai. Bashir bin Ma'bad kehte hain main Huzoor (ﷺ) ke hath par bai'at karne aaya to aap ne shart bayan ki, Allah Ta'ala ki wahdaniyat, shahadat aur Muhammad (ﷺ) ki abdiyat-o-risalat ki shahadat doon, panchhon waqt ki namaz qaim rakhun aur zakat ada karta rahoon aur hajj mutabiq-e-Islam baja laoon aur Ramazan-ul-Mubarak ke mahine ke rozay rakhun aur Allah ki rah mein jihad karoon. Main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) is mein se do kaam mere bas ke nahin, ek to jihad dusre zakat, main ne to suna hai ke jihad mein peeth dikhane wala Allah ke ghazab mein aa jata hai, mujhe to dar hai ke maut ka bhayanak saman kahin kisi waqt mera munh na pher de aur maal-e-ghanimat aur ushr hi mere paas hota hai woh hi mere bachon aur ghar walon ka asasa hai, sawari lein aur doodh piyein use main kisi ko kaise de doon? Aap ne apna hath hila kar farmaya jab jihad bhi na ho aur sadaqa bhi na ho to jannat kaise mil jaye? Main ne kaha achha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) sab shartein manzoor hain, chunancha main ne aap ke hath par bai'at kar li. Yeh hadith Sahah-e-Sitta mein nahin, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai aur is sanad se gharib hai. Tabrani mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke teen gunahon ke sath koi neki nafa nahin deti, Allah ke sath shirk, maa baap ki nafarmani, larai se bhagna, yeh hadith bhi bahut gharib hai. Isi Tabrani mein hai aap farmate hain jis ne dua (Astaghfirullahallazi la ilaha illa huwal hayyul qayyumu wa atubu ilaih) parh liya us ke sab gunah maaf ho jate hain go woh larai se bhaga ho. Abu Dawood aur Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Imam Tirmidhi ise gharib batate hain aur An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ke maula Zaid is ke rawi hain. Un se is ke siwa koi hadith nazar se nahin guzri. Ba'az hazrat ka qaul hai ke bhagne ki hurmat ka yeh hukm Sahaba ke sath makhsoos tha is liye ke un par jihad farz-e-ain tha aur kaha gaya hai ke Ansar ke sath hi makhsoos tha is liye ke un ki bai'at sunne aur manne ki thi khushi mein bhi aur na-khushi mein bhi. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke Badri Sahaba ke sath yeh khaas tha kyunke un ki koi jama'at thi hi nahin, chunancha Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne apni dua mein kaha tha ke Aye Allah agar tu is jama'at ko halak kar de ga to phir zameen mein teri ibadat na ki jaye gi.

Hazrat Hasan (R.H) farmate hain 'Yauma'izin' se murad Badr ka din hai. Ab agar koi apni buri jamaat ki taraf aajaye ya kisi qile mein panah le to mere khayal mein to us par koi haraj nahin. Yazid bin Abi Habib (R.H) farmate hain ke Badr wale din jo bhage uske liye dozakh wajib thi, uske baad jang-e-Uhud hui us waqt yeh ayatein utrin (INNALLAZINA TAWALLAW MINKUM YAUMAL TAQAL JAM'AN) (Surah Al-Imran: 155) se 'Afallahu Anhum' tak. Iske saat saal baad jang-e-Hunain hui jis ke bare mein Qurani zikr hai ayat (THUMMA WALLAITUM MUDIBIRIN) (Surah At-Tawbah: 25), phir Allah ne jis ki chahi tauba qubool farmayi. Abu Dawood, Nasai, Mustadrak Hakim wagaira mein hai ke Abu Saeed (R.A) farmate hain yeh ayat Badriyon ke bare mein utri hai, lekin yeh yaad rahe ke go yeh maan liya jaye ke sabab-e-nuzool is ayat ka Badri log hain magar ladai se munh pherna to haram hai jaise ke is se pehle hadith mein guzra ke saat halak karne wale gunahon mein ek yeh bhi hai aur yahi mazhab-e-jumhoor ka hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke is farman ke baad aap ka is aayat ki tilawat karna bhi mazkoor hai.

Hazrat Abu Ubaidah (R.A) jang-e-Fars mein ek pul par gher liye gaye, Majusiyon ke tiddi dal lashkaron ne charon taraf se aap ko gher liya. Mauqa tha ke aap un mein se bach kar nikal aate lekin aap ne mardana-war Allah ki raah mein jaam-e-shahadat nosh farmaya. Jab Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko yeh waqia maloom hua to aap ne farmaya agar woh wahan se mere paas chale aate to un ke liye jaiz tha kyunke main Musalmanon ki jamaat hoon, mujh se mil jane mein koi harj nahin. Aur riwayat mein hai main tamam Musalmanon ki jamaat hoon. Aur riwayat mein hai ke tum is aayat ka galat matlab na lena, yeh waqia Badr ke mutaliq hai. Ab tamam Musalmanon ke liye woh fi'at (jamaat) jis ki taraf panah lene ke liye wapas murna jaiz hai, main hoon.

Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se Nafi ne sawal kiya ke hum log dushman ki ladai ke waqt sabit qadam nahin reh sakte aur hamain yeh maloom nahin ke fi'at se murad Imam-e-Lashkar hai ya Musalmanon ka jangi markaz? Aap ne farmaya fi'at Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) the. Main ne is aayat ki tilawat ki to aap ne farmaya yeh aayat Badr ke din utri hai, na is se pehle na is ke baad. Zahhak farmate hain lashkar-e-kuffar se bhag kar An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap ke Sahaba ke paas panah le, us ke liye jaiz hai. Aaj bhi Ameer aur Salar-e-Lashkar ke paas ya apne markaz mein jo bhi aaye us ke liye yahi hukm hai.

Haan is surat ke siwa namardi aur buzdili ke taur par lashkar-gah se jo bhaag khara ho larai mein pusht dikhaye woh jahannami hai aur us par Allah ka ghazab hai woh hurmat ke kabira gunah ka murtakib hai. Bukhari Muslim ki hadith mein hai saat gunahon se jo muhlik hain bachte raho, pucha gaya ke woh kya kya hain? Farmaya Allah ke sath shirk karna, jadu, kisi ko na-haq maar dalna, sood khori, yateem ka maal khana, maidan-e-jihad se peeth dikha kar bhaag khara hona, imandar paak daman be-aib aurton par tohmat lagana. Farman hai ke aisa karne wala Allah Ta'ala ka ghazab-o-ghussa le kar laut-ta hai, uski lautne aur rehne sehne ki jagah jahannam hai jo bahut hi badtar hai. Bashir bin Ma'bad kehte hain main Huzoor (ﷺ) ke hath par bai'at karne aaya to aap ne shart bayan ki, Allah Ta'ala ki wahdaniyat, shahadat aur Muhammad (ﷺ) ki abdiyat-o-risalat ki shahadat doon, panchhon waqt ki namaz qaim rakhun aur zakat ada karta rahoon aur hajj mutabiq-e-Islam baja laoon aur Ramazan-ul-Mubarak ke mahine ke rozay rakhun aur Allah ki rah mein jihad karoon. Main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) is mein se do kaam mere bas ke nahin, ek to jihad dusre zakat, main ne to suna hai ke jihad mein peeth dikhane wala Allah ke ghazab mein aa jata hai, mujhe to dar hai ke maut ka bhayanak saman kahin kisi waqt mera munh na pher de aur maal-e-ghanimat aur ushr hi mere paas hota hai woh hi mere bachon aur ghar walon ka asasa hai, sawari lein aur doodh piyein use main kisi ko kaise de doon? Aap ne apna hath hila kar farmaya jab jihad bhi na ho aur sadaqa bhi na ho to jannat kaise mil jaye? Main ne kaha achha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) sab shartein manzoor hain, chunancha main ne aap ke hath par bai'at kar li. Yeh hadith Sahah-e-Sitta mein nahin, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai aur is sanad se gharib hai. Tabrani mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke teen gunahon ke sath koi neki nafa nahin deti, Allah ke sath shirk, maa baap ki nafarmani, larai se bhagna, yeh hadith bhi bahut gharib hai. Isi Tabrani mein hai aap farmate hain jis ne dua (Astaghfirullahallazi la ilaha illa huwal hayyul qayyumu wa atubu ilaih) parh liya us ke sab gunah maaf ho jate hain go woh larai se bhaga ho. Abu Dawood aur Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Imam Tirmidhi ise gharib batate hain aur An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ke maula Zaid is ke rawi hain. Un se is ke siwa koi hadith nazar se nahin guzri. Ba'az hazrat ka qaul hai ke bhagne ki hurmat ka yeh hukm Sahaba ke sath makhsoos tha is liye ke un par jihad farz-e-ain tha aur kaha gaya hai ke Ansar ke sath hi makhsoos tha is liye ke un ki bai'at sunne aur manne ki thi khushi mein bhi aur na-khushi mein bhi. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke Badri Sahaba ke sath yeh khaas tha kyunke un ki koi jama'at thi hi nahin, chunancha Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne apni dua mein kaha tha ke Aye Allah agar tu is jama'at ko halak kar de ga to phir zameen mein teri ibadat na ki jaye gi.

Hazrat Hasan (R.H) farmate hain 'Yauma'izin' se murad Badr ka din hai. Ab agar koi apni buri jamaat ki taraf aajaye ya kisi qile mein panah le to mere khayal mein to us par koi haraj nahin. Yazid bin Abi Habib (R.H) farmate hain ke Badr wale din jo bhage uske liye dozakh wajib thi, uske baad jang-e-Uhud hui us waqt yeh ayatein utrin (INNALLAZINA TAWALLAW MINKUM YAUMAL TAQAL JAM'AN) (Surah Al-Imran: 155) se 'Afallahu Anhum' tak. Iske saat saal baad jang-e-Hunain hui jis ke bare mein Qurani zikr hai ayat (THUMMA WALLAITUM MUDIBIRIN) (Surah At-Tawbah: 25), phir Allah ne jis ki chahi tauba qubool farmayi. Abu Dawood, Nasai, Mustadrak Hakim wagaira mein hai ke Abu Saeed (R.A) farmate hain yeh ayat Badriyon ke bare mein utri hai, lekin yeh yaad rahe ke go yeh maan liya jaye ke sabab-e-nuzool is ayat ka Badri log hain magar ladai se munh pherna to haram hai jaise ke is se pehle hadith mein guzra ke saat halak karne wale gunahon mein ek yeh bhi hai aur yahi mazhab-e-jumhoor ka hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Allah ki madad hi wajah-e-kamrani hai. Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke bandon ke kul kamon ka khaliq wahi hai, un se jo bhi achhaiyan sarzad hon us par qabil-e-tareef wahi hai, is liye ke taufeeq usi ki taraf se hai aur iaanat-o-madad bhi usi ki janib se hai. Isi liye farmata hai ke ae Musalmanon! Tum ne aap apni taqat-o-quwwat se apne dushmanon ko qatl nahin kiya, tum toh mitti bhar thay aur dushman bahut zyada thay, tum bekas aur kamzor thay, dushman kas-bal walay quwwat-o-taqat walay thay. Yeh Allah hi ki madad thi ke us ne tumhein un par ghalib kar diya, jaise farman hai aayat (Walaqad nasarakumullahu bi-badrin wa antum azillatun, fattaqullaha la'allakum tashkurun) (Surah Al-Imran: 123). Allah ne Badr ke din tumhari madad ki aur aayat mein hai aayat (Laqad nasarakumullahu fi mawatina kathiratin, wa yawma hunaynin, iz a'jabatkum kathratukum falam tughni 'ankum shay'an wa daqat 'alaikumul-ardu bima rahubat thumma wallaytum mudbirin) (Surah At-Tawbah: 25), bahut si jagah Allah Jalla Shanuhu ne tumhari imdad farmayi hai, Hunain ke din bhi jabke tumhein apni zyadati par ghamand hua lekin woh bekar sabit hui aur yeh wasee zameen tum par tang ho gayi aur aakhir munh mor kar tum bhag kharay huay. Pas sabit hai ke ginti ki zyadati, hathiyaron ki umdagi aur saaz-o-saman ki farawani par ghalba mauqoof nahin, woh toh Allah ki madad par mauqoof hai. Jaise irshad-e-Ilahi hai aayat (Kam min fi'atin qalilatin ghalabat fi'atan kathiratan bi-iznillah, wallahu ma'as-sabirin), yani basa auqat choti choti jamaton ne baray baray lashkaron ke munh pher diye hain aur un par ghalba hasil kar liya hai, yeh sab Allah ke hukum aur us ki madad se hai aur yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala ki madad sabr karne walon ke sath hai. Phir mitti ki us mutthi ka zikr ho raha hai jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Badr ki larai mein kafiron ki taraf phenki thi. Pehle toh aap ne apni jhonpri mein Allah Ta'ala se dua ki, roye, girgiraye aur munajat kar ke bahar niklay aur kankariyon ki ek mutthi utha kar kafiron ki taraf phenki aur farmaya un ke chehray bigar jayen, un ke munh phir jayen, sath hi Sahaba ko hukum diya ke foran aam hamla kar do. Idhar hamla hua udhar se woh kankariyan Allah Ta'ala ne apni qudrat-e-kamilah se kafiron ki aankhon mein daal dein. Woh sab apni aankhein mal hi rahe thay ke lashkar-e-Islam un ke galay par pahunch gaya. Pas farmata hai ke woh mutthi tu ne nahin balkay hum ne phenki thi, yani phenki toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne lekin un ki aankhon tak pahuncha kar unhein shikast dene wala Allah Ta'ala hi tha na ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam).

Ibn-e-Abbas R.A bayan farmate hain ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apne haath utha kar dua ki jis mein yeh bhi kaha ke ae mere Parwardigar agar tu ne is jamaat ko halak kar diya toh phir kabhi bhi teri ibadat zameen par na ki jaye gi. Isi waqt Hazrat Jibraeel A.S ne farmaya Ya Rasool Allah! Aap ek mutthi zameen se mitti ki bhar lein aur un ke munh ki taraf phenk dein. Aap ne yahi kiya, pas mushrikeen ke saare lashkar ke munh aur aankh aur nathnon mein woh mitti ghus gayi aur unhein peeth pherte hi bani. Suddi farmate hain ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne jang-e-Badr mein Hazrat Ali R.A se farmaya kankariyon ki ek mutthi zameen se bhar kar mujhe do. Hazrat Ali R.A ne mutthi bhar di jis mein kankariyan thin aur mitti bhi. Aap ne mushrikon ki taraf woh mutthi phenki jis se un ki aankhein bhar gayin. Idhar se musalmanon ne un par hamla kar diya aur qatl karna aur qeema karna shuru kar diya. Isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai ke yeh tere bas ki baat na thi balkeh yeh Allah ke bas ki cheez thi. Ek riwayat mein hai ke teen kankar le kar aap ne phenke thay, ek daayein, ek baayein, ek beech mein. Go Hunain wale din bhi aap ne kankariyan mushrikon ki taraf phenki thin lekin yahan zikr jang-e-Badr ke din ka hai. Hakim bin Hizam ka bayan hai ke jang-e-Badr ke din hum ne ek aawaz suni ke goya aasman se koi kankar kisi tasht mein gira, isi waqt Rasool Allah ﷺ ki phenki hui kankariyan hum mein pahunchin aur humein shikast hui. Yeh riwayat is sanad se bahut ghareeb hai. Yahan do qaul aur bhi hain lekin bilkul ghareeb hain. Ek toh yeh ke Khaibar ki jang ke mauqe par yaum-e-Ibn-e-Abi Haqeeq mein Rasool Allah ﷺ ne ek kamaan mangayi, logon ne bahut lambi kamaan la kar aap ko di, aap ne us se qil'e ki taraf teer phenka, woh ghoomta hua chala aur sardar-e-qil'a Al-Haqeeq ko us ke ghar mein us ke bistare par ja kar laga aur isi se woh mara. Is ka zikr is aayat mein hai ke woh teer tu ne nahin balkeh hum ne phenka tha. Yeh riwayat ghareeb hai, mumkin hai raavi ko shuba ho gaya ho ya murad un ki yeh ho ke yeh aayat aam hai, yeh waqea bhi isi mein shamil hai. Warna yeh toh zahir hai ke Surah Anfal ki is aayat mein jang-e-Badr ke bayan ka zikr hai. Toh yeh waqea isi jang-e-Badr ka hai aur yeh baat bilkul zahir hai, Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmata hai taake mominon ko apni ne'mat ka iqrar kara de ke bawajood un ki kasrat, un ki qillat, un ke saaz-o-samaan, un ki besaro-samani ke Rabb-ul-Aalameen ne unhein un par ghalib kar diya. Hadees mein hai har ek imtehan hamara imtehan hai aur hum par Allah ka ehsaan hai. Allah duaon ka sunne wala hai. Woh khoob jaanta hai ke madad aur ghalbe ka mustahiq kaun hai? Phir farmata hai is fatah ke saath hi yeh khushkhabri bhi sun lo ke Allah Ta'ala kafiron ke heele hawalay kamzor kar de ga, un ki shaan ghata de ga, un ka anjam tabahi ke siwa aur kuch na hoga aur yahi hua bhi.

Iman walon ka muta'een-o-madadgar Allah azza ismuhu. Allah Ta'ala kafiron se farma raha hai ke tum yeh duayein karte the ke hum mein aur musalmanon mein Allah Ta'ala faisla kar de, jo haq par ho use ghalib kar de aur uski madad farmaye, toh ab tumhari yeh khwahish bhi poori ho gayi, musalman ba-hukm-e-Ilahi apne dushmanon par ghalib aa gaye. Abu Jahl ne Badr wale din kaha tha ke ae Allah! Hum mein se jo rishton naton ka todne wala ho aur ghair-maroof cheez le kar aaya ho, use tu kal ki ladai mein shikast de. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne yahi kiya aur yeh aur uska lashkar haar gaye. Makkah se nikalne se pehle in mushrikon ne Khana-e-Ka'aba ka ghilaf pakad kar dua ki thi ke Ilahi! Dono lashkaron mein se tere nazdeek jo a'ala ho aur zyada buzurg ho aur zyada behtari wala ho, toh uski madad kar. Pas is aayat mein un se farmaya ja raha hai ke lo Allah ki madad aa gayi, tumhara kaha hua poora ho gaya. Hum ne apne Nabi (ﷺ) ko jo hamare nazdeek buzurg, behtar aur a'ala the, ghalib kar diya. Khud Quran ne unki dua naqal ki hai ke yeh kehte the: (Wa iz qalu Allahumma in kana haza huwal haqqu min indika fa-amtir alaina hijaratan minas-sama-i aw-itina bi-azabin aleem) (Surah Al-Anfal: 32). Ilahi! Agar yeh teri janib se raast hai toh tu hum par aasman se patthar barsa ya koi aur dardnak azab hum par la. Phir farmata hai ke agar ab bhi tum apne kufr se baaz aa jao toh yeh tumhare liye behtar hai. Allah Jalla Jalaluhu aur uske Rasool (ﷺ) ko na jhutlao toh dono jahan mein bhalai paoge aur agar phir tum ne yahi kufr-o-gumrahi ki toh hum bhi isi tarah musalmanon ke hathon tumhein past karenge. Agar tum ne phir isi tarah fatah mangi toh hum phir apne nek bandon par apni madad utarenge lekin awwal qaul qawi hai. Yaad rakho go tum sab ke sab mil kar chadhai karo, tumhari tadaad kitni hi badh jaye, apne tamam lashkar jama kar lo lekin sab tadbeerein dhari ki dhari reh jayengi. Jis ke sath Allah Ta'ala ho use koi maghloob nahin kar sakta. Zahir hai ke Khaliq-e-Kainat mominon ke sath hai is liye ke woh uske Rasool (ﷺ) ke sath hain.

Allah ki nigah mein badtareen makhlooq. Allah Ta'ala apne imandar bandon ko apni aur apne Rasool (ﷺ) ki farmanbardari ka hukum deta hai aur mukhalifat se aur kafiron jaisa hone se mana farmata hai. Irshad hota hai ke ita'at ko na chhodo, tabe-dari se munh na modo. Jin kamon se Allah aur uska Rasool (ﷺ) rok de ruk jaya karo, sun kar ansuni na kar diya karo, mushrikon ki tarah na ban jao ke suna nahin aur keh diya ke sun liya, na munafiqon ki tarah bano ke bazahir manne wala zahir kar diya aur darhaqiqat yeh baat nahin. Badtareen makhlooq janwaron, keere makoron se bhi bure Allah ke nazdeek aise hi log hain jo haq baton se apne kaan behre kar lein aur haq ke samajhne se goonge ban jayen, be-aqli se kaam lein. Is liye ke tamam janwar bhi Allah Qadir-e-Kul ke zer-e-farman hain jo jis kaam ke liye banaya gaya hai us mein mashghool hai magar yeh hain ke paida kiye gaye ibadat ke liye lekin kufr karte hain. Chunancha aur aayat mein inhein janwaron se tashbeeh di gayi. Farman hai aayat (Wa masalul-lazina kafaroo kamasalil-lazi yan'iqu bima la yasma'u illa du'an wa nida'an, bukmun umyun fahum la ya'qiloon) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 171). Kafiron ki misaal aisi hi hai jaise koi inhein aawaz de to siwaye pukara aur nida ke kuch na sunen aur aayat mein hai ke yeh log misl-e-chopayon ke hain balkeh un se bhi zyada behke hue aur ghafil. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke murad is se Bani Abdud-Dar ke Quraishi hain. Muhammad bin Ishaq kehte hain murad is se munafiq hain. Baat yeh hai ke mushrik munafiq donon hi murad hain, donon mein sahih feham aur salamti wali aql nahin hoti na hi amal-e-saleh ki inhein taufiq hoti hai. Agar in mein bhalai hoti to Allah inhein suna deta lekin na in mein bhalai na taufiq-e-Ilahi. Allah Jalla Shanuhu ko ilm hai ke inhein sunaya bhi samjhaya bhi to bhi yeh apni sarkashi se baaz nahin aayenge balkeh aur akar kar bhaag jayenge.

Allah ki nigah mein badtareen makhlooq. Allah Ta'ala apne imandar bandon ko apni aur apne Rasool (ﷺ) ki farmanbardari ka hukum deta hai aur mukhalifat se aur kafiron jaisa hone se mana farmata hai. Irshad hota hai ke ita'at ko na chhodo, tabe-dari se munh na modo. Jin kamon se Allah aur uska Rasool (ﷺ) rok de ruk jaya karo, sun kar ansuni na kar diya karo, mushrikon ki tarah na ban jao ke suna nahin aur keh diya ke sun liya, na munafiqon ki tarah bano ke bazahir manne wala zahir kar diya aur darhaqiqat yeh baat nahin. Badtareen makhlooq janwaron, keere makoron se bhi bure Allah ke nazdeek aise hi log hain jo haq baton se apne kaan behre kar lein aur haq ke samajhne se goonge ban jayen, be-aqli se kaam lein. Is liye ke tamam janwar bhi Allah Qadir-e-Kul ke zer-e-farman hain jo jis kaam ke liye banaya gaya hai us mein mashghool hai magar yeh hain ke paida kiye gaye ibadat ke liye lekin kufr karte hain. Chunancha aur aayat mein inhein janwaron se tashbeeh di gayi. Farman hai aayat (Wa masalul-lazina kafaroo kamasalil-lazi yan'iqu bima la yasma'u illa du'an wa nida'an, bukmun umyun fahum la ya'qiloon) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 171). Kafiron ki misaal aisi hi hai jaise koi inhein aawaz de to siwaye pukara aur nida ke kuch na sunen aur aayat mein hai ke yeh log misl-e-chopayon ke hain balkeh un se bhi zyada behke hue aur ghafil. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke murad is se Bani Abdud-Dar ke Quraishi hain. Muhammad bin Ishaq kehte hain murad is se munafiq hain. Baat yeh hai ke mushrik munafiq donon hi murad hain, donon mein sahih feham aur salamti wali aql nahin hoti na hi amal-e-saleh ki inhein taufiq hoti hai. Agar in mein bhalai hoti to Allah inhein suna deta lekin na in mein bhalai na taufiq-e-Ilahi. Allah Jalla Shanuhu ko ilm hai ke inhein sunaya bhi samjhaya bhi to bhi yeh apni sarkashi se baaz nahin aayenge balkeh aur akar kar bhaag jayenge.

Dil Rabb ki ungliyon mein hain. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai, istajiboo ma'ani mein ujeeboo ke hai, lamma yuhyeekum ma'ani bima yuslihukum ke hai, ya'ni Allah aur us ka Rasool tumhein jab aawaz dein tum jawab do aur maan lo kyunke us ke farman ke manne mein hi tumhari maslahat hai. Hazrat Abu Saeed bin Mu'alla (R.A) farmate hain ke main namaz mein tha, Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere paas se guzre. Mujhe aawaz di, main aap ke paas na aaya. Jab namaz parh chuka to hazir-e-khidmat hua. Aap ne farmaya tujhe kis ne roka tha ke tu mere paas chala aaye? Kya Allah Ta'ala ne nahin farmaya ke ae iman walo Allah aur Allah ka Rasool tumhein jab aawaz dein tum qabool kar liya karo kyunke isi mein tumhari zindagi hai. Suno is masjid se nikalne se pehle hi main tumhein Quran ki sab se bari surat sikhaunga. Jab Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne masjid se jaane ka irada kiya to main ne aap ko aap ka wada yaad dilaya aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh waqia Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) ka hai aur aap ne woh surat Fatiha batlai aur farmaya saat aayatein dohrai hui yahi hain. Is hadith ka poora poora bayan Surah Fatiha ki tafsir mein guzar chuka hai. Zindagi, aakhirat mein najaat, azab se bachao aur chhutkara Quran ki ta'leem, haq ko tasleem karne aur Islam lane aur jihad mein hai. In hi cheezon ka hukum Allah aur us ke Rasool ne diya hai. Allah insaan aur us ke dil mein hail hai. Ya'ni momin mein aur kufr mein, kafir mein aur iman mein. Yeh ma'ani ek marfoo hadith mein bhi hain lekin theek yahi hai ke yeh qaul Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka hai, marfoo hadith nahin. Mujahid kehte hain ya'ni use is haal mein chhorna hai ke woh kisi cheez ko samajhta nahin. Suddi kehte hain Allah Ta'ala ke irade ke baghair na iman la sake na kufr kar sake. Qatada kehte hain yeh aayat misl-e-aayat (Wa nahnu aqrabu ilaihi min hablil wareed - 50:16) ke hai, ya'ni bande ki rag-e-jaan se bhi zyada nazdeek hum hain. Is aayat ke munasib hadithein bhi hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aksar farmaya karte the ke ae dilon ke pherne wale mere dil ko apne deen par sabit rakh. To hum ne arz ki Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum aap par aur aap par utri hui wahi par iman la chuke hain kya phir bhi aap ko hamari nisbat khatra hai? Aap ne farmaya haan, Allah ki ungliyon mein se do ungliyon ke darmiyan dil hain, woh jis tarah chahta hai un ka taghayyur-o-tabaddul karta rehta hai. Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh riwayat Kitab-ul-Qadr mein majood hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh dua parha karte the: Ya Muqallibal Quloobi thabbit qalbi 'ala deenik (Ae dilon ke pherne wale mere dil ko apne deen par mazbooti se qaim rakh).

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai aap farmate hain har dil Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki ungliyon mein se do ungliyon ke darmiyan hai jab seedha karna chahta hai kar deta hai aur jab tedha karna chahta hai kar deta hai, aap ki dua thi ke aye Muqallib-ul-Quloob Allah mera dil apne deen par sabit qadam rakh, farmate hain Meezan Rabb-e-Rahman ke haath mein hai, jhukata hai aur oonchi karta hai, Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai ke aap ki is dua ko aksar sun kar Hazrat Mai Ayesha (R.A) ne aap se poocha ke bakasrat is dua ke karne ki kya wajah hai? Aap ne farmaya insaan ka dil Allah ki ungliyon mein se do ungliyon ke darmiyan hai jab chahta hai tedha kar deta hai aur jab chahta hai seedha kar deta hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke aap ki is dua ko bakasrat sun kar Hazrat Umme Salma (R.A) ne aap se poocha ke kya dil palat jate hain? Aap ne yahi jawab diya. Hum Allah Ta'ala se jo hamara Parwardigar hai dua karte hain ke woh hidayat ke baad hamare dil tedhe na kar de aur hamein apne paas se rahmat-o-nemat ata farmaye woh badi hi bakhshish karne wala aur bahut inaamon wala hai. Hazrat Umme Salma kehti hain main ne Huzoor se phir darkhwast ki ke kya aap mujhe mere liye bhi koi dua sikhayenge? Aap ne farmaya haan yeh dua manga karo dua (Allahumma Rabban-Nabi Muhammadin-ighfirli zanbi wa azhib ghaiza qalbi wa ajirni min mudillatil-fitani ma ahyaitani) yani aye Allah aye Muhammad Nabi (ﷺ) ke Parwardigar mere gunah maaf farma mere dil ki sakhti door kar de mujhe gumrah karne wale fitnon se bacha le jab tak bhi tu mujhe zinda rakh. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke tamam insaanon ke dil ek hi dil ki tarah Allah ki ungliyon mein se do ungliyon ke darmiyan hain. Jis tarah chahta hai unhein ulat palat karta rehta hai phir aap ne dua ki ke aye dilon ke pherne wale Allah hamare dilon ko apni itaat ki taraf pher le.

Buraiyon se na rokna azab-e-Ilahi ka sabab hai. Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko dara raha hai ke is imtehan aur is mehnat aur fitne ka khauf rakho jo gunahgaron badkaron par hi nahin rahega balkeh is bala ki waba aam hogi. Hazrat Zubair R.A se logon ne kaha ke ae Abu Abdullah tumhein kaunsi cheez layi hai? Tum ne maqtool khalifa ko dhoka diya phir us ke khoon ke badle ki justuju mein tum aaye, is par Hazrat Zubair R.A ne farmaya hum An-Hazrat ﷺ aur Hazrat Umar R.A aur Hazrat Usman R.A ke zamane mein is aayat (Wattaqu fitnatan la tusibannallazina zalamu minkum khassah) ko padhte the lekin yeh khayal bhi na tha ke hum hi is ke ahl hain yahan tak ke yeh waqiyat ronuma hue aur riwayat mein hai ke ahd-e-nabvi mein hi hum is aayat se dara diye gaye the lekin yeh khayal bhi na tha ke hum hi is ke sath makhsoos kar diye gaye hain. Suddi kehte hain yeh aayat khassatan Ahl-e-Badr ke bare mein utri hai ke woh Jang-e-Jamal mein aapas mein khoob lade bhide. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain murad is se khass Ashab-e-Rasool hain. Farmate hain is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala mominon ko hukum farma raha hai ke woh aapas mein kisi khilaf-e-shar'a kaam ko baqi aur jaari na rahne dein. Warna Allah ke aam azab mein sab pakad liye jayenge. Yeh tafseer nihayat umda hai. Mujahid kehte hain yeh hukum tumhare liye bhi hai. Ibn Masood R.A farmate hain tum mein se har shakhs fitne mein mashghool hai, Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ke tumhare maal aur tumhari auladein fitna hain, pas tum mein se jo bhi panah mange woh Allah Ta'ala se mange, har gumrah kun fitne se panah talab kar liya kare. Sahih baat yahi hai ke is farman mein Sahaba aur ghair-e-Sahaba sab ko tanbeeh hai go khitab unhi se hai, isi par dalalat un ahadees ki hai jo fitne se darane ke liye hain, go un ke bayan mein Aimma-e-Kiram ki mustaqil tasaneef hain lekin ba'az makhsoos hadeesein hum yahan bhi warid karte hain, Allah hamari madad farmaye. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain khass logon ke gunahon ki wajah se aam logon ko Allah Azza-wa-Jal azab nahin karta, han agar woh koi burai dekhein aur us ke mitane par qadir hon phir bhi us khilaf-e-shar'a kaam ko na rokein to Allah Ta'ala sab ko azab karta hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Is ki asnad mein ek rawi mubham hai. Aur hadees mein Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai ke ya to tum achi baton ka hukum aur buri baton se mana karte rahoge ya Allah Ta'ala tum par apne paas se koi aam azab nazil farmayega.

(Musnad-e-Ahmad) Hazrat Huzaifa R.A ka farman hai ke ek aadmi ek baat zaban se nikalta tha aur munafiq hojata tha lekin ab toh tum ek hi majlis mein nihayat be-parwahi se chaar chaar dafa aise kalmaat apni zaban se nikal diya karte ho. Wallah ya toh tum nek baton ka hukum, buri baton se roko aur nekiyon ki raghbat dilao warna Allah Ta'ala tum sab ko tehas-nehas kar dega ya tum par bure logon ko musallat kar dega phir nek log duayein karenge lekin woh qabool na farmayega. (Musnad) Hazrat Numan bin Bashir R.A ne apne khutbay mein apne kaanon ki taraf apni ungliyon se ishara kar ke farmaya: Allah ki haddon par qaim rehne wale, un mein waqay hone wale aur un ke bare mein susti karne walon ki misaal un logon ki si hai jo ek kashti mein sawar hue, koi neeche tha koi oopar tha. Neeche wale pani lene ke liye oopar aate the, oopar walon ko takleef hoti thi. Aakhir unhon ne kaha aao yahin se neeche se hi kashti ka ek takhta tod lein, hasb-e-zarurat pani yahin se le liya karenge taake na oopar jana pade na unhein takleef pohanche. Pas agar oopar wale un ke kaam apne zimma le lein aur unhein kashti ke neeche ka takhta ukhaadne se rok dein toh woh bhi bachenge aur yeh bhi, warna woh bhi doobenge aur yeh bhi. (Bukhari) Ek aur hadith mein Rasool ﷺ farmate hain jab meri ummat mein gunah zahir honge toh Allah Ta'ala apne aam azab un par bheje ga. Hazrat Umme Salma R.A ne daryaft kiya ya Rasool Allah! Un mein toh nek log bhi honge? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya kyun nahin? Poocha phir woh log kya karenge? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya unhein bhi wahi pohanchega jo auron ko pohancha aur phir unhein Allah ki maghfirat aur razamandi milegi. (Musnad-e-Ahmad) Ek aur hadith mein Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke jo log bure kaam karne lagein aur un mein koi zi-izzat, zi-asar shakhs ho aur woh mana na kare, roke nahin toh un sab ko Allah ka azab hoga, saza mein sab shamil rahenge. (Musnad-o-Abu Dawood waghaira) Aur riwayat mein hai ke karne wale thode hon, na karne wale zyada aur zi-asar hon phir bhi woh is burai ko na rokein toh Allah un sab ko ijtima'i saza dega. Musnad ki aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap ﷺ ne farmaya jab zameen walon mein badi zahir hojaye toh Allah Ta'ala un par apna azab utarta hai. Hazrat Aisha R.A ne poocha ke un hi mein Allah ke itaat-guzar bande bhi honge? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya azab aam hoga phir woh Allah ki rahmat ki taraf laut jayenge.

Ahl-e-Iman par Allah ke ehsanat. Mominon ko Parwardigar-e-Alam apne ehsanat yaad dila raha hai ke un ki ginti us ne barha di, un ki kamzori ko zor se badal diya, un ke khauf ko aman se badal diya, un ki natwani ko taqat se badal diya, un ki faqiri ko amiri se badal diya, unhon ne jaise jaise Allah ke farman ki baja awari ki waise waise yeh taraqqi pa gaye. Momin sahaba Makkah ke qayam ki halat mein tadaad mein bohat thore thay, chhupe phirte thay, be-qarar rehte thay, har waqt dushmanon ka khatra laga rehta tha, majoosi un ke dushman thay, yahoodi un ki jaan ke peeche, but-parast un ke khoon ke pyase, nasrani un ki fikr mein. Dushmanon ki yeh halat thi to un ki apni yeh halat ke tadaad mein ungliyon par gin lo. Baghair taqat-o-shan-o-shaukat mutlaqan nahin. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala unhein Madine ki taraf hijrat karne ka hukum deta hai yeh maan lete hain wahan pahunchte hi Allah un ke qadam jama deta hai wahan Madine walon ko un ka sathi balkay pusht-panah bana deta hai woh un ki madad par aur sath dene par tayyar ho jate hain, Badr wale din apni janen hatheliyon par liye nikal khare hote hain, apne maal pani ki tarah rah-e-haq mein bahate hain aur dusre mauqon par bhi na ita'at chorte hain na sath na sakhawat. Nateeja yeh hota hai ke chand ki tarah chamakne lagte hain aur suraj ki tarah damakne lagte hain. Qatada bin Da'ama Sadusi (R.H) farmate hain ke Arab ke yeh log sab se zyada gire hue, sab se zyada tang-haal, sab se zyada bhooke nange, sab se zyada gumrah aur be-deen-o-mazhab thay. Jeete to zillat ki halat mein, marte to jahannami ho kar, har ek un ke sar kuchalta lekin yeh aapas mein uljhe rehte. Wallah roo-e-zameen par un se zyada gumrah koi na tha. Ab yeh Islam laye Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ita'at-guzar bane to idhar se udhar tak shehron balkay mulkon par un ka qabza ho gaya, duniya ki daulat un ke qadmon par bikharne lagi, logon ki gardanon ke malik aur duniya ke badshah ban gaye. Yaad rakho yeh sab kuch sachay deen aur Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taleem par amal ke nataij thay, pas tum apne Parwardigar ke shukr mein lage raho aur us ke bare bare ehsan tum par hain, woh shukr ko aur shukr karne walon ko pasand farmata hai. Suno shukr-guzar ne'maton ki zyadati mein hi rehte.

Allah aur uske Rasool ki khayanat na karo. Kehte hain ke yeh aayat Hazrat Abu Lubaba bin Abdul Munzir (R.A) ke bare mein utri hai. Unhein Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Banu Quraiza ke Yahudiyon ke paas bheja tha ke woh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke faisle ki shart ke manne par qila khali kardein. In Yahudiyon ne aap hi se mashwara daryaft kiya to aap ne apni gardan par hath pher kar unhein bata diya ke Huzoor ka faisla tumhare haq mein yahi hoga. Ab Hazrat Abu Lubaba (R.A) bahut hi nadim hue ke afsos main ne bahut bura kiya, Allah ki aur uske Rasool ki khayanat ki. Isi nadamat ki halat mein qasam kha baithe ke jab tak meri tauba qabool na ho main khane ka ek luqma bhi na uthaunga chahe mar hi jaaun. Masjid-e-Nabvi mein aa kar ek sutoon ke sath apne tayein bandhwa diya. Nau din isi halat mein guzar gaye, ghashi aa gayi, behosh ho kar murde ki tarah gir pade yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki tauba qabool kar li aur yeh aayatein nazil huin. Log aaye, aap ko khushkhabri sunayi aur is sutoon se kholna chaha to unhon ne farmaya, Wallah main apne tayein kisi se na khulwaunga bajuz is ke ke khud Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne hath mubarak se kholein. Chunancha aap khud tashreef laye aur apne hath se unhein khola to aap arz karne lage ke Ya Rasool Allah! Main ne nazr mani hai ke agar Allah Ta'ala meri tauba qabool kar le to main apna kul maal rah-e-lillah sadqa kar dunga. Aap ne irshad farmaya, nahin sirf ek tihayi fi sabeelillah de do, yahi kafi hai.

Hazrat Mughira bin Shuba (R.A) farmate hain ke yeh aayat Hazrat Usman (R.A) ki shahadat ke bare mein nazil hui hai. Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah ka bayan hai ke Abu Sufyan Makkah se chala, Jibraeel (A.S) ne aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko khabar di ke Abu Sufyan falan jagah hai. Aap ne sahaba se zikr kiya aur farma diya ke is taraf chalo lekin kisi ko kanon-kan khabar na karna, lekin ek munafiq ne use likh bheja ke tere pakadne ke irade se Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef la rahe hain, hoshiyar rehna. Pas yeh aayat utri, lekin yeh riwayat bahut ghareeb hai aur is ki sanad aur matan dono hi qabil-e-nazar hain.

Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Hatib bin Abu Balta'a (R.A) ka qissa hai ke Fatah-e-Makkah wale saal unhon ne Quraish ko khat bhej diya jis mein Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke irade se unhein mutalla kiya tha, lekin Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko khabar kar di. Aap ne aadmi un ke peeche daudaye aur khat pakda gaya. Hazrat Hatib ne apne qusoor ka iqrar kiya. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne un ki gardan marne ki ijazat chahi ke is ne Allah ke Rasool aur mominon se khayanat ki hai. Aap ne farmaya, ise chhod do yeh Badri sahabi hai. Tum nahin jante, Badri ki taraf Allah Ta'ala ne bazat-e-khud farma diya hai, jo chaho tum karo main ne tumhein bakhsh diya hai.

Main kehta hoon kisi khas waqiye ke bare mein utarne ke bawajood alfaz ki umoomiyat apne hukm-e-umoom par hi rahegi, yahi jamhoor ulama ka qaul hai. Khayanat aam hai, chhote bade, lazim muta'addi sab gunah khayanat mein dakhil hain. Apni amanaton mein bhi khayanat na karo, yani farz ko naqis na karo, paighambar ki sunnat ko na chhodo, us ki nafarmani na karo.

Urwah bin Zubair kehte hain ke kisi ke samne uske haq ka izhar karna aur darparda karna uske ulat, baatein karna aur samne uske khilaf karna bhi amanat ko zaya karna aur apne nafs ki khayanat karna hai. Suddi farmate hain jab kisi ne Allah o Rasool ki khayanat ki to usne amanat dari mein rakhna daal diya. Ek surat iski Huzoor (ﷺ) ke zamane mein yeh bhi thi ke aap ki baat suni phir use mushrikon mein phaila diya. Pas munafiqon ke is fe'l se musalmanon ko roka ja raha hai. Phir farmata hai ke tumhare maal aur tumhari auladein tumhare imtehan ka ba'is hain, yeh dekhein aaya Allah ka shukr karte ho aur uski ita'at karte ho? Ya in mein mashghool ho kar, inki mohabbat mein phans kar Allah ki baaton aur uski ita'at se hat jate ho? Isi tarah har khair o shar se Allah apne bandon ko azmata hai. Iska irshad hai ke musalmano maal o aulad ke chakkar mein Allah ki yaad na bhool jana. Aisa karne wale nuqsan pane wale hain aur aayat mein hai ke tumhari ba'az biwiyan aur ba'az auladein tumhari dushman hain, inse hoshiyar rehna. Samajh lo ke Allah ke paas ajr yahan ke maal o aulad se bahut behtar hain aur bahut bade hain kyunke in mein se ba'az to dushman hi hote hain aur aksar be-naf'a hote hain. Allah Subhanah o Ta'ala mutasarrif o malik hai, duniya o aakhirat usi ki hai, qayamat ke sawab usi ke qabze mein hain. Ek asar mein farman-e-Ilahi hai ke ae Ibn-e-Adam mujhe dhoond tu payega, mujhe pa lena tamam cheezon ko pa lena hai, mera faut ho jana tamam cheezon ka faut ho jana hai, main teri tamam cheezon se teri mohabbat ka zyada haqdar hoon. Sahih hadith mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ka farman hai teen cheezein jis mein hon usne iman ki mithas chakh li: jise Allah aur uska Rasool sab se zyada pyara ho, jo mahz Allah ke liye dosti rakhta ho aur jise aag mein jal jane se bhi zyada bura iman ke baad kufr karna maloom hota ho. Balkeh yaad rahe ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki mohabbat bhi aulad o maal aur nafs ki mohabbat par muqaddam hai jaise ke sahih hadith se sabit hai ke aap ne farmaya: uski qasam jiske hath mein meri jaan hai ke tum mein se koi ba-iman nahin ho sakta jab tak ke main usko uske nafs se aur ahl se aur maal se aur sab logon se zyada mehboob na ho jaoon.

Allah aur uske Rasool ki khayanat na karo. Kehte hain ke yeh aayat Hazrat Abu Lubaba bin Abdul Munzir (R.A) ke bare mein utri hai. Unhein Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Banu Quraiza ke Yahudiyon ke paas bheja tha ke woh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke faisle ki shart ke manne par qila khali kardein. In Yahudiyon ne aap hi se mashwara daryaft kiya to aap ne apni gardan par hath pher kar unhein bata diya ke Huzoor ka faisla tumhare haq mein yahi hoga. Ab Hazrat Abu Lubaba (R.A) bahut hi nadim hue ke afsos main ne bahut bura kiya, Allah ki aur uske Rasool ki khayanat ki. Isi nadamat ki halat mein qasam kha baithe ke jab tak meri tauba qabool na ho main khane ka ek luqma bhi na uthaunga chahe mar hi jaaun. Masjid-e-Nabvi mein aa kar ek sutoon ke sath apne tayein bandhwa diya. Nau din isi halat mein guzar gaye, ghashi aa gayi, behosh ho kar murde ki tarah gir pade yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki tauba qabool kar li aur yeh aayatein nazil huin. Log aaye, aap ko khushkhabri sunayi aur is sutoon se kholna chaha to unhon ne farmaya, Wallah main apne tayein kisi se na khulwaunga bajuz is ke ke khud Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne hath mubarak se kholein. Chunancha aap khud tashreef laye aur apne hath se unhein khola to aap arz karne lage ke Ya Rasool Allah! Main ne nazr mani hai ke agar Allah Ta'ala meri tauba qabool kar le to main apna kul maal rah-e-lillah sadqa kar dunga. Aap ne irshad farmaya, nahin sirf ek tihayi fi sabeelillah de do, yahi kafi hai.

Hazrat Mughira bin Shuba (R.A) farmate hain ke yeh aayat Hazrat Usman (R.A) ki shahadat ke bare mein nazil hui hai. Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah ka bayan hai ke Abu Sufyan Makkah se chala, Jibraeel (A.S) ne aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko khabar di ke Abu Sufyan falan jagah hai. Aap ne sahaba se zikr kiya aur farma diya ke is taraf chalo lekin kisi ko kanon-kan khabar na karna, lekin ek munafiq ne use likh bheja ke tere pakadne ke irade se Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef la rahe hain, hoshiyar rehna. Ek asar mein farman-e-Ilahi hai ke ae Ibn-e-Adam mujhe dhoond tu payega, mujhe pa lena tamam cheezon ko pa lena hai, mera faut ho jana tamam cheezon ka faut ho jana hai, main teri tamam cheezon se teri mohabbat ka zyada haqdar hoon.
