Balkeh yaad rahe ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki mohabbat bhi aulad o maal aur nafs ki mohabbat par muqaddam hai jaise ke sahih hadith se sabit hai ke aap ne farmaya: uski qasam jiske hath mein meri jaan hai ke tum mein se koi ba-iman nahin ho sakta jab tak ke main usko uske nafs se aur ahl se aur maal se aur sab logon se zyada mehboob na ho jaoon.

Dunya-o-Akhirat ki sa'adat mandi, Furqan se murad najaat hai, dunyawi bhi aur ukhrawi bhi, aur fath-o-nusrat, ghalba-o-imtiaz bhi murad hai jis se haq-o-batil mein tameez ho jaye. Baat yehi hai ke jo Allah ki farmanbardari kare, nafarmani se bache, Allah uski madad karta hai. Jo haq-o-batil mein tameez kar leta hai, dunya-o-akhirat ki sa'adat mandi hasil kar leta hai, uske gunah mit jate hain, logon se poshida kar diye jate hain aur Allah ki taraf se ajr-o-sawab ka woh kamil mustahiq thehar jata hai. Jaise farman-e-aali shan hai: Ya ayyuhallazina amanuttaqullaha wa aminu bi rasulihi yu'tikum kiflayni min rahmatihi wa yaj'al lakum nuran tamshuna bihi wa yaghfir lakum, wallahu Ghafurur Rahim (Surah Al-Hadid: 28). Ya'ni: Aye musalmano! Allah ka darr dilon mein rakho, uske Rasool par iman lao, woh tumhein apni rahmat ke dohre hisse de ga aur tumhare liye ek noor muhayya kar de ga jis ke sath tum chalte phirte rahoge aur tumhein bakhsh bhi de ga, Allah Ghafur-o-Rahim hai.

Rasool-Allah (ﷺ) ke qatl ki napak saazish kafiron ne yehi teen iraday kiye thay jab Abu Talib ne Aap (ﷺ) se poocha ke Aap (ﷺ) ko kuffar ke raaz aur un ki posheeda chaalein maloom bhi hain? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya haan woh teen shor-o-ghul kar rahe hain. Us ne ta'ajjub ho kar poocha ke Aap (ﷺ) ko is ki khabar kis ne di? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya mere Parwardigar ne, us ne kaha Aap (ﷺ) ka Parwardigar behtareen Parwardigar hai, tum us ki khair-khwahi mein hi rehna. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya main us ki khair-khwahi kya karta woh khud meri hifazat aur bhalai karta hai. Isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai lekin is waqiye mein Abu Talib ka zikr bahut ghareeb balkay munkar hai is liye ke aayat toh Madine mein utri hai aur kafiron ka yeh mashwara hijrat ki raat tha aur yeh waqiya Abu Talib ki maut ke taqreeban teen saal ke baad ka hai. Isi ki maut ne un ki jurraton ko dobala kar diya tha, is himmat aur nusrat ke baad hi toh kafiron ne Aap (ﷺ) ki eeza-dahi par kamar bandhi thi. Chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke Quraish ke tamam qabeelon ke sardaron ne Dar-un-Nadwa mein jama hone ka irada kiya. Mal'oon Iblees unhein ek bahut baray muqatta buzurg ki surat mein mila. Unhon ne poocha Aap (ﷺ) kaun hain? Us ne kaha Ahl-e-Najd ka sheikh hoon. Mujhe maloom hua tha ke aap log aaj ek mashwaray ki gharz se jama hone walay hain, main bhi hazir hua ke is majlis mein shamil ho jaoon aur raaye mein aur khair-khwahi mein koi kami na karoon. Aakhir majlis jama hui toh us ne kaha is shakhs ke baray mein pooray ghaur-o-khauz se koi sahih raaye qaim kar lo. Wallah is ne toh sab ka naak mein dam kar diya hai. Woh dilon par kaisay qabza kar leta hai? Koi nahin jo is ki baaton ka bhookon ki tarah mushtaq na rehta ho. Wallah agar tum ne usay yahan se nikala toh woh apni sheereen-zabani aur aatish-bayani se hazarha saathi paida kar le ga aur phir jo udhar ka rukh kare ga toh tumhein chutti ka doodh yaad aa jaye ga phir toh tumharay shareefon ko teh-e-tegh kar ke tum sab ko yahan se be-k-beeni-o-dogosh nikal bahar kare ga. Sab ne kaha sheikh ji sach farmatay hain aur koi raaye pesh karo is par Abu Jahl mal'oon ne kaha ek raaye meri sun lo. Mera khayal hai ke tum sab ke zehen mein bhi yeh baat na aayi hogi, bas yehi raaye theek hai, tum is par be-khatkay amal karo. Sab ne kaha chacha bayan farmaiye! Us ne kaha har qabeelay se ek naujawan jaree bahadur shareef mana hua shakhs chun lo yeh sab naujawan ek saath is par hamla karein aur apni talwaron se is ke tukray ura dein phir toh is ke qabeelay ke log yani Bani Hashim ko yeh toh himmat na hogi Quraish ke tamam qabeelon se larein kyunke har qabeelay ka ek naujawan is ke qatl mein shareek hoga. Is ka khoon tamam qabail-e-Quraish mein bata hua hoga nachaar woh diyat lene par aamada ho jayenge, hum is bala se chhoot jayenge aur is shakhs ka khatma ho jaye ga. Ab toh sheikh tundi uchhal para aur kehne laga Allah jaanta hai wallah bas yehi ek raaye bilkul theek hai is ke siwa koi aur baat samajh mein nahin aati bas yehi karo aur is qissay ko khatam karo is se behtar koi surat nahin ho sakti.

Chunancha yeh pukhta faisla kar ke yeh majlis barkhast hui. Wahin Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur aap se farmaya aaj ki raat aap apne ghar mein apne bistare par na soyein, kafiron ne aap ke khilaf aaj meeting mein yeh tajweez tay ki hai. Chunancha aap ne yahi kiya, us raat aap apne ghar apne bistar par na lete. Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko hijrat ki ijazat de di aur aap ke Madine pahunch jaane ke baad is aayat mein apne is ehsaan ka zikr farmaya aur un ke is fareb ka zikr karte hue yeh bhi farmaya "Am yaqooloona sha'ir" (Surah At-Tur: 30), us din ka naam hi "Yaum-uz-Zahma" ho gaya. Un ke inhi iradon ka zikr aayat "Wa in kaadoo layastafizzoonaka" (Surah Bani Israel: 76) mein hai. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Makkah Sharif mein Allah ke hukum ke muntazir thay yahan tak ke Quraishiyon ne jama ho kar makr ka irada kiya. Jibraeel (A.S) ne aap ko khabar kar di aur kaha ke aaj aap is makaan mein na soyein jahan soya karte thay. Aap ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko bula kar apne bistare par apni sabz chadar orha kar letne ko farmaya aur aap bahar aaye. Quraish ke mukhtalif qabeelon ka muqarrara jatha aap ke darwaze ko ghere khara tha. Aap ne zameen se ek mutthi mitti aur kankar bhar kar un ke saron aur aankhon mein daal kar Surah Yaseen ki "Fahum la yubsiroon" (Surah Yaseen: 9) tak ki tilawat karte hue nikal gaye. Sahih Ibn-e-Hibban aur Mustadrak Hakim mein hai ke Hazrat Fatima (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas roti hui aayin, aap ne daryaft farmaya ke pyari beti kyun ro rahi ho? Arz kiya ke abba ji kaise na roun, yeh Quraish Khana-e-Kaaba mein jama hain, Laat-o-Uzza ki qasmein kha kar yeh tay kiya hai ke har qabeele ke log aap ko dekhte hi uth khare hon aur ek saath hamla kar ke qatl kar dein taake ilzaam sab par aaye aur ek balwa qarar paaye, koi khaas shakhs qatil na thahre. Aap ne farmaya beti paani lao, paani aaya, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne wuzu kiya aur Masjid-e-Haram ki taraf chale. Unhon ne aap ko dekha aur dekhte hi ghul machaya ke lo woh aa gaya utho, isi waqt un ke sar jhuk gaye, thoriyan seene se lag gayin, nigah unchi na kar sake. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek mutthi mitti ki bhar kar un ki taraf phenki aur farmaya yeh munh ulte ho jayenge, yeh chehre barbaad ho jayenge. Jis shakhs par in kankariyon mein se koi kankar para woh hi Badr wale din kufr ki halat mein qatl kiya gaya. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke Makkah mein raat ko mushrikon ka mashwara hua. Kisi ne kaha subah ko ise qaid kar do, kisi ne kaha maar daalo, kisi ne kaha des nikala de do, Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi-e-Mukarram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is par muttala farma diya. Us raat Hazrat Ali (R.A) aap ke bistare par soye aur aap Makkah se nikal khare hue. Ghaar mein ja kar baithe rahe. Mushrikeen yeh samajh kar ke khud Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne bistare par lete hue hain saari raat pehra dete rahe, subah sab kood kar andar pahunche dekha to Hazrat Ali (R.A) hain, saari tadbeer chopat ho gayi. Poocha ke tumhare saathi kahan hain? Aap ne apni la-ilmi zahir ki. Yeh log qadmon ke nishaan dekhte hue aap ke peeche peeche us pahar tak pahunch gaye. Wahan se phir koi pata na chal saka.

Pahar par charh gaye, us ghar ke paas se guzre lekin dekha ke wahan makri ka jala tana hua hai, kehne lage agar is mein jate to yeh jala kaise sabit reh jata? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne teen raatein isi ghar mein guzarein. Pas farmata hai ke unhon ne makr kiya, main bhi un se aisi mazboot chaal chala ke aaj tujhe un se bacha kar le hi aaya.

Azab-e-Ilahi na aane ka sabab: Allah ke Rasool aur Istighfar. Allah Ta'ala mushrikon ke ghuroor-o-takabbur, unki sarkashi aur na-haq shanasi ki, unki zid aur hat-dharmi ki halat bayan karta hai ke jhoot bak dete hain ke haan bhai hum ne Quran sun liya, is mein rakha kya hai. Hum khud qadir hain, agar chahein to isi jaisa kalam keh dein. Halan-ke woh keh nahin sakte. Apni aajizi aur tahi-dasti ko khoob jaante, lekin zaban se shekhi bagharte thay. Jahan Quran suna to uski qadr ghatane ke liye bak diya jab ke un se zabardast da'we ke sath kaha gaya ke lao is jaisi ek hi surat bana kar lao to sab aajiz ho gaye. Pas yeh qaul sirf jahilon ki khush-tab'i ke liye kehte thay. Kaha gaya hai ke yeh kehne wala Nasr bin Haris mal'oon tha. Yeh khabeeth Fars ke mulk gaya to tha aur Rustam-o-Isfand Yar ke qisse yaad kar aaya tha. Yahan Huzoor (ﷺ) ko nabuwwat mil chuki thi, aap logon ko Kalam-e-Allah Sharif suna rahe hote, jab aap farigh hote to yeh apni majlis jamata aur Fars ke qisse sunata, phir fakhran kehta kaho mera bayan achha hai ya Muhammad (ﷺ) ka? Yeh Badr ke din qaid ho kar laya gaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ke farman se aap ke samne is ki gardan mari gayi, falhamdulillah ise qaid karne wale Hazrat Miqdad bin Aswad (R.A) thay. Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait, Tu'aima bin Adi, Nasr bin Haris, yeh teeno isi qaid mein qatl kiye gaye. Hazrat Miqdad (R.A) ne kaha bhi ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) mera qaidi? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki kitab ke bare mein zaban darazi karta tha. Unhon ne ba'd az qatl phir kaha ke Huzoor (ﷺ) mein jise bandh kar laya hoon? Aap (ﷺ) ne dua ki ke Ya Allah apne fazl se Miqdad ko ghani kar de. Aap (R.A) khush ho gaye aur arz kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) yahi mera maqsad aur maqsood tha. Isi ke bare mein yeh aayat utri hai. Ek riwayat mein Tu'aima ki bajaye Mut'im bin Adi ka naam hai lekin yeh ghalat hai, Badr wale din woh to zinda hi na tha balkeh Huzoor (ﷺ) ka farman marwi hai ke agar aaj yeh zinda hota aur mujh se in qaidiyon ko talab karta to mein ise de deta. Is liye ke Taif se laut-te hue Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko wahi apni panah mein Makkah mein le gaya tha. Yeh kuffar kehte thay ke Quran mein siwaye pehle logon ki likhi hui kahaniyon ke kya dhara hai, inhi ko parh parh kar logon ko sunata rehta hai. Halan-ke yeh mahaz jhoot baat thi jo unhon ne ghar li thi, isi liye un ke is qaul ko naqal kar ke Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya hai ke inhe jawab de ke ise to aasman-o-zameen ki tamam ghaib baton ke janne wale ne utara hai jo Ghafoor bhi hai aur Raheem bhi hai. Tauba karne walon ki khatayein maaf farmata hai, apne samne jhukne walon par bade karam karta hai. Phir unki jahalat ka karishma bayan ho raha hai ke chahiye to yeh tha ke Allah Ta'ala se dua karte ke Ya Allah agar yeh haq hai to hamein is ki hidayat de aur is ki itteba ki taufiq naseeb farma, lekin bajaye is ke yeh dua karne lage ke hamein jald azab kar.

Baat yeh hai ke Allah ki taraf se har cheez ka waqt muqarrar hai warna is par bhi azab aa jata lekin agar tumhara yahi haal raha toh phir bhi woh din door nahin, achanak un ki be-khabri mein apne waqt par aa hi jayega. Yeh toh kaha karte thay ke hamara faisla faisle ke din se pehle hi ho jayega, bator-e-mazaq azab ke waqay hone ki darkhwast karte thay jo kafiron par aane wala hai, jise koi rok nahin sakta, jo us Allah ki taraf se hoga jo seedhiyon wala hai. Agli ummaton ke jahilon ka bhi yahi watira raha. Qaum-e-Shuaib ne kaha tha ke ae mudda'i-e-nabuwwat agar tu sacha hai toh hum par aasman ko gira de. Isi tarah in logon ne kaha. Abu Jahl waghera ne yeh dua ki thi jis ke jawab mein farmaya gaya ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki maujoodgi aur inhi mein se baaz ka istighfar Allah ke azab ki dhaal hai. Nadr bin Haris bin Kalda ne bhi yahi dua ki thi jis ka zikr 'Sa'ala Sa'il' mein hai, un ke isi qaul ka zikr aayat 'Wa Qalu Rabbana Ajjil Lana...' mein hai aur aayat 'Wa Laqad Ji'tumuna Furada...' mein hai aur aayat 'Sa'ala Sa'il...' mein hai. Garz das se oopar oopar aayatein is bayan mein hain. Amr bin Aas jang-e-Uhud mein apne ghore par sawar tha aur keh raha tha ke ae Allah agar Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka laya hua deen haq hai toh mujhe mere ghore samet zameen mein dhansa de. Go is ummat ke be-waqoofon ne yeh tamanna ki lekin Allah ne is ummat par raham farmaya aur jawab diya ke ek toh paighambar ki maujoodgi aam azab se mani' hai, dusre tum logon ka istighfar. Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke mushrik hajj mein tawaf ke waqt kehte thay 'Labbayk Allahumma Labbayk, Labbayk La Shareeka Laka', isi waqt Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate bas bas, lekin woh phir kehte 'Illa Shareekan Huwa Laka Tamlikuhu Wa Ma Malak' yani hum hazir hain ae Allah tera koi shareek nahin. Phir kehte haan woh shareek jo khud bhi teri malkiyat mein hain aur jin cheezon ke woh malik hain un ka bhi asal malik tu hi hai aur kehte 'Ghufranaka Ghufranaka' ae Allah hum tujh se istighfar karte hain ae Allah tu hamein maaf farma. Isi talab-e-bakhshish ko azab ke jald na aane ka sabab bataya gaya hai. Farmate hain in mein do sabab thay, ek toh Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) dusre istighfar, pas aap toh chal diye aur istighfar baqi reh gaya. Qurayshi aapas mein kaha karte thay ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Allah ne hum mein se hum par buzurg banaya, ae Allah agar yeh sacha hai toh tu hamein azab kar. Jab iman laye toh apne is qaul par bada hi nadim huye aur istighfar kiya, isi ka bayan dusri aayat mein hai. Pas ambiya ki maujoodgi mein qaumon par azab nahin aata, haan woh nikal jayen phir azab baras parte hain aur chunke un ki qismat mein iman tha aur baad az iman woh istighfar ahl-e-Makkah ke liye ba'is-e-amn-o-aman tha. In do wajah-e-amn mein se ek toh ab na raha, dusra ab bhi maujood hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke mujh par do amn meri ummat ke liye utre hain, ek meri maujoodgi dusre un ka istighfar, pas jab main chala jaunga toh istighfar qayamat tak ke liye in mein chor jaunga.

Ek aur hadith mein hai ke Shaitan ne kaha ae Allah mujhe teri izzat ki qasam main toh jab tak tere bandon ke jism mein rooh hai unhein behkata rahoonga. Allah Azzawajal ne farmaya mujhe bhi meri jalalat aur meri buzurgi ki qasam jab tak woh mujh se istighfar karte rahenge main bhi unhein bakhshta rahoonga (Mustadrak Hakim). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hi Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain banda Allah ke azabon se aman mein rehta hai jab tak woh Allah Azzawajal se istighfar karta hai.

Azab-e-Ilahi na aane ka sabab: Allah ke Rasool aur Istighfar. Allah Ta'ala mushrikon ke ghuroor-o-takabbur, unki sarkashi aur na-haq shanasi ki, unki zid aur hat-dharmi ki halat bayan karta hai ke jhoot bak dete hain ke haan bhai hum ne Quran sun liya, is mein rakha kya hai. Hum khud qadir hain, agar chahein to isi jaisa kalam keh dein. Halan-ke woh keh nahin sakte. Apni aajizi aur tahi-dasti ko khoob jaante, lekin zaban se shekhi bagharte thay. Jahan Quran suna to uski qadr ghatane ke liye bak diya jab ke un se zabardast da'we ke sath kaha gaya ke lao is jaisi ek hi surat bana kar lao to sab aajiz ho gaye. Pas yeh qaul sirf jahilon ki khush-tab'i ke liye kehte thay. Kaha gaya hai ke yeh kehne wala Nasr bin Haris mal'oon tha. Yeh khabeeth Fars ke mulk gaya to tha aur Rustam-o-Isfand Yar ke qisse yaad kar aaya tha. Yahan Huzoor (ﷺ) ko nabuwwat mil chuki thi, aap logon ko Kalam-e-Allah Sharif suna rahe hote, jab aap farigh hote to yeh apni majlis jamata aur Fars ke qisse sunata, phir fakhran kehta kaho mera bayan achha hai ya Muhammad (ﷺ) ka? Yeh Badr ke din qaid ho kar laya gaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ke farman se aap ke samne is ki gardan mari gayi, falhamdulillah ise qaid karne wale Hazrat Miqdad bin Aswad (R.A) thay. Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait, Tu'aima bin Adi, Nasr bin Haris, yeh teeno isi qaid mein qatl kiye gaye. Hazrat Miqdad (R.A) ne kaha bhi ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) mera qaidi? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki kitab ke bare mein zaban darazi karta tha. Unhon ne ba'd az qatl phir kaha ke Huzoor (ﷺ) mein jise bandh kar laya hoon? Aap (ﷺ) ne dua ki ke Ya Allah apne fazl se Miqdad ko ghani kar de. Aap (R.A) khush ho gaye aur arz kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) yahi mera maqsad aur maqsood tha. Isi ke bare mein yeh aayat utri hai. Ek riwayat mein Tu'aima ki bajaye Mut'im bin Adi ka naam hai lekin yeh ghalat hai, Badr wale din woh to zinda hi na tha balkeh Huzoor (ﷺ) ka farman marwi hai ke agar aaj yeh zinda hota aur mujh se in qaidiyon ko talab karta to mein ise de deta. Irshad hai ke fi-alwaq yeh kuffar azabon ke laiq hain lekin Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki maujudgi se azab ruke hue hain, chunancha aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki hijrat ke baad un par azab-e-Ilahi aaya. Badr ke din un ke tamam sardar maar dale gaye ya qaid kar diye gaye, sath hi Allah Ta'ala ne unhein istighfar ki hidayat ki ke apne shirk-o-fasad se hat jayen aur Allah se maaf talab karein. Kehte hain ke woh log maafi nahin mangte the warna azab na hota. Haan un mein jo kamzor musalman reh gaye the aur hijrat par qadir na the woh istighfar mein lage rehte the aur un ki un mein maujudgi Allah ke azabon ke rukne ka zariya thi. Chunancha Hudaibiya ke waqiye ka zikr karte hue irshad-e-Ilahi hai: "Hum-ullazina kafaru..." (Surah Al-Fath: 25), yani yeh Makkah wale hi toh woh hain jinhon ne kufr kiya aur tumhein Masjid-e-Haram se roka aur qurbani ke janwaron ko bhi na aane diya ke woh jahan the wahin ruke khade rahe aur apne halaal hone ki jagah na pahunch sake. Agar shehar-e-Makkah mein kuch musalman mard aur kuch musalman auratein aisi na hotin ke tum un ke haal se waqif nahin the, aur ain mumkin tha ke ladai ki surat mein tum unhein bhi pamal kar dalte aur nadanista un ki taraf se tumhein nuqsan pahunch jata toh beshak tumhein usi waqt ladai ki ijazat mil jati. Us waqt ki sulah is liye hai ke Allah jise chahe apni rahmat mein le le. Agar Makkah mein ruke hue musalman wahan se kahin tal jate toh yaqeenan un kafiron ko dardnak maar mari jati. Pas Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki maujudgi Ahl-e-Makkah ke liye bais-e-amn rahi, phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki hijrat ke baad jo zaeef musalman wahan reh gaye the aur istighfar karte rahe the, un ki maujudgi ki wajah se azab na aaya. Jab woh bhi Makkah se nikal gaye tab yeh aayat utri ke ab koi mani baqi na raha, pas musalmanon ko Makkah par charhai karne ki ijazat mil gayi aur yeh matooh hue. Haan ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke agar murad un ka khud ka istighfar ho toh is aayat ne pehli aayat ko mansookh kar diya. Chunancha Hasan Basri (R.H) waghera ka yeh qaul bhi hai ke Ahl-e-Makkah se jang bhi hui, unhein zarb bhi pahunche, un par qahat-saliyan bhi aayin, pas in mushrikon ka is aayat mein istisna kar liya gaya hai. Unhein Allah ke azab kyun na hon? Yeh momin logon ko Ka'batullah mein namaz padhne se rokte hain jo momin bajah apni kamzori ke ab tak Makkah mein hi hain aur un ke siwa aur mominon ko bhi tawaf-o-namaz se rokte hain halankeh asal ahliyat in hi mein hai. In mushrikon mein is ki ahliyat nahin, jaise farman hai: "Ma kana lil-mushrikina an ya'muru masajid-Allah..." (Surah At-Tawbah: 17), mushrikeen Allah ke gharon ki abadi ke ahl nahin, woh toh kufr mein mubtala hain, un ke aamal akarat hain aur woh hamesha ke jahannami hain. Masjidon ki abadi ke ahl Allah par, Qayamat par iman rakhne wale, namazi, zakat ada karne wale, sirf khauf-e-Ilahi rakhne wale hi hain aur wohi rah-yafta log hain aur aayat mein hai ke rah-e-Rabb se rokna, Allah ke sath kufr karna, Masjid-e-Haram ki be-hurmati karna aur is ke laiq logon ko is se nikalna Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek bahut bada jurm hai.

Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya gaya ke aap ke dost kaun hain? Aap ne farmaya har ek parhezgar Allah se darne wala. Phir aap ne parha: "In auliya-u-illa-al-muttaqun". Mustadrak Hakim mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Quraishiyon ko jama kiya, phir poocha ke tum mein is waqt koi aur to nahin? Unhon ne kaha behnon ki aulad aur haleef aur maula hain. Farmaya yeh teeno to tum mein se hi hain. Suno tum mein se mere dost wahi hain jo taqwe aur parhezgari wale hon. Pas Allah ke auliya Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain aur aap ke as-haab (Razi Allahu Anhum / R.A) aur kul mujahid khwah woh koi ho aur kahin ke hon. Phir un ki ek aur shararat aur bedhanga pan bayan farmata hai. Kaabe mein aa kar kya karte hain? Ya to janwaron ki si seetiyan bajate hain, munh mein ungliyan rakhein aur seetiyan shuru karein ya taliyan peetne lage. Tawaf karte hain to nangay ho kar, rukhsar jhuka kar, seeti bajayi, tali bajayi, chaliye namaz ho gayi. Kabhi rukhsar zameen par latka liya. Bayin taraf se tawaf kiya. Yeh bhi maqsood tha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki namaz bigadein, mominon ka mazaq udayein, logon ko rah-e-Rabb se rokein. Ab apne kufr ka bharpoor phal chakho, Badr ke din qaid ho ke qatl hue, talwar chali, cheekh aur zalzale aaye.

Irshad hai ke fi-alwaq yeh kuffar azabon ke laiq hain lekin Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki maujudgi se azab ruke hue hain, chunancha aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki hijrat ke baad un par azab-e-Ilahi aaya. Badr ke din un ke tamam sardar maar dale gaye ya qaid kar diye gaye, sath hi Allah Ta'ala ne unhein istighfar ki hidayat ki ke apne shirk-o-fasad se hat jayen aur Allah se maaf talab karein. Kehte hain ke woh log maafi nahin mangte the warna azab na hota. Haan un mein jo kamzor musalman reh gaye the aur hijrat par qadir na the woh istighfar mein lage rehte the aur un ki un mein maujudgi Allah ke azabon ke rukne ka zariya thi. Chunancha Hudaibiya ke waqiye ka zikr karte hue irshad-e-Ilahi hai: "Hum-ullazina kafaru..." (Surah Al-Fath: 25), yani yeh Makkah wale hi toh woh hain jinhon ne kufr kiya aur tumhein Masjid-e-Haram se roka aur qurbani ke janwaron ko bhi na aane diya ke woh jahan the wahin ruke khade rahe aur apne halaal hone ki jagah na pahunch sake. Agar shehar-e-Makkah mein kuch musalman mard aur kuch musalman auratein aisi na hotin ke tum un ke haal se waqif nahin the, aur ain mumkin tha ke ladai ki surat mein tum unhein bhi pamal kar dalte aur nadanista un ki taraf se tumhein nuqsan pahunch jata toh beshak tumhein usi waqt ladai ki ijazat mil jati. Us waqt ki sulah is liye hai ke Allah jise chahe apni rahmat mein le le. Agar Makkah mein ruke hue musalman wahan se kahin tal jate toh yaqeenan un kafiron ko dardnak maar mari jati. Pas Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki maujudgi Ahl-e-Makkah ke liye bais-e-amn rahi, phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki hijrat ke baad jo zaeef musalman wahan reh gaye the aur istighfar karte rahe the, un ki maujudgi ki wajah se azab na aaya. Jab woh bhi Makkah se nikal gaye tab yeh aayat utri ke ab koi mani baqi na raha, pas musalmanon ko Makkah par charhai karne ki ijazat mil gayi aur yeh matooh hue. Haan ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke agar murad un ka khud ka istighfar ho toh is aayat ne pehli aayat ko mansookh kar diya. Chunancha Hasan Basri (R.H) waghera ka yeh qaul bhi hai ke Ahl-e-Makkah se jang bhi hui, unhein zarb bhi pahunche, un par qahat-saliyan bhi aayin, pas in mushrikon ka is aayat mein istisna kar liya gaya hai. Unhein Allah ke azab kyun na hon? Yeh momin logon ko Ka'batullah mein namaz padhne se rokte hain jo momin bajah apni kamzori ke ab tak Makkah mein hi hain aur un ke siwa aur mominon ko bhi tawaf-o-namaz se rokte hain halankeh asal ahliyat in hi mein hai. In mushrikon mein is ki ahliyat nahin, jaise farman hai: "Ma kana lil-mushrikina an ya'muru masajid-Allah..." (Surah At-Tawbah: 17), mushrikeen Allah ke gharon ki abadi ke ahl nahin, woh toh kufr mein mubtala hain, un ke aamal akarat hain aur woh hamesha ke jahannami hain. Masjidon ki abadi ke ahl Allah par, Qayamat par iman rakhne wale, namazi, zakat ada karne wale, sirf khauf-e-Ilahi rakhne wale hi hain aur wohi rah-yafta log hain aur aayat mein hai ke rah-e-Rabb se rokna, Allah ke sath kufr karna, Masjid-e-Haram ki be-hurmati karna aur is ke laiq logon ko is se nikalna Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek bahut bada jurm hai.

Yeh bhi maqsood tha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki namaz bigadein, mominon ka mazaq udayein, logon ko rah-e-Rabb se rokein. Ab apne kufr ka bharpoor phal chakho, Badr ke din qaid ho ke qatl hue, talwar chali, cheekh aur zalzale aaye.

Shikast khorda kuffar ki sazishain: Quraishiyon ko Badr mein shikast-e-fash hui, apne murday aur apne qaidi musalmanon ke hathon mein chhor kar bhaag kharay huay. Abu Sufyan apna qafila aur maal-o-mata'a le kar pohancha toh Abdullah bin Abi Rabia, Ikrama bin Abi Jahl, Safwan bin Umayya aur woh log jin ke aziz-o-aqarib is larai mein kaam aaye thay Abu Sufyan ke paas pohanchay aur kaha ke aap dekhte hain hamari kya durgat hui? Ab agar aap razamand hon toh yeh sara maal rok liya jaye aur isi khazanay se dusri jang ki tayari wasee paimanay par ki jaye aur unhein maza chakhaya jaye. Chunancha yeh baat maan li gayi aur pukhta ho gayi, isi par yeh aayat utri ke kharch karo warna yeh bhi gharat jaye ga aur dobara munh ki khao ge. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke yeh aayat bhi Badr ke baray mein utri hai. Alfaaz-e-aayat ke aam hain go sabab-e-nuzool khaas ho. Haq ko rokne ke liye jo bhi maal kharch kare woh aakhir nadamat ke sath reh jaye ga. Deen ka charagh insani phonkon se bujh nahin sakta. Is khwahish ka anjam namuradi hi hai. Khud Allah Ta'ala apne deen ka nasir aur hafiz hai. Is ka kalma buland hoga, is ka bol bala hoga, is ka deen ghalib hoga, kuffar munh dekhte reh jayenge. Duniya mein alag ruswai aur zillat hogi, aakhirat mein alag barbadi aur khwari hogi. Jeetay ji ya toh apne samnay apni pasti, zillat, nikbat-o-adbar aur khwari dekh lenge ya marnay par azab-e-naar dekh lenge. Pasti-o-ghulami ki maar aur shikast un ke mathay par likh di gayi hai. Phir aakhri thikana Jahannam hai taake Allah Ta'ala shaqi aur sa'eed ko alag alag kar de. Buray aur bhalay ko mumtaz kar de. Yeh tafreeq aur imtiyaz aakhirat mein hogi aur duniya mein bhi. Farman hai: Summa naqulu lillazina ashraku... (Al-Aayat), Qayamat ke din hum kafiron se kahenge ke tum aur tumhare mabood yahin isi jagah tharay raho. Aur aayat mein hai: Qayamat ke din yeh sab juda juda ho jayenge. Aur aayat mein hai: Us din yeh mumtaz ho jayenge. Aur aayat mein hai: Wamtaazul yauma ayyuhal mujrimun (Surah Yaseen: 59), aye gunahgaro! Tum aaj nek karon se alag ho jao. Isi tarah duniya mein bhi ek dusre se bilkul mumtaz thay. Mominon ke aamaal un ke apne hain aur un se bilkul juda gana. Laam-e-ta'leel ho sakta hai, yani kafir apne maalon ko Allah ki rah ki rok ke liye kharch karte hain taake momin-o-kafir mein alaihadgi ho jaye ke kaun Allah ka farmanbardar hai aur kaun nafarmani mein mumtaz hai? Chunancha farman hai: Wama asabakum yaumal taqal jam'ani... (Surah Al-Imran: 166), yani dono lashkaron ki mud-bher ke waqt jo kuch tum se hua woh Allah ke hukum se tha taake mominon aur munafiqon mein tameez ho jaye. Un se jab kaha gaya ke aao rah-e-haq mein jihad karo ya dushmanon ko dafa karo toh unhon ne jawab diya ke agar hum funoon-e-jang se waqif hotay toh zaroor tumhara sath dete. Aur aayat mein hai: Ma kanallahu liyazaral mu'mineena 'ala ma antum 'alaihi... (Surah Al-Imran: 179), yani Allah Ta'ala tumhein tumhari maujooda halaton par hi chhorne wala nahin, woh paak aur paleed ko alaihada alaihada karne wala hai. Yeh hi nahin ke Allah tumhein apne ghaib par khabardar kar de.

Farman hai: Am hasibtum an tadkhulul jannata al-ayah, kya tum yeh guman kiye baithe ho ke yunhi jannat mein chale jaoge halanke ab tak toh Allah Ta'ala ne tum mein se mujahideen ko aur sabr karne walon ko khullam khulla zahir nahin kiya. Surah Bara'at mein bhi isi jaisi ayat majood hai, toh matlab yeh hua ke hum ne tumhein kafiron ke hathon mein is liye mubtala kiya hai aur is liye unhein apne maal batil mein kharch karne par lagaya hai ke nek-o-bad ki tameez ho jaye. Khabees ko khabees se mila kar jama kar ke jahannam mein daal de. Dunya-o-akhirat mein yeh log barbad hain.

Fitne ke ikhtitam tak jihad jaari rakho. Kaafiron se keh de ke agar woh apne kufr se aur zid se baaz aa jayain, Islam aur ita'at qabool kar lain, Rabb ki taraf jhuk jayain to un se jo ho chuka hai sab maaf kar diya jaye ga, kufr bhi, khata bhi, gunah bhi. Hadith mein hai jo shakhs Islam la kar nekiyan kare woh apne jahiliyat ke a'maal par pakda na jaye ga aur Islam mein bhi phir buraiyan kare to agli pichli tamam khataon par us ki pakad hogi aur hadith mein hai Islam se pehle ke sab gunah maaf hain, tauba bhi apne se pehle ke gunah ko mita deti hai. Phir farmata hai ke agar yeh na manain aur apne kufr par qaim rahein to woh aglon ki halat dekh lein ke hum ne unhein un ke kufr ki wajah se kaisa gharat kiya? Abhi Badri kuffar ka hashr bhi un ke samne hai. Jab tak fitna baqi hai tum jang jaari rakho. Ek shakhs ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se kaha ke aayat (وَ اِنْ طَاۗىِٕفَتٰنِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ اقْتَتَلُوْا فَاَصْلِحُوْا بَيْنَهُمَا ۚ فَاِنْۢ بَغَتْ اِحْدٰىهُمَا عَلَي الْاُخْرٰى فَقَاتِلُوا الَّتِيْ تَبْغِيْ حَتّٰى تَفِيْۗءَ اِلٰٓى اَمْرِ اللّٰهِ ۚ فَاِنْ فَاۗءَتْ فَاَصْلِحُوْا بَيْنَهُمَا بالْعَدْلِ وَاَقْسِطُوْا ۭ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Hujurat: 9), ko pesh-e-nazar rakh kar aap us waqt ki bahami jang mein shirkat kyun nahin karte? Aap ne farmaya tum logon ka yeh ta'ana is se bahut halka hai ke main kisi momin ko qatl kar ke jahannami ban jaaun jaise farman-e-Ilahi hai "Wa man yaqtul mominan muta'ammidan" al-kh. Us ne kaha Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ke fitna baqi ho tab tak ladai jaari rakho. Aap ne farmaya yahi hum ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane mein kiya. Us waqt musalman kam thay, unhein kaafir giraftar kar lete thay aur deen mein fitne daalte thay ya to qatl kar daalte thay ya qaid kar lete thay. Jab musalman badh gaye woh fitna jata raha. Us ne jab dekha ke aap maante nahin to kaha achha Hazrat Ali aur Hazrat Usman ke bare mein kya khayal rakhte hain? Aap ne farmaya Hazrat Usman ko Allah ne maaf farmaya lekin tumhein Allah ki woh maafi buri maloom hoti hai. Hazrat Ali Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke chacha zaad bhai thay aur aap ke damad thay, yeh hain aap ki sahibzadi, yeh kehte hue un ke makan ki taraf ishara kiya. Ibn-e-Umar ek martaba logon ke paas aaye to kisi ne kaha ke is fitne ke waqt ki ladai ki nisbat janab ka kya khayal hai? Aap ne farmaya jaante bhi ho fitne se kya murad hai? Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kaafiron se jang karte thay, us waqt un ka zor tha, un mein jana fitna tha, tumhari to yeh mulki ladaiyan hain. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair ke zamane mein do shakhs Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ke paas aaye aur kehne lage ke log jo kuch kar rahe hain woh aap ke samne hai, aap Hazrat Umar ke sahibzade aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sahabi hain. Aap kyun maidan-e-jang mein nahin utre? Farmaya is liye ke Allah ne har momin ka khoon haram kar diya hai. Unhon ne kaha kya fitne ke baqi rehne tak ladna Allah ka hukum nahin?

Aap ne farmaya hai aur hum ne ise nibhaya bhi yahan tak ke fitna door ho gaya aur deen sab Allah hi ka ho gaya, ab tum apni is bahami jang se fitna khada karna aur ghair-Allah ke deen ke liye ho jana chahte ho. Zul-Sabatain Hazrat Usama bin Zaid (R.A) ka farman hai main hargiz us shakhs se jang na karunga jo La ilaha illallah ka qail ho. Hazrat Sa'ad bin Malik (R.A) ne yeh sun kar us ki ta'eed ki aur farmaya main bhi yahi kehta hoon to un par bhi yahi aayat pesh ki gayi aur yahi jawab aap ne bhi diya. Baqol Ibn Abbas (R.H) wa ghaira fitna se murad shirk hai aur yeh bhi ke musalmanon ki kamzori aisi na rahe ke koi unhein un ke sachay deen se murtad karne ki taqat rakhay. Deen sab Allah ka ho jaye yani tauheed nikhar jaye, La ilaha illallah ka kalma zabanon par charh jaye, shirk aur maboodan-e-batil ki parastish uth jaye. Tumhare deen ke sath kufr baqi na rahe. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe hukum farmaya gaya hai ke main logon se jihad jari rakhun yahan tak ke woh La ilaha illallah keh lein, jab woh ise keh lenge to mujh se apni janen aur apne maal bacha lenge, haan haq-e-Islam ke sath aur un ka hisab Allah Ta'ala ke zimme hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya gaya ke ek shakhs apni bahaduri ke liye, ek shakhs ghairat ke liye, ek shakhs riya-kari ke liye ladai kar raha hai to Allah ki rah mein in mein se kaun hai? Aap ne farmaya jo Allah ke kalmay ko buland karne ki gharz se jihad kare woh Allah ki rah mein hai. Phir farmaya ke agar tumhare jihad ki wajah se yeh apne kufr se baaz aa jayen to tum un se ladai mauqoof kar do, un ke dilon ka haal supurd-e-Rabb kar do. Allah un ke aamal ka dekhne wala hai. Jaise farman hai (Fa-in tabu wa aqamu-s-salata wa ataw-uz-zakata fa-khallu sabeelahum, innallaha Ghafurur-Rahim) (Surah At-Tawbah: 5), yani agar yeh tauba kar lein aur namazi aur zakat dene wale ban jayen to un ki rah chhor do, un ke rastay na roko. Aur aayat mein hai ke is surat mein woh tumhare deeni bhai hain aur aayat mein hai ke un se laro yahan tak ke fitna baqi na rahe aur deen Allah ka ho jaye, phir agar woh baaz aa jayen to ziyadati ka badla to sirf zalimon ke liye hi hai. Ek sahih riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Usama (R.A) ek shakhs par talwar le kar charh gaye, jab woh zad mein aa gaya aur dekha ke talwar chala chahti hai to us ne jaldi se La ilaha illallah keh diya lekin us ke sar par talwar par gayi aur woh qatl ho gaya. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is waqiye ka bayan hua to aap ne Hazrat Usama (R.A) se farmaya kya tu ne ise us ke La ilaha illallah kehne ke baad qatl kiya? Tu La ilaha illallah ke sath Qayamat ke din kya karega? Hazrat Usama (R.A) ne arz kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah! Yeh to us ne sirf apne bachao ke liye kaha tha. Aap ne farmaya kya tu ne us ka dil cheer kar dekha tha? Bata kaun hoga jo Qayamat ke din La ilaha illallah ka muqabla kare.

Baar baar aap yahi farmate rahe yahan tak ke Hazrat Usama R.A farmate hain mere dil mein khayal aane laga ke kaash ke main aaj ke din se pehle musalman hi na hua hota? Phir farmata hai ke agar yeh ab bhi baaz na rahein tumhari mukhalifat aur tum se ladai na chhorein toh tum yaqeen mano ke Allah Ta'ala tumhara mawala, tumhara maalik, tumhara madadgar aur nasir hai. Woh tumhein un par ghalib karega. Woh behtareen mawla aur behtareen madadgar hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke Abdul Malik bin Marwan ne Hazrat Urwa se kuch baatein daryaft ki thin jis ke jawab mein aap ne unhein likha salam-e-alaik ke baad main aap ke samne us Allah ki tareefein karta hoon jis ke siwa koi mabood-e-barhaq nahin. Baad hamd-o-salat ke aap ka khat mila aap ne hijrat-e-Rasoolullah ﷺ ki babat mujh se sawal kiya hai main aap ko is waqiye ki khabar likhta hoon. Allah hi ki madad par khair karna aur shar se rokna mauqoof hai. Makkah Sharif se aap ke tashreef le jaane ka waqiya yun hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko nabuwwat di, SubhanAllah kaise achhe peshwa behtareen rehnuma thay, Allah aap ko jazaye khair ata farmaye hamein jannat mein aap ki ziyarat naseeb farmaye hamein aap hi ke deen par zinda rakhe isi par maut de aur isi par Qayamat ke din khada kare, Ameen. Jab aap ne apni qoum ko hidayat aur noor ki taraf dawat di jo Allah ne aap ko ata farmaya tha toh shuru shuru toh unhein kuch zyada bura nahin maloom hua balki qareeb tha ke aap ki baatein sunne lagein magar jab un ke maboodan-e-batil ka zikr aaya us waqt woh bigad baithe, aap ki baton ka bura manne lage, aap par sakhti karne lage, isi zamane mein Taif ke chand Quraishi maal le kar pohanche woh bhi un ke shareek-e-haal ho gaye, ab aap ki baton ke manne wale musalmanon ko tarah tarah se satane lage jis ki wajah se aam log aap ke is aane jaane se hat gaye bajuz un chand hastiyon ke jo Allah ki hifazat mein thin yahi halat ek arsay tak rahi jab tak ke musalmanon ki tadaad ki kami ziyadati ki had tak nahin pohanchi thi. Phir sardaran-e-kufr ne aapas mein mashwara kiya ke jitne log iman la chuke hain un par aur zyada sakhti ki jaye jo jis ka rishtedar aur qareebi ho woh use har tarah tang kare taake woh Rasool-e-Akram ﷺ ka sath chhor dein ab fitna barh gaya aur baaz log un ki sazaon ki taab na la kar un ki haan mein haan milane lage. Khare aur sabit qadam log deen-e-haq par is museebat ke zamane mein bhi jame rahe aur Allah ne unhein mazboot kar diya aur mehfooz rakh liya. Aakhir jab takleefein had se guzarne lagein toh Rasool-e-Maqbool ﷺ ne unhein Habsha ki taraf hijrat kar jaane ki ijazat de di. Habsha ka badshah Najashi ek nek aadmi tha us ki saltanat zulm-o-ziyadati se khali thi har taraf us ki tareefein ho rahi thin. Yeh jagah Quraish ki tijarati mandi thi jahan un ke tajir raha karte thay aur be-khauf-o-khatar bari bari tijartein kiya karte thay.

Pas jo log yahan Makkah Sharif mein kafiron ke hathon bahut tang aa gaye thay aur ab museebat jhelne ke qabil nahin rahe thay aur har waqt unhein apne deen ke apne hath se chhoot jaane ka khatra laga rehta tha woh sab Habsha chale gaye. Lekin khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yahin thehre rahe. Is par bhi jab kayi saal guzar gaye toh yahan Allah ke fazl se musalmanon ki tadaad khasi ho gayi, Islam phail gaya aur sharif aur sardar log bhi islami jhande tale aa gaye, yeh dekh kar kufr ko apni dushmani ka josh thanda karna pada. Woh zulm-o-ziyadati se bilkul toh nahin lekin kuch na kuch ruk gaye. Pas woh fitna jiske zalzalon ne Sahaba (R.A) ko watan chhodne aur Habsha jaane par majboor kiya tha uske kuch dab jaane ki khabron ne Muhajireen-e-Habsha ko phir aamada kiya ke woh Makkah Sharif wapas chale aayein. Chunancha woh bhi thode bahut aa gaye. Isi asna mein Madinah Sharif ke chand Ansar musalman ho gaye. Unki wajah se Madinah Sharif mein bhi isha'at-e-Islam hone lagi. Unka Makkah Sharif aana jaana shuru hua, is se Makkah wale kuch bigde aur bipharkar irada kar liya ke dobara sakht sakhti karein, chunancha dusri martaba phir fitna shuru hua. Hijrat-e-Habash par pehle fitne ne aamada kiya, wapsi par phir fitna phaila. Ab sattar buzurg sardar-e-Madinah yahan aaye aur musalman ho kar Aan-Hazrat Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hath par bai'at ki. Mausam-e-Hajj ke mauqa par yeh aaye thay. Quba mein unhon ne bai'at ki, ahd-o-paiman, qaul-o-qarar huye ke hum aap ke aur aap hamare. Agar koi bhi aap ka aadmi hamare han aa jaye toh hum uske amn-o-aman ke zimmedar hain, khud aap agar tashreef layein toh hum jaan maal se aap ke sath hain. Is cheez ne Quraish ko aur bhadka diya aur unhon ne za'eef aur kamzor musalmanon ko aur satana shuru kar diya. Unki sazayein badha dein aur khoon ke pyase ho gaye. Is par Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein ijazat de di ke woh Madinah Sharif ki taraf hijrat kar jayein. Yeh tha aakhri aur intehai fitna jis ne na sirf Sahaba-e-Kiram (R.A) ko hi nikala balkeh khud Allah ke mohtaram Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi Makkah ko khali kar gaye. Yehi hai woh jise Allah farmata hai un se jihad jaari rakho yahan tak ke fitna mit jaye aur sara deen Allah ka hi ho jaye. Alhamdulillah nauwein pare ki tafsir bhi khatam hui. Allah Ta'ala ise qabool farmaye.

Fitne ke ikhtitam tak jihad jaari rakho. Kaafiron se keh de ke agar woh apne kufr se aur zid se baaz aa jayain, Islam aur ita'at qabool kar lain, Rabb ki taraf jhuk jayain to un se jo ho chuka hai sab maaf kar diya jaye ga, kufr bhi, khata bhi, gunah bhi. Hadith mein hai jo shakhs Islam la kar nekiyan kare woh apne jahiliyat ke a'maal par pakda na jaye ga aur Islam mein bhi phir buraiyan kare to agli pichli tamam khataon par us ki pakad hogi aur hadith mein hai Islam se pehle ke sab gunah maaf hain, tauba bhi apne se pehle ke gunah ko mita deti hai. Phir farmata hai ke agar yeh na manain aur apne kufr par qaim rahein to woh aglon ki halat dekh lein ke hum ne unhein un ke kufr ki wajah se kaisa gharat kiya? Abhi Badri kuffar ka hashr bhi un ke samne hai. Jab tak fitna baqi hai tum jang jaari rakho. Ek shakhs ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se kaha ke aayat (وَ اِنْ طَاۗىِٕفَتٰنِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ اقْتَتَلُوْا فَاَصْلِحُوْا بَيْنَهُمَا ۚ فَاِنْۢ بَغَتْ اِحْدٰىهُمَا عَلَي الْاُخْرٰى فَقَاتِلُوا الَّتِيْ تَبْغِيْ حَتّٰى تَفِيْۗءَ اِلٰٓى اَمْرِ اللّٰهِ ۚ فَاِنْ فَاۗءَتْ فَاَصْلِحُوْا بَيْنَهُمَا بالْعَدْلِ وَاَقْسِطُوْا ۭ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Hujurat: 9), ko pesh-e-nazar rakh kar aap us waqt ki bahami jang mein shirkat kyun nahin karte? Us ne kaha Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ke fitna baqi ho tab tak ladai jaari rakho. Aap ne farmaya yahi hum ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane mein kiya. Us waqt musalman kam thay, unhein kaafir giraftar kar lete thay aur deen mein fitne daalte thay ya to qatl kar daalte thay ya qaid kar lete thay. Jab musalman badh gaye woh fitna jata raha. Us ne jab dekha ke aap maante nahin to kaha achha Hazrat Ali aur Hazrat Usman ke bare mein kya khayal rakhte hain? Aap ne farmaya Hazrat Usman ko Allah ne maaf farmaya lekin tumhein Allah ki woh maafi buri maloom hoti hai. Hazrat Ali Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke chacha zaad bhai thay aur aap ke damad thay, yeh hain aap ki sahibzadi, yeh kehte hue un ke makan ki taraf ishara kiya. Ibn-e-Umar ek martaba logon ke paas aaye to kisi ne kaha ke is fitne ke waqt ki ladai ki nisbat janab ka kya khayal hai? Aap ne farmaya jaante bhi ho fitne se kya murad hai? Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kaafiron se jang karte thay, us waqt un ka zor tha, un mein jana fitna tha, tumhari to yeh mulki ladaiyan hain. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair ke zamane mein do shakhs Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ke paas aaye aur kehne lage ke log jo kuch kar rahe hain woh aap ke samne hai, aap Hazrat Umar ke sahibzade aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sahabi hain. Aap kyun maidan-e-jang mein nahin utre? Farmaya is liye ke Allah ne har momin ka khoon haram kar diya hai. Unhon ne kaha kya fitne ke baqi rehne tak ladna Allah ka hukum nahin?

Aap ne farmaya hai aur hum ne ise nibhaya bhi yahan tak ke fitna door ho gaya aur deen sab Allah hi ka ho gaya, ab tum apni is bahami jang se fitna khada karna aur ghair-Allah ke deen ke liye ho jana chahte ho. Baqol Ibn Abbas (R.H) wa ghaira fitna se murad shirk hai aur yeh bhi ke musalmanon ki kamzori aisi na rahe ke koi unhein un ke sachay deen se murtad karne ki taqat rakhay. Deen sab Allah ka ho jaye yani tauheed nikhar jaye, La ilaha illallah ka kalma zabanon par charh jaye, shirk aur maboodan-e-batil ki parastish uth jaye. Tumhare deen ke sath kufr baqi na rahe. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe hukum farmaya gaya hai ke main logon se jihad jari rakhun yahan tak ke woh La ilaha illallah keh lein, jab woh ise keh lenge to mujh se apni janen aur apne maal bacha lenge, haan haq-e-Islam ke sath aur un ka hisab Allah Ta'ala ke zimme hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya gaya ke ek shakhs apni bahaduri ke liye, ek shakhs ghairat ke liye, ek shakhs riya-kari ke liye ladai kar raha hai to Allah ki rah mein in mein se kaun hai? Aap ne farmaya jo Allah ke kalmay ko buland karne ki gharz se jihad kare woh Allah ki rah mein hai. Phir farmaya ke agar tumhare jihad ki wajah se yeh apne kufr se baaz aa jayen to tum un se ladai mauqoof kar do, un ke dilon ka haal supurd-e-Rabb kar do. Allah un ke aamal ka dekhne wala hai. Jaise farman hai (Fa-in tabu wa aqamu-s-salata wa ataw-uz-zakata fa-khallu sabeelahum, innallaha Ghafurur-Rahim) (Surah At-Tawbah: 5), yani agar yeh tauba kar lein aur namazi aur zakat dene wale ban jayen to un ki rah chhor do, un ke rastay na roko. Ek shakhs ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se kaha ke aayat (وَ اِنْ طَاۗىِٕفَتٰنِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ اقْتَتَلُوْا فَاَصْلِحُوْا بَيْنَهُمَا ۚ فَاِنْۢ بَغَتْ اِحْدٰىهُمَا عَلَي الْاُخْرٰى فَقَاتِلُوا الَّتِيْ تَبْغِيْ حَتّٰى تَفِيْۗءَ اِلٰٓى اَمْرِ اللّٰهِ ۚ فَاِنْ فَاۗءَتْ فَاَصْلِحُوْا بَيْنَهُمَا بالْعَدْلِ وَاَقْسِطُوْا ۭ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Hujurat: 9), ko pesh-e-nazar rakh kar aap us waqt ki bahami jang mein shirkat kyun nahin karte? Aap ne farmaya tum logon ka yeh ta'ana is se bahut halka hai ke main kisi momin ko qatl kar ke jahannami ban jaaun jaise farman-e-Ilahi hai "Wa man yaqtul mominan muta'ammidan" al-kh. Us ne kaha Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ke fitna baqi ho tab tak ladai jaari rakho. Aap ne farmaya yahi hum ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane mein kiya. Us waqt musalman kam thay, unhein kaafir giraftar kar lete thay aur deen mein fitne daalte thay ya to qatl kar daalte thay ya qaid kar lete thay. Jab musalman badh gaye woh fitna jata raha. Us ne jab dekha ke aap maante nahin to kaha achha Hazrat Ali aur Hazrat Usman ke bare mein kya khayal rakhte hain? Aap ne farmaya Hazrat Usman ko Allah ne maaf farmaya lekin tumhein Allah ki woh maafi buri maloom hoti hai. Hazrat Ali Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke chacha zaad bhai thay aur aap ke damad thay, yeh hain aap ki sahibzadi, yeh kehte hue un ke makan ki taraf ishara kiya. Ibn-e-Umar ek martaba logon ke paas aaye to kisi ne kaha ke is fitne ke waqt ki ladai ki nisbat janab ka kya khayal hai? Aap ne farmaya jaante bhi ho fitne se kya murad hai? Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kaafiron se jang karte thay, us waqt un ka zor tha, un mein jana fitna tha, tumhari to yeh mulki ladaiyan hain. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair ke zamane mein do shakhs Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ke paas aaye aur kehne lage ke log jo kuch kar rahe hain woh aap ke samne hai, aap Hazrat Umar ke sahibzade aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sahabi hain. Aap kyun maidan-e-jang mein nahin utre? Farmaya is liye ke Allah ne har momin ka khoon haram kar diya hai. Unhon ne kaha kya fitne ke baqi rehne tak ladna Allah ka hukum nahin?

Aap ne farmaya hai aur hum ne ise nibhaya bhi yahan tak ke fitna door ho gaya aur deen sab Allah hi ka ho gaya, ab tum apni is bahami jang se fitna khada karna aur ghair-Allah ke deen ke liye ho jana chahte ho. Zul-Sabatain Hazrat Usama bin Zaid (R.A) ka farman hai main hargiz us shakhs se jang na karunga jo La ilaha illallah ka qail ho. Hazrat Sa'ad bin Malik (R.A) ne yeh sun kar us ki ta'eed ki aur farmaya main bhi yahi kehta hoon to un par bhi yahi aayat pesh ki gayi aur yahi jawab aap ne bhi diya. Baqol Ibn Abbas (R.H) wa ghaira fitna se murad shirk hai aur yeh bhi ke musalmanon ki kamzori aisi na rahe ke koi unhein un ke sachay deen se murtad karne ki taqat rakhay. Deen sab Allah ka ho jaye yani tauheed nikhar jaye, La ilaha illallah ka kalma zabanon par charh jaye, shirk aur maboodan-e-batil ki parastish uth jaye. Tumhare deen ke sath kufr baqi na rahe. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe hukum farmaya gaya hai ke main logon se jihad jari rakhun yahan tak ke woh La ilaha illallah keh lein, jab woh ise keh lenge to mujh se apni janen aur apne maal bacha lenge, haan haq-e-Islam ke sath aur un ka hisab Allah Ta'ala ke zimme hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya gaya ke ek shakhs apni bahaduri ke liye, ek shakhs ghairat ke liye, ek shakhs riya-kari ke liye ladai kar raha hai to Allah ki rah mein in mein se kaun hai? Aap ne farmaya jo Allah ke kalmay ko buland karne ki gharz se jihad kare woh Allah ki rah mein hai. Phir farmaya ke agar tumhare jihad ki wajah se yeh apne kufr se baaz aa jayen to tum un se ladai mauqoof kar do, un ke dilon ka haal supurd-e-Rabb kar do. Allah un ke aamal ka dekhne wala hai. Jaise farman hai (Fa-in tabu wa aqamu-s-salata wa ataw-uz-zakata fa-khallu sabeelahum, innallaha Ghafurur-Rahim) (Surah At-Tawbah: 5), yani agar yeh tauba kar lein aur namazi aur zakat dene wale ban jayen to un ki rah chhor do, un ke rastay na roko. Aur aayat mein hai ke is surat mein woh tumhare deeni bhai hain aur aayat mein hai ke un se laro yahan tak ke fitna baqi na rahe aur deen Allah ka ho jaye, phir agar woh baaz aa jayen to ziyadati ka badla to sirf zalimon ke liye hi hai. Ek sahih riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Usama (R.A) ek shakhs par talwar le kar charh gaye, jab woh zad mein aa gaya aur dekha ke talwar chala chahti hai to us ne jaldi se La ilaha illallah keh diya lekin us ke sar par talwar par gayi aur woh qatl ho gaya. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is waqiye ka bayan hua to aap ne Hazrat Usama (R.A) se farmaya kya tu ne ise us ke La ilaha illallah kehne ke baad qatl kiya? Tu La ilaha illallah ke sath Qayamat ke din kya karega? Hazrat Usama (R.A) ne arz kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah! Yeh to us ne sirf apne bachao ke liye kaha tha. Aap ne farmaya kya tu ne us ka dil cheer kar dekha tha? Bata kaun hoga jo Qayamat ke din La ilaha illallah ka muqabla kare.

Baar baar aap yahi farmate rahe yahan tak ke Hazrat Usama R.A farmate hain mere dil mein khayal aane laga ke kaash ke main aaj ke din se pehle musalman hi na hua hota? Phir farmata hai ke agar yeh ab bhi baaz na rahein tumhari mukhalifat aur tum se ladai na chhorein toh tum yaqeen mano ke Allah Ta'ala tumhara mawala, tumhara maalik, tumhara madadgar aur nasir hai. Woh tumhein un par ghalib karega. Woh behtareen mawla aur behtareen madadgar hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke Abdul Malik bin Marwan ne Hazrat Urwa se kuch baatein daryaft ki thin jis ke jawab mein aap ne unhein likha salam-e-alaik ke baad main aap ke samne us Allah ki tareefein karta hoon jis ke siwa koi mabood-e-barhaq nahin. Baad hamd-o-salat ke aap ka khat mila aap ne hijrat-e-Rasoolullah ﷺ ki babat mujh se sawal kiya hai main aap ko is waqiye ki khabar likhta hoon. Allah hi ki madad par khair karna aur shar se rokna mauqoof hai. Makkah Sharif se aap ke tashreef le jaane ka waqiya yun hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko nabuwwat di, SubhanAllah kaise achhe peshwa behtareen rehnuma thay, Allah aap ko jazaye khair ata farmaye hamein jannat mein aap ki ziyarat naseeb farmaye hamein aap hi ke deen par zinda rakhe isi par maut de aur isi par Qayamat ke din khada kare, Ameen. Jab aap ne apni qoum ko hidayat aur noor ki taraf dawat di jo Allah ne aap ko ata farmaya tha toh shuru shuru toh unhein kuch zyada bura nahin maloom hua balki qareeb tha ke aap ki baatein sunne lagein magar jab un ke maboodan-e-batil ka zikr aaya us waqt woh bigad baithe, aap ki baton ka bura manne lage, aap par sakhti karne lage, isi zamane mein Taif ke chand Quraishi maal le kar pohanche woh bhi un ke shareek-e-haal ho gaye, ab aap ki baton ke manne wale musalmanon ko tarah tarah se satane lage jis ki wajah se aam log aap ke is aane jaane se hat gaye bajuz un chand hastiyon ke jo Allah ki hifazat mein thin yahi halat ek arsay tak rahi jab tak ke musalmanon ki tadaad ki kami ziyadati ki had tak nahin pohanchi thi. Phir sardaran-e-kufr ne aapas mein mashwara kiya ke jitne log iman la chuke hain un par aur zyada sakhti ki jaye jo jis ka rishtedar aur qareebi ho woh use har tarah tang kare taake woh Rasool-e-Akram ﷺ ka sath chhor dein ab fitna barh gaya aur baaz log un ki sazaon ki taab na la kar un ki haan mein haan milane lage. Khare aur sabit qadam log deen-e-haq par is museebat ke zamane mein bhi jame rahe aur Allah ne unhein mazboot kar diya aur mehfooz rakh liya. Aakhir jab takleefein had se guzarne lagein toh Rasool-e-Maqbool ﷺ ne unhein Habsha ki taraf hijrat kar jaane ki ijazat de di. Habsha ka badshah Najashi ek nek aadmi tha us ki saltanat zulm-o-ziyadati se khali thi har taraf us ki tareefein ho rahi thin. Yeh jagah Quraish ki tijarati mandi thi jahan un ke tajir raha karte thay aur be-khauf-o-khatar bari bari tijartein kiya karte thay.

Pas jo log yahan Makkah Sharif mein kafiron ke hathon bahut tang aa gaye thay aur ab museebat jhelne ke qabil nahin rahe thay aur har waqt unhein apne deen ke apne hath se chhoot jaane ka khatra laga rehta tha woh sab Habsha chale gaye. Lekin khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yahin thehre rahe. Is par bhi jab kayi saal guzar gaye toh yahan Allah ke fazl se musalmanon ki tadaad khasi ho gayi, Islam phail gaya aur sharif aur sardar log bhi islami jhande tale aa gaye, yeh dekh kar kufr ko apni dushmani ka josh thanda karna pada. Woh zulm-o-ziyadati se bilkul toh nahin lekin kuch na kuch ruk gaye. Pas woh fitna jiske zalzalon ne Sahaba (R.A) ko watan chhodne aur Habsha jaane par majboor kiya tha uske kuch dab jaane ki khabron ne Muhajireen-e-Habsha ko phir aamada kiya ke woh Makkah Sharif wapas chale aayein. Chunancha woh bhi thode bahut aa gaye. Isi asna mein Madinah Sharif ke chand Ansar musalman ho gaye. Unki wajah se Madinah Sharif mein bhi isha'at-e-Islam hone lagi. Unka Makkah Sharif aana jaana shuru hua, is se Makkah wale kuch bigde aur bipharkar irada kar liya ke dobara sakht sakhti karein, chunancha dusri martaba phir fitna shuru hua. Hijrat-e-Habash par pehle fitne ne aamada kiya, wapsi par phir fitna phaila. Ab sattar buzurg sardar-e-Madinah yahan aaye aur musalman ho kar Aan-Hazrat Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hath par bai'at ki. Mausam-e-Hajj ke mauqa par yeh aaye thay. Quba mein unhon ne bai'at ki, ahd-o-paiman, qaul-o-qarar huye ke hum aap ke aur aap hamare. Agar koi bhi aap ka aadmi hamare han aa jaye toh hum uske amn-o-aman ke zimmedar hain, khud aap agar tashreef layein toh hum jaan maal se aap ke sath hain. Is cheez ne Quraish ko aur bhadka diya aur unhon ne za'eef aur kamzor musalmanon ko aur satana shuru kar diya. Unki sazayein badha dein aur khoon ke pyase ho gaye. Is par Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein ijazat de di ke woh Madinah Sharif ki taraf hijrat kar jayein. Yeh tha aakhri aur intehai fitna jis ne na sirf Sahaba-e-Kiram (R.A) ko hi nikala balkeh khud Allah ke mohtaram Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi Makkah ko khali kar gaye. Yehi hai woh jise Allah farmata hai un se jihad jaari rakho yahan tak ke fitna mit jaye aur sara deen Allah ka hi ho jaye. Alhamdulillah nauwein pare ki tafsir bhi khatam hui. Allah Ta'ala ise qabool farmaye.

Maal-e-Ghanimat ki taqseem ka bayan tamam agli ummaton par maal-e-ghanimat haram hai. Lekin is ummat ke liye Allah Ta'ala ne apni meherbani se ise halal kardiya. Is ki taqseem ki tafseel yahan bayan ho rahi hai. Maal-e-Ghanimat woh hai jo musalmanon ko jihad ke baad kafiron se haath lage aur jo maal baghair lade jang ke haath aaye maslan sulah hogayi aur muqarrara tawan-e-jang un se wasool kiya ya koi margaya aur lawaris tha ya jizye aur khiraj ki raqam waghera woh fay hai. Salaf-o-khalaf ki ek jamaat ka aur Hazrat Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ka yahi khayal hai. Baaz log ghanimat ka itlaq fay par aur fay ka itlaq ghanimat par bhi karte hain. Isi liye Qatada waghera ka qaul hai ke yeh aayat Surah Hashr ki (aayat Ma Afa Allahu Alkh,) ki nasikh hai. Ab maal-e-ghanimat mein farq karte hain woh kehte hain ke woh aayat toh fay ke bare mein hai aur yeh ghanimat ke bare mein. Baaz buzurgon ka khayal hai ke in dono qisam ke maal ki taqseem Imam ki raye par hai. Pas muqarrara Hashr ki aayat aur is aayat mein koi ikhtilaf nahin jabke Imam ki marzi ho wallahu a'lam. Aayat mein bayan hai ke khums yani panchwan hissa maal-e-ghanimat mein se nikal dena chahiye. Chahe woh kam ho ya zyada ho. Go sui ho ya dhaga ho. Parwardigar-e-Aalam farmata hai jo khayanat karega woh ise lekar Qayamat ke din pesh hoga aur har ek ko is amal ka poora badla milega kisi par zulm na kiya jayega. Kehte hain ke khums mein se Allah ke liye muqarrara shuda hissa Ka'be mein dakhil kiya jayega. Hazrat Abu Al-Aliyah Riyahi kehte hain ke ghanimat ke maal ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) panch hisse karte the. Char mujahideen mein taqseem hote panchwein mein se aap mutthi bhar kar nikal lete use Ka'be mein dakhil kardete phir jo bacha us ke panch hisse kar dalte ek Rasool Allah ka ek qarabat daron ka. Ek yateemon ka ek maskeenon ka ek musafiron ka. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yahan Allah ka naam sirf bator-e-tabarruk hai goya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hisse ke bayan ka woh shuru hai. Ibn-e-Abbas ka bayan hai ke jab Huzoor koi lashkar bhejte aur maal-e-ghanimat ka maal milta toh aap us ke panch hisse karte aur phir panchwein hisse ke panch hisse kar dalte phir aap ne yahi aayat tilawat farmayi. Pas yeh farman ke "Inna lillahi khumsahu" yeh sirf kalam ke shuru ke liye hai. Zameen-o-aasman mein jo kuch hai Allah hi ka hai. Panchwein hisse mein se panchwan hissa Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka hai bahut se buzurgon ka qaul yahi hai ke Allah Rasool ka ek hi hissa hai. Isi ki ta'eed Baihaqi ki is sahih sanad wali hadith se bhi hoti hai ke ek sahabi ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Wadi-ul-Qura mein aa kar sawal kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah ghanimat ke bare mein aap kya irshad farmate hain? Aap ne farmaya is mein se panchwan hissa Allah ka hai baqi ke char hisse lashkariyon ke. Us ne poocha toh is mein kisi ko kisi par zyada haq nahin? Aap ne farmaya hargiz nahin yahan tak ke tu apne kisi dost ke jism se teer nikale toh us teer ka bhi tu us se zyada mustahiq nahin. Hazrat Hasan ne apne maal ke panchwein hisse ki wasiyat ki aur farmaya kya main apne liye is hisse par razamand na hojaun?

Jo Allah Ta'ala ne khud apna rakha hai. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke maal-e-ghanimat ke paanch hisse barabar kiye jate thay, chaar toh un lashkariyon ko milte thay jo us jang mein shamil thay, phir paanchwein hisse ke chaar hisse kiye jate thay, ek chauthai Allah ka aur uske Rasool ka, phir yeh hissa Aan-Hazrat ﷺ lete thay yani paanchwein hisse ka paanchwan hissa Aap aur Aap ke baad jo bhi Aap ka naib ho us ka hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Buraida R.A farmate hain Allah ka hissa Allah ke Nabi ka hai aur jo Aap ka hissa tha woh Aap ki biwiyon ka hai. Atta bin Abi Rabah R.H farmate hain Allah aur uske Rasool ka jo hissa hai woh sirf Rasool Allah ﷺ hi ka hai, ikhtiyar hai jis kaam mein Aap chahein lagayein. Miqdam bin Ma'di Karib, Hazrat Ubada bin Samit R.A, Hazrat Abu Darda R.A aur Hazrat Haris bin Muawiya Kundi R.A ke paas baithe hue thay, un mein Rasool Allah ﷺ ki ahadees ka zikr hone laga toh Abu Dawood ne Ubada bin Samit R.A se kaha, "Fulan fulan ghazwe mein Rasool Allah ﷺ ne khums ke bare mein kya irshad farmaya tha?" Aap ne farmaya ke Huzoor ﷺ ne ek jihad mein khums ke ek oont ke peeche sahaba ko namaz parhayi, salam ke baad kharay ho gaye aur chand baal chutki mein le kar farmaya ke maal-e-ghanimat ke oont ke yeh baal bhi maal-e-ghanimat mein se hi hain aur mere nahin hain, mera hissa toh tumhare sath sirf paanchwan hai aur phir woh bhi tum hi ko wapas de diya jata hai, pas sui dhagay tak har chhoti bari cheez pohancha diya karo, khayanat na karo, khayanat aar hai aur khayanat karne wale ke liye dono jahan mein aag hai. Qareeb walon se, door walon se, rah-e-haq mein jihad jaari rakho. Shar'i kamon mein kisi malamat karne wale ki malamat ka khayal tak na karo. Watan mein aur safar mein Allah ki muqarrar karda haddein jaari karte raho, Allah ke liye jihad karte raho, jihad jannat ke bahut baray darwazon mein se ek darwaza hai, isi jihad ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala gham-o-ranj se nijat deta hai (Musnad Imam Ahmad). Yeh hadees hasan hai aur bahut hi aala hai. Sahah-e-Sitta mein is sanad se marwi nahin lekin Musnad hi ki dusri riwayat mein dusri sanad se khums ka aur khayanat ka zikr marwi hai. Abu Dawood aur Nasai mein bhi mukhtasaran yeh hadees marwi hai. Is hisse mein se Aan-Hazrat Rasool-e-Maqbool ﷺ baaz cheezein apni zaat ke liye bhi makhsoos farma liya karte thay, laundi, ghulam, talwar, ghora waghera. Jaisa ke Muhammad bin Sirin R.H aur Aamir Sha'bi R.H aur aksar ulama ne farmaya hai. Tirmidhi waghera mein hai ke Zulfiqar nami talwar Badr ke din ke maal-e-ghanimat mein se thi jo Huzoor ﷺ ke paas thi, isi ke bare mein Uhad wale din khwab dekha tha. Hazrat Ayesha R.A farmati hain ke Hazrat Safiya R.A bhi isi tarah aayi thin.

Abu Dawood waghera mein hai Hazrat Yazeed bin Abdullah kehte hain ke hum baare mein baithe hue thay jo ek sahib tashreef laye unke haath mein chamre ka ek tukra tha humne use parha toh usmein tehreer tha ke yeh Muhammad Rasool Allah ki taraf se Zuhair bin Aqeesh ki taraf hai ke agar tum Allah ki wahdat ki aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat ki gawahi do aur namazein qaim rakho aur zakat diya karo aur ghaneemat ke maal se khums ada karte raho aur Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka hissa aur khalis hissa ada karte raho toh tum Allah aur uske Rasool ki aman mein ho. Humne unse poocha ke tujhe yeh kisne likh diya hai usne kaha Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne, pas in sahih ahadees ki dalalat aur suboot is baat par hai isi liye aksar buzurgon ne ise Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke khawas mein se shumar kiya hai. Salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaihi aur log kehte hain ke khums mein imam-e-waqt musalmanon ki maslahat ke mutabiq jo chahe kar sakta hai. Jaise ke maal-e-fay mein use ikhtiyar hai. Hamare Sheikh Allama Ibn-e-Taimiyah (R.H) farmate hain ke yahi qaul Hazrat Imam Malik ka hai aur aksar salaf ka hai aur yahi sab se zyada sahih qaul hai. Jab yeh sabit hogaya aur maloom hogaya toh yeh bhi khayal rahe ke khums jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka hissa tha use ab aap ke baad kya kiya jaye baaz toh kehte hain ke ab yeh hissa imam-e-waqt yani Khalifatul Muslimeen ka hoga. Hazrat Abu Bakr, Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Qatada aur ek jamaat ka yahi qaul hai. Aur is bare mein ek marfoo hadees bhi aayi hai kuch logon ka kehna hai ke yeh musalmanon ki maslahat mein sarf hoga ek qaul hai ke yeh bhi ahl-e-hajat ki baqaya qismon par kharch hoga yani qarabat dar, yateem, maskeen aur musafir. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer ka mukhtar mazhab yahi hai aur buzurgon ka farman hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka aur aap ke qarabat daron ka hissa yateemon, maskeenon aur musafiron ko de diya jaye. Iraq walon ki ek jamaat ka yahi qaul hai aur kaha gaya hai khums ka yeh panchwan hissa sab ka sab qarabat daron ka hai. Chunancha Abdullah bin Muhammad bin Ali aur Ali bin Hussain ka qaul hai ke yeh hamara haq hai poocha gaya ke aayat mein yateemon aur maskeenon ka bhi zikr hai toh Imam Ali ne farmaya is se murad bhi hamare yateem aur maskeen hain. Imam Hassan bin Muhammad bin Hanafiyah (R.H) Ta'ala se is aayat ke bare mein sawal hota hai toh farmate hain ke kalam ka shuru is tarah hua hai warna duniya aakhirat ka sab kuch Allah hi ka hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke baad in dono hisson ke bare mein kya hua ismein ikhtilaf hai. Baaz kehte hain Hazrat ka hissa aap ke khalifa ko milega. Baaz kehte hain aap ke qarabat daron ko. Baaz kehte hain khalifa ke qarabat daron ko unki raye mein in dono hisson ko ghoron aur hathiyaron ke kaam mein lagaya jaye isi tarah khilafat-e-Siddiqi-o-Farooqi mein hota bhi raha hai. Ibrahim kehte hain Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar aur Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke is hisse ko jihad ke kaam mein kharch karte thay. Poocha gaya ke Hazrat Ali is bare mein kya karte thay? Farmaya woh is bare mein unse sakht thay. Aksar ulama (R.H) ka yahi qaul hai.

Haan Zawil-Qurba ka jo hissa hai woh Banu Hashim aur Banu Abdul-Muttalib ka hai. Is liye ke aulad-e-Abdul-Muttalib ne aulad-e-Hashim ki jahiliyat mein aur awwal-e-Islam mein muwafiqat ki aur inhi ke sath unhon ne ghati mein qaid hona bhi manzoor kar liya kyunke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sataye jaane ki wajah se yeh log bigar baithe thay aur Aap (ﷺ) ki himayat mein thay, in mein se musalman toh Allah Ta'ala aur Uske Rasool ki ita'at ki wajah se. Kafir khandani taraf-dari aur rishton naaton ki himayat ki wajah se aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke chacha Abu Talib ki farmanbardari ki wajah se sataye gaye. Haan Banu Abd-Shams aur Banu Naufal goya yeh bhi Aap (ﷺ) ke chachazad bhai thay. Lekin woh in ki muwafiqat mein na thay balkeh in ke khilaf thay, inhein alag kar chuke thay aur in se lar rahe thay aur keh rahe thay ke Quraish ke tamam qabail in ke mukhalif hain, isi liye Abu Talib ne apne qasida-e-lamiyah mein in ki bahut hi muzammat ki hai kyunke yeh qareebi qarabat-dar thay. Is qaside mein unhon ne kaha hai ke inhein bahut jald Allah ki taraf se in ki is shararat ka poora poora badla milega. In bewaqoofon ne apne ho kar, ek khandan aur ek khoon ke ho kar hum se aankhein pher li hain waghera. Ek mauqa par Ibn Jubair bin Mu'tim bin Adi bin Naufal aur Hazrat Usman bin Affan bin Abul-Aas bin Umayyah bin Abd-Shams Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke paas gaye aur shikayat ki ke Aap (ﷺ) ne Khaibar ke khums mein se Banu Abdul-Muttalib ko toh diya lekin hamein chor diya halankeh Aap (ﷺ) ki qarabat-dari ke lihaz se woh aur hum bilkul yaksan aur barabar hain. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya suno Banu Hashim hain. Mujahid ka qaul hai ke Allah ko ilm tha ke Banu Hashim mein fuqara hain pas sadqe ki jagah in ka hissa maal-e-ghaneemat mein muqarrar kar diya. Yehi Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke woh qarabat-dar hain jin par sadqa haram hai. Ali bin Hussain se bhi isi tarah marwi hai. Baaz kehte hain yeh sab Quraish hain. Ibn Abbas se istifsar kiya gaya ke Zawil-Qurba kaun hain? Aap (R.A) ne jawab tahreer farmaya ke hum toh kehte thay hum hain lekin hamari qaum nahin manti, woh sab kehte hain ke saare hi Quraish hain (Muslim waghera). Baaz riwayaton mein sirf pehla jumla hi hai. Dusre jumle ki riwayat ke rawi Abu Ma'shar Najeeh bin Abdur-Rahman Madani ki riwayat mein hi yeh jumla hai ke sab kehte hain ke saare Quraish hain. Is mein zu'f bhi hai. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya tumhare liye logon ke mail-kuchail se toh main ne munh pher liya, khums ka panchwan hissa tumhein kafi hai. Yeh hadith hasan hai, is ke rawi Ibrahim bin Mahdi ko Imam Abu Hatim siqa batate hain lekin Yahya bin Ma'een kehte hain ke yeh munkar riwayatein late hain, wallahu a'lam. Aayat mein yateemon ka zikr hai yani musalmanon ke woh bachay jin ka baap faut ho chuka ho. Phir baaz toh kehte hain ke yateemi ke sath faqiri bhi ho toh woh mustahiq hain aur baaz kehte hain har ameer faqir yateem ko yeh alfaz shamil hain. Masakeen se murad woh mohtaj hain jin ke paas itna nahin ke in ki faqiri aur in ki haajat poori ho jaye aur inhein kafi ho jaye.

Ibn-us-Sabeel woh musafir hai jo itni had tak watan se nikal chuka ho ya ja raha ho ke jahan pahunch kar use namaz ko qasr parhna jaiz ho aur safar kharch kafi us ke paas na raha ho. Is ki tafsir Surah Barat ki (Aayat Innamas-Sadaqatu-l-Kh) ki tafsir mein aayegi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Hamara Allah par bharosa hai aur usi se hum madad talab karte hain. Phir farmata hai ke agar tumhara Allah par aur us ki utari hui wahi par iman hai to jo woh farma raha hai lao yani maal-e-ghanimat mein se panchwan hissa alag kardiya karo. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke wafd-e-Abdul Qais ko Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya main tumhein char baton ka hukm karta hoon aur char se mana karta hoon main tumhein Allah par iman lane ka hukm deta hoon. Jante bhi ho ke Allah par iman lana kya hai? Gawahi dena ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin aur Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah ke Rasool hain aur namaz ko pabandi se ada karna, zakat dena aur ghanimat mein se khums ada karna. Pas khums ka dena bhi iman mein dakhil hai. Hazrat Imam Bukhari (R.H) ne apni kitab Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein baab bandha hai ke khums ka ada karna iman mein hai phir is hadith ko warid farmaya hai aur hum ne sharh-e-Sahih Bukhari mein is ka pura matlab wazeh bhi kardiya hai wallahul hamdu wal minnah. Phir Allah Ta'ala apna ek ehsan-o-inaam bayan farmata hai ke us ne haq-o-batil mein farq kardiya. Apne deen ko ghalib kiya, apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aur aap ke lashkariyon ki madad farmayi aur jang-e-Badr mein unhein ghalba diya. Kalma-e-Iman kalma-e-Kufr par chha gaya pas Yaum-ul-Furqan se murad Badr ka din hai jis mein haq-o-batil ki tameez hogi. Bohat se buzurgon se yahi tafsir marwi hai. Yahi sab se pehla ghazwa tha. Mushrik log Utba bin Rabia ki mat-huti mein thay, Jumma ke din unnis ya satra Ramadan ko yeh larai hui thi, as-hab-e-Rasool (R.A) teen sau das se kuch oopar thay aur mushrikon ki tadad nau sau se ek hazar thi. Bawajood is ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne kafiron ko shikast di, satra se zaid to kafir mare gaye aur utne hi qaid kar liye gaye. Mustadrak Hakim mein hai Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain ke Lailatul Qadr ko gyarhwin raat mein hi yaqeen ke sath talash karo is liye ke is ki subh ko Badr ki larai ka din tha. Hasan bin Ali (R.A) farmate hain ke Lailatul Furqan jis din dono jamaton mein ghamsan ki larai hui Ramadan Sharif ki satrahwin thi, yeh raat bhi Jumma ki raat thi. Ghazway aur seerat ke murattab karne wale ke nazdeek yahi sahih hai. Haan, Yazeed bin Abu Ja'ad jo apne zamane ke Misri ilaqe ke imam thay farmate hain ke Badr ka din Peer ka din tha lekin kisi aur ne un ki mutaba'at nahin ki aur jamhoor ka qaul yaqeenan un ke qaul par muqaddam hai wallahu a'alam.

Allah Ta'ala ne Ghazwa-e-Badr ke zariye imaan ko kufr se mumtaz kar diya. Farmata hai ke us din tum wadi-e-dunya mein thay jo Madine Sharif se qareeb hai aur mushrik log Makka ki janib Madine ki door ki wadi mein thay aur Abu Sufyan aur us ka qafila tijarati asbab samet neeche ki janib darya ki taraf tha. Agar tum kuffar-e-Quraish se jang ka irada pehle se karte toh yaqeenan tum mein ikhtilaf padta ke ladai kahan ho? Yeh bhi matlab kaha gaya hai ke agar tum log aapas mein tay kar ke jang ke liye tayyar hote aur phir tumhein un ki kasrat-e-tadaad aur kasrat-e-asbab maloom hoti toh bohat mumkin tha ke irade past ho jate. Is liye qudrat ne pehle se tay kiye baghair dono jamaton ko achanak mila diya ke Allah ka yeh irada poora ho jaye ke Islam aur Musalmanon ko bulandi hasil ho aur shirk aur mushrikon ko pasti mile. Pas jo karna tha Allah Pak kar guzra. Chunancha Ka'ab ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) aur Musalman toh sirf qafile ke irade se hi nikle thay, Allah ne dushman se madbher kara di baghair kisi taqarrur ke aur baghair kisi jangi tayari ke. Abu Sufyan mulk-e-Sham se qafila le kar chala, Abu Jahl use Musalmanon se bachane ke liye Makka se nikla. Qafila dusre raste se nikal gaya aur Musalmanon aur kafiron ki jang ho gayi. Is se pehle dono ek dusre se be-khabar thay, ek dusre ko khususan pani lane walon ko dekh kar unhein un ka aur unhein un ka ilm hua. Seerat-e-Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) barabar apne irade se ja rahe thay, Safra ke qareeb pahunch kar Qais bin Amr aur Adi bin Abu Al-Za'ba Jahni ko Abu Sufyan ka pata chalane ke liye bheja. Un dono ne Badr ke maidan mein pahunch kar batha ke ek teele par apni sawariyan bithayin aur pani ke liye nikle. Raste mein do ladkiyon ko aapas mein jhagadte hue dekha, ek dusri se kehti hai tu mera qarza kyun ada nahin karti? Us ne kaha jaldi na kar kal ya parson yahan qafila aane wala hai main tujhe tera haq de doongi. Majdi bin Amr beech mein bol utha aur kaha yeh sach kehti hai. Ise un dono sahabiyon ne sun liya, apne oont kase aur foran khidmat-e-Nabvi mein ja kar aap (ﷺ) ko khabar di. Idhar Abu Sufyan apne qafile se pehle yahan akela pahuncha aur Majdi bin Amr se kaha ke is kunwein par tum ne kisi ko dekha? Us ne kaha nahin, albatta do sawar aaye thay, apne oont aur teele par bithaye, apni mashk mein pani bhara aur chal diye. Yeh sun kar yeh us jagah pahuncha, mengniyan lein aur unhein toda aur khajuron ki guthliyan un mein pa kar kehne laga Wallah yeh Madani log hain. Wahin se wapas apne qafile mein pahuncha aur rasta badal kar samundar ke kinare chal diya. Jab use us taraf se itminan ho gaya toh us ne apna qasid Quraishiyon ko bheja ke Allah ne tumhare qafile, maal aur admiyon ko bacha liya, tum laut jao. Yeh sun kar Abu Jahl ne kaha nahin, jab yahan tak hum aa chuke hain toh hum Badr tak zaroor jayenge, yahan ek bazaar laga karta tha. Wahan hum teen roz thehrenge, wahan oont zibah karenge.

Sharabain piyain ge kabab banayain ge taake Arab mein hamari dhoom mach jaye aur har ek ko hamari bahaduri aur be-jigri maloom ho aur woh hamesha hum se khauf zada rahein. Lekin Akhnas bin Shariq ne kaha ke Banu Zuhra ke logo Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare maal mehfooz kar diye tum ko chahiye ke ab wapas chale jao. Us ke qabeelay ne us ki maan li yeh log aur Banu Adi laut gaye. Badr ke qareeb pohanch kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib, Hazrat Sa'ad bin Waqqas aur Hazrat Zubair bin Awam ko khabar lanay ke liye bheja chand aur sahaba ko bhi un ke sath kar diya unhein Banu Saeed bin Aas ka aur Banu Hajjaj ka ghulam kunwein par mil gaya dono ko giraftar kar liya aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein pesh kiya us waqt aap namaz mein thay sahaba ne un se sawal karna shuru kiya ke tum kaun ho? Unhon ne kaha Quraish ke saqqay hain unhon ne hamein pani lanay ke liye bheja tha. Sahaba ka khayal tha ke yeh Abu Sufyan ke aadmi hain is liye unhon ne un par sakhti shuru ki aakhir ghabra kar unhon ne keh diya ke hum Abu Sufyan ke qafilay ke hain tab unhein chhora. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek rakat parh kar salam pher diya aur farmaya ke jab tak yeh sach boltay rahay tum unhein martay peet-tay rahay aur jab unhon ne jhoot kaha tum ne chhor diya wallah yeh sachay hain yeh Quraish ke ghulam hain haan ji batao Quraish ka lashkar kahan hai? Unhon ne kaha wadi Qaswa ke us taraf teelay ke peechay. Aap ne farmaya woh tadaad mein kitnay hain? Unhon ne kaha bohat hain aap ne farmaya aakhir kitnay ek? Unhon ne kaha tadaad to hamein maloom nahin aap ne farmaya achha yeh bata saktay ho har roz kitnay oont kat-tay hain? Unhon ne kaha ek din nau ek din das. Aap ne farmaya phir woh nau sau se ek hazar tak hain. Phir aap ne daryaft farmaya ke un mein sardaran-e-Quraish mein se kaun kaun hain? Unhon ne jawab diya ke Utba bin Rabia, Shaiba bin Rabia, Abu Al-Bakhtari bin Hisham, Hakim bin Hizam, Naufal, Tuaima bin Adi, Nazr bin Harith, Zam'a bin Aswad, Abu Jahl, Umayya bin Khalaf, Munabbih bin Hajjaj, Suhail bin Amr, Amr bin Abduwud. Yeh sun kar aap ne sahaba se farmaya lo Makkah ne apne jigar ke tukray tumhari taraf daal diye hain. Badr ke din jab dono jamaton ka muqabla shuru honay laga to Hazrat Sa'ad bin Mu'az (R.A) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se arz kiya ke agar aap ijazat dein to hum aap ke liye ek jhonpri bana dein aap wahan rahein hum apne janwaron ko yahin bitha kar maidan mein ja koodain agar fatah hui to Alhamdulillah yahi matloob hai warna aap hamaray janwaron par sawar ho kar unhein apne sath le kar hamari qoum ke un hazrat ke paas chale jayain jo Madina Shareef mein hain woh hum se zyada aap se mohabbat rakhtay hain. Unhein maloom na tha ke koi jang honay wali hai warna woh hargiz aap ka sath na chhortay aap ki madad ke liye aap ke ham-rikab nikal kharay hotay. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un ke is mashwaray ki qadar ki unhein dua di aur is deray mein aap thehar gaye aap ke sath sirf Hazrat Abu Bakr thay aur koi na tha.

Subh hote hi Quraishiyon ke lashkar teele ke peeche se aate hue namudar hue. Unhein dekh kar Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Janab-e-Bari mein dua ki ke Bari Ta'ala yeh fakhr-o-ghuroor ke sath tujh se ladane aur tere Rasool ko jhutlane ke liye aa rahe hain. Bari Ta'ala tu inhein past-o-zaleel kar. Is aayat ke aakhri jumle ki tafseer Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein hai ke yeh is liye ke kufr karne wale daleel-e-Rabbani dekh lein go kufr hi par rahein aur imaan wale bhi daleel ke sath imaan layein. Ya'ni aamadgi aur baghair shart-o-qarardad ke Allah Ta'ala ne mominon aur mushrikon ka yahan achanak aamna samna kara diya ke haqaniyat ko baatil par ghalba de kar haq ko mukammal taur par zahir kar de is tarah ke kisi ko shak-o-shuba baqi na rahe. Ab jo kufr par rahe woh bhi kufr ko kufr samajh ke rahe aur jo imaan wala ho jaye woh daleel dekh kar imaan-dar bane. Imaan hi dilon ki zindagi hai aur kufr hi asli halakat hai. Jaise farman-e-Quran hai (Aayat: Awaman kana maitan fa-ahyaynahu...), ya'ni woh jo murda tha phir hum ne use jila diya aur us ke liye noor bana diya ke us ki roshni mein woh logon mein chal phir raha hai. Tohmat ke qissa mein Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke alfaaz hain ke phir jise halak hona tha woh halak ho gaya ya'ni bohtan mein hissa liya. Allah Ta'ala tumhare tazarru-o-zari aur tumhari dua-o-istighfar aur faryad-o-munajat ka sunne wala hai, woh khoob jaanta hai ke tum ahl-e-haq ho, tum mustahiq-e-imdad ho, tum is qabil ho ke tumhein kafiron aur mushrikon par ghalba diya jaye.

Larai mein momin kam aur kuffar zyada dikhai diye. Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ) ko khwab mein mushrikon ki tadaad bahut kam dikhai, aap (ﷺ) ne apne as-haab se zikr kiya, yeh cheez unki saabit qadmi ka baa'is ban gayi. Ba'az buzurg kehte hain ke aap (ﷺ) ko aapki aankhon se unki tadaad kam dikhai, jin aankhon se aap (ﷺ) sote the. Lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai, jab Quran mein 'manaam' ke lafz hain to iski ta'weel bila daleel karne ki zaroorat hi kya hai? Mumkin tha ke unki tadaad ki zyadati mein ra'ab bitha de aur aapas mein ikhtilaf shuru ho jaye ke aaya inse ladein ya na ladein? Allah Ta'ala ne is baat se hi bacha liya aur unki tadaad kam karke dikhai. Allah Paak dilon ke bhed se, seene ke raaz se waqif hai, aankhon ki khayanat aur dil ke bhed jaanta hai. Khwab mein tadaad mein kam dikha kar phir yeh bhi meherbani farmayi ke ba-waqt-e-jang bhi musalmanon ki nigahon aur unki jaanch mein woh bahut hi kam aaye taake musalman daleer ho jayein aur unhein koi cheez na samjhein. Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain, main ne andaza karke apne saathi se kaha ke yeh log to koi sattar (70) ke qareeb honge, usne poora andaza karke kaha nahin, koi ek hazaar (1000) ka yeh lashkar hai. Phir isi tarah kafiron ki nazron mein bhi Allah Hakeem ne musalmanon ki tadaad kam dikhai, ab to woh in par aur yeh un par toot pade. Taake Rabb ka kaam jiska karna woh apne ilm mein muqarrar kar chuka tha poora ho jaye, kafiron par apni pakad aur mominon par apni rahmat nazil farma de. Jab tak larai shuru nahin hui thi, yahi kaifiyat dono janib rahi, larai shuru hote hi Allah Ta'ala ne ek hazaar (1000) farishton se apne bandon ki madad farmayi, musalmanon ka lashkar badh gaya aur kafiron ka zor toot gaya. Chunancha ab to kafiron ko musalman apne se dugne nazar aane lage aur Allah ne muwahhidon ki madad ki aur aankhon walon ke liye ibrat ka khazana khol diya. Jaise ke (Qad kaana lakum aayatun fee fi'atainil taqata, fi'atun tuqaatilu fee sabeelillaahi wa ukhraa kaafiratun yarawnahum mislaihim ra'yal ain, wallaahu yu'ayyidu binasrihee man yashaa', inna fee zaalika la'ibratal li-ulil absaar) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 13) mein bayan hua hai. Pas dono aayatein ek si hain, musalman tab tak kam nazar aate rahe jab tak larai shuru nahin hui. Shuru hote hi musalman dugne dikhai dene lage.
