Jihad ke waqt kasrat se Allah ka zikr. Allah Ta'ala apne momin bandon ko ladai ki kamyabi ki tadbeer aur dushman ke muqable ke waqt shuja'at ka sabaq sikha raha hai. Ek ghazwe mein Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne suraj dhalne ke baad khade ho kar farmaya! Logo dushman se muqable ki tamanna na karo, Allah Ta'ala se aafiyat mangte raho lekin jab dushmanon se muqabla ho jaye to istiqlaal rakho aur yaqeen mano ke jannat talwaron ke saye tale hai. Phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khade ho kar Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke aye sachi kitab ke nazil farmane wale, aye badalon ke chalane wale aur lashkaron ko hazimat dene wale, Allah in kafiron ko shikast de aur un par hamari madad farma (Bukhari, Muslim). Abdur Razzaq ki riwayat mein hai ke dushman ke muqable ki tamanna na karo aur muqable ke waqt sabit qadmi aur ulul-azmi dikhao, go woh cheekhein chillayein lekin tum khamosh raha karo. Tabrani mein hai teen waqt aise hain jin mein Allah Ta'ala ko khamoshi pasand hai: 001 tilawat-e-Quran ke waqt, 002 jihad ke waqt aur 003 janaze ke waqt. Ek aur hadith mein hai kamil banda woh hai jo dushman ke muqable ke waqt mera zikr karta rahe, yani is haal mein bhi mere zikr ko, mujh se dua karne aur faryad karne ko tark na kare. Hazrat Qatada farmate hain ladai ke dauran yani jab talwar chalti ho tab bhi Allah Ta'ala ne apna zikr farz rakha hai. Hazrat Ata (R.H) ka qaul hai ke chup rehna aur zikr-e-Allah karna ladai ke waqt bhi wajib hai, phir Aap ne yahi aayat tilawat farmayi. To Juraij ne Aap se daryaft kiya ke Allah Ta'ala ki yaad buland aawaz se karein? Aap ne farmaya haan. Ka'ab Ahbar farmate hain Quran-e-Kareem ki tilawat aur zikr-e-Allah se zyada mehboob Allah ke nazdeek aur koi cheez nahin. Is mein bhi aula woh hai jis ka hukm logon ko namaz mein kiya gaya hai aur jihad mein, kya tum nahin dekhte? Ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne ba-waqt-e-jihad bhi apne zikr ka hukm farmaya hai, phir Aap ne yahi aayat padhi. Shair kehta hai ke ain jang-o-jidal ke waqt bhi mere dil mein teri yaad hoti hai. Antara kehta hai nezon aur talwaron ke shapa-shap chalte hue bhi main tujhe yaad karta rehta hoon. Pas aayat mein Janab-e-Bari ne dushmanon ke muqable ke waqt maidan-e-jang mein sabit qadam rehne aur sabr-o-istiqamat ka hukm diya ke namard, buzdil aur darpok na bano, Allah ko yaad karo, use na bhoolo. Us se faryad karo, us se duayein karo, usi par bharosa rakho, us se madad talab karo. Yehi kamyabi ke gur hain. Is waqt bhi Allah-o-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ita'at ko haath se na jaane do, woh jo farmayein baja lao, jin se rokein ruk jao, aapas mein jhagde aur ikhtilaf na phailao warna zaleel ho jaoge, buzdili jam jayegi, hawa ukhad jayegi. Quwwat aur tezi jaati rahegi, iqbal aur taraqqi ruk jayegi. Dekho sabr ka daaman na chhodo aur yaqeen rakho ke sabiron ke saath khud Allah hota hai. Sahaba-e-Kiram (R.A) in ahkaam mein aise poore utre ke un ki misaal aglon mein bhi nahin, peeche walon ka to zikr hi kya hai?

Yahi shuja'at, yahi ita'at-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam), yahi sabr-o-istiqlal tha jis ke ba'is madad-e-Rabbani shamil-e-haal rahi aur bahut hi kam muddat mein bawajood ta'dad aur asbab ki kami ke mashriq-o-maghrib ko fath kar liya. Na sirf logon ke mulkon ke hi maalik bane balkeh un ke dilon ko bhi fath kar ke Allah ki taraf laga diya. Roomiyon aur Farsiyon ko, Turkon aur Saqaliya ko, Barbariyon aur Habshiyon ko, Sudaniyon aur Qibtiyon ko, gharz duniya ke goron-kalon ko maghloob kar liya. Allah ke kalme ko buland kiya, deen-e-haq ko phailaya aur Islami hukumat ko duniya ke kone-kone mein jama diya. Allah un se khush rahe aur unhein bhi khush rakhe. Khayal to karo ke tees saal mein duniya ka naqsha badal diya, tareekh ka waraq palat diya. Allah Ta'ala hamara bhi inhi ki jama'at mein hashr kare, woh Kareem-o-Wahhab hai.

Jihad ke waqt kasrat se Allah ka zikr. Allah Ta'ala apne momin bandon ko ladai ki kamyabi ki tadbeer aur dushman ke muqable ke waqt shuja'at ka sabaq sikha raha hai. Ek ghazwe mein Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne suraj dhalne ke baad khade ho kar farmaya! Logo dushman se muqable ki tamanna na karo, Allah Ta'ala se aafiyat mangte raho lekin jab dushmanon se muqabla ho jaye to istiqlaal rakho aur yaqeen mano ke jannat talwaron ke saye tale hai. Phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khade ho kar Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke aye sachi kitab ke nazil farmane wale, aye badalon ke chalane wale aur lashkaron ko hazimat dene wale, Allah in kafiron ko shikast de aur un par hamari madad farma (Bukhari, Muslim). Abdur Razzaq ki riwayat mein hai ke dushman ke muqable ki tamanna na karo aur muqable ke waqt sabit qadmi aur ulul-azmi dikhao, go woh cheekhein chillayein lekin tum khamosh raha karo. Tabrani mein hai teen waqt aise hain jin mein Allah Ta'ala ko khamoshi pasand hai: 001 tilawat-e-Quran ke waqt, 002 jihad ke waqt aur 003 janaze ke waqt. Ek aur hadith mein hai kamil banda woh hai jo dushman ke muqable ke waqt mera zikr karta rahe, yani is haal mein bhi mere zikr ko, mujh se dua karne aur faryad karne ko tark na kare. Hazrat Qatada farmate hain ladai ke dauran yani jab talwar chalti ho tab bhi Allah Ta'ala ne apna zikr farz rakha hai. Hazrat Ata (R.H) ka qaul hai ke chup rehna aur zikr-e-Allah karna ladai ke waqt bhi wajib hai, phir Aap ne yahi aayat tilawat farmayi. To Juraij ne Aap se daryaft kiya ke Allah Ta'ala ki yaad buland aawaz se karein? Aap ne farmaya haan. Ka'ab Ahbar farmate hain Quran-e-Kareem ki tilawat aur zikr-e-Allah se zyada mehboob Allah ke nazdeek aur koi cheez nahin. Quwwat aur tezi jaati rahegi, iqbal aur taraqqi ruk jayegi. Dekho sabr ka daaman na chhodo aur yaqeen rakho ke sabiron ke saath khud Allah hota hai. Sahaba-e-Kiram (R.A) in ahkaam mein aise poore utre ke un ki misaal aglon mein bhi nahin, peeche walon ka to zikr hi kya hai?

Yahi shuja'at, yahi ita'at-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam), yahi sabr-o-istiqlal tha jis ke ba'is madad-e-Rabbani shamil-e-haal rahi aur bahut hi kam muddat mein bawajood ta'dad aur asbab ki kami ke mashriq-o-maghrib ko fath kar liya. Khayal to karo ke tees saal mein duniya ka naqsha badal diya, tareekh ka waraq palat diya. Allah Ta'ala hamara bhi inhi ki jama'at mein hashr kare, woh Kareem-o-Wahhab hai.

Maidan-e-Badr mein Iblees mushrikeen ka hamrahi tha. Jihad mein sabit qadmi, nek niyati, zikr-e-Allah ki kasrat ki nasihat farma kar mushrikeen ki mushabahat se rok raha hai ke jaise woh haq ko mitane aur logon mein apni bahaduri jhatane ke liye fakhr-o-ghuroor ke sath apne shehron se chale, tum aisa na karna. Chunancha Abu Jahl se jab kaha gaya ke qafila toh bach gaya ab laut kar wapas chalna chahiye toh is maloon ne jawab diya ke wah! Kis ka lautna? Badr ke pani par ja kar parao karenge. Wahan sharabein urayenge, kabab khayenge, gana sunenge taake logon mein shohrat ho jaye. Allah ki shan ke qurban jaiye, in ke arman qudrat ne palat diye, yahin in ki lashein giren aur yahin ke garhon mein zillat ke sath thons diye gaye. Allah in ke aamal ka ihata karne wala hai, in ke irade us par khule hain, isi liye inhein bure waqt se pala para. Pas yeh mushrikeen ka zikr hai jo Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) rasoolon ke sartaj se Badr mein larne chale the, in ke sath gane waliyan bhi thin, baje gaje bhi the. Shaitan-e-La'een in ka pusht panah bana hua tha, inhein phusla raha tha. In ke kaam ko khubsurat bhala dikha raha tha, in ke kanon mein phoonk raha tha ke bhala tumhein kaun hara sakta hai? In ke dil se Banu Bakr ka Makkah par charhai karne ka khauf nikal raha tha aur Suraqa bin Malik bin Ja'sham ki surat mein in ke samne khara ho kar keh raha tha ke main toh is ilaqe ka sardar hoon, Banu Mudlij sab mere tabe hain, main tumhara himayati hoon, be-fikr raho. Shaitan ka kaam bhi yahi hai ke jhoote wade de, na pura hone wali ummidon ke sabz bagh dikhaye aur dhoke ke jaal mein phansaye. Badr wale din yeh apne jhande aur lashkar ko sath le kar mushrikeen ki himayat mein nikla, in ke dilon mein dalta raha ke bas tum bazi le gaye, main tumhara madadgar hoon. Lekin jab musalmanon se muqabla shuru hua aur is khabees ki nazrein farishton par parin toh pichle pairon bhaga aur kehne laga main woh dekhta hoon jis se tumhari aankhein andhi hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) kehte hain Badr wale din Iblees apna jhanda buland kiye Mudliji shakhs ki surat mein apne lashkaron samet pohancha aur Shaitan Suraqa bin Malik bin Ja'sham ki surat mein namudar hua aur mushrikeen ke dil barhaye, himmat dilai. Jab maidan-e-jang mein saf bandi ho gayi toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne mitti ki mutthi bhar kar mushrikon ke munh par mari, is se in ke qadam ukhad gaye aur in mein bhagdar mach gayi. Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) Shaitan ki taraf chale, us waqt yeh ek mushrik ke hath mein hath diye hue tha, Aap (A.S) ko dekhte hi us ke hath se hath chura kar apne lashkaron samet bhag khara hua. Us shakhs ne kaha Suraqa! Tum toh keh rahe the ke tum hamare himayati ho, phir yeh kya kar rahe ho? Yeh maloon chunke farishton ko dekh raha tha, kehne laga main woh dekhta hoon jo tum nahin dekhte, main toh Allah se darne wala aadmi hoon, Allah ke azab bare bhari hain. Aur riwayat mein hai ke use peeth pherta dekh kar Harith bin Hisham ne pakar liya.

Usne uske munh par thappar mara jis se yeh behosh ho kar gir pada. Dusre logon ne kaha Suraqa tu is haal mein hamain zaleel karta hai? Aur aise waqt hamain dhoka deta hai? Woh kehne laga haan haan main tum se bari-uz-zimma aur be-taluq hoon, main unhein dekh raha hoon jinhein tum nahin dekh rahe. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par thodi si der ke liye ek tarah ki be-khudi si tari ho gayi, phir hoshiyar ho kar farmane lage, "Sahabiyo khush ho jao, yeh hain tumhari dayin janib Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aur yeh hain tumhari bayin taraf Mikaeel (A.S) aur yeh hain Hazrat Israfeel (A.S), teeno ma'a apni apni faujon ke aa-maujood hue hain."

Iblees Suraqa bin Malik bin Ja'sham Mudlaji ki surat mein mushrikon mein tha, un ke dilon ko badha raha tha aur un mein pesh-goiyan kar raha tha ke be-fikr raho aaj tumhein koi hara nahin sakta. Lekin farishton ke lashkar ko dekhte hi us ne to munh moda aur yeh kehta hua bhaga ke main tum se bari hoon, main unhein dekh raha hoon jo tumhari nigah mein nahin aate. Haris bin Hisham chunke use Suraqa hi samjhe hue tha is liye us ne uska hath tham liya, us ne us ke seene mein is zor se ghunsa mara ke yeh munh ke bal gir pada aur shaitan bhag gaya, samundar mein kood pada aur apna kapda uncha kar ke kehne laga, "Ya Allah main tujhe tera woh wada yaad dilata hoon jo tu ne mujh se kiya hai." Tabrani mein Hazrat Rifa'a bin Rafe' se bhi isi ke qareeb qareeb marwi hai.

Hazrat Urwa bin Zubair kehte hain jab Quraishiyon ne Makkah se nikalne ka irada kiya to unhein Bani Bakr ki jang yaad aa gayi aur khayal kiya ke aisa na ho hamari adam-maujoodgi mein yahan chadhai kar dein, qareeb tha ke woh apne irade se dast-bardar ho jayen, usi waqt Iblees-e-La'een Suraqa ki surat mein un ke paas aaya jo Banu Kinana ke sardaron mein se tha, kehne laga apni qaum ka main zimmedar hoon, tum un ka be-khatar sath do aur musalmanon ke muqable ke liye mukammal tayyar ho kar jao. Khud bhi un ke sath chala, har manzil mein yeh use dekhte the, sab ko yaqeen tha ke Suraqa khud hamare sath hai, yahan tak ke ladai shuru ho gayi, us waqt yeh mardood dum daba kar bhaga. Haris bin Hisham ya Umair bin Wahab ne use jate dekh liya, us ne shor macha diya ke Suraqa kahan bhaga ja raha hai? Shaitan unhein maut aur dozakh ke munh mein dhakel kar khud farar ho gaya. Kyunke us ne Allah ke lashkaron ko musalmanon ki imdad ke liye aate hue dekh liya tha, saaf keh diya ke main tum se bari hoon, main woh dekhta hoon jo tum nahin dekhte. Is baat mein woh sacha bhi tha. Phir kehta hai main Allah ke khauf se darta hoon. Allah ke azab sakht aur bhari hain. Us ne Jibraeel (A.S) ko farishton ke sath utarte dekh liya tha, samajh gaya tha ke un ke muqable ki mujh mein ya mushrikon mein taqat nahin. Woh apne is qaul mein to jhoota tha ke main khauf-e-Ilahi karta hoon, yeh to sirf us ki zabani baat thi, darasal woh apne mein taqat hi nahin pata tha.

Yehi us dushman-e-Rabb ki aadat hai ke bharkata aur behkata hai, haq ke muqable mein la-khara kar deta hai phir ro-posh ho jata hai. Quran farmata hai shaitan insaan ko kufr ka hukum deta hai phir jab woh kufr kar chukta hai to yeh kehne lagta hai ke main tujh se bezar hoon, main Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen se darta hoon aur aayat mein hai ke jab haq wazeh ho jata hai to yeh kehta hai Allah ke wade sache hain, main khud jhoota, mere wade bhi sarasar jhoote, mera tum par koi zor dawa to tha hi nahin, tum ne to aap meri aarzu par gardan jhuka di, ab mujhe sarzanish na karo, khud apne tayin malamat karo, na main tumhein bacha sakunga na tum mere kaam aa sakoge. Is se pehle jo tum mujhe shareek-e-Rabb bana rahe thay main to aaj us ka bhi inkari hoon. Yaqeen mano ke zalimon ke liye dozakh ka azab hai. Hazrat Abu Usaid Malik bin Rabia (R.A) farmate hain agar meri aankhein aaj bhi hotin to main tumhein Badr ke maidan mein woh ghati dikha deta jahan se farishtay aate thay, beshak-o-shuba mujhe woh maloom hai. Unhein Iblees ne dekh liya aur Allah ne unhein hukum diya ke mominon ko sabit qadam rakho. Yeh logon ke paas un ke jaan pehchan ke aadmiyon ki shakal mein aate aur kehte khush ho jao, yeh kafir bhi koi cheez hain? Allah ki madad tumhare sath hai, be-khaufi ke sath sher ka sa hamla kar do. Iblees yeh dekh kar bhag khara hua, ab tak woh Suraqa ki shakal mein kuffar mein majood tha. Abu Jahl ne yeh haal dekh kar apne lashkaron mein gasht shuru kiya, keh raha tha ke ghabrao nahin, us ke bhag khare hone se dil tang na ho jao, woh to Muhammad (ﷺ) ki taraf se seekha parha aaya tha ke tumhein ain mauqe par buzdil kar de, koi ghabrane ki baat nahin, Laat-o-Uzza ki qasam! Aaj in musalmanon ko un ke Nabi samet giraftar kar lenge, namardi na karo, dil barhao aur sakht hamla karo. Dekho khabardar inhein qatl na karna, zinda pakarna taake inhein dil khol kar saza dein. Yeh bhi apne zamane ka Firaun hi tha, us ne bhi jadugaron ke imaan lane ko kaha tha ke yeh to sirf tumhara ek makr hai ke yahan se tum hamein nikal do. Us ne bhi kaha tha ke jadugaro! Yeh Musa (A.S) tumhara ustad hai halanke yeh mehez us ka fareb tha. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain Arafah ke din jis qadar Iblees haqeer-o-zaleel, ruswa aur darmanda hota hai utna kisi aur din nahin dekha gaya. Kyunke woh dekhta hai ke Allah Ta'ala ki aam maafi aur aam rehmat utri hai, har ek ke gunah umooman maaf ho jate hain, han Badr ke din us ki zillat-o-ruswai ka kuch mat poocho jab us ne dekha ke farishton ki faujein Jibraeel (A.S) ki mat-huti mein aa rahi hain. Jab dono faujein saf-bandi kar ke aamne samne aa gayin to Allah ki qudrat-o-hikmat se musalman kafiron ko bohat kam nazar aane lage aur kafir musalmanon ki nigah mein kam jachne lage. Is par kafiron ne qehqaha lagaya ke dekho musalman kaise mazhabi deewane hain? Mutthi bhar aadmi hum ek hazar ke lashkar se takra rahe hain, abhi koi dam mein in ka choora ho jayega, pehle hi hamle mein woh chot khayenge ke sar hilate reh jayenge.

Rabb-ul-Aalameen farmata hai unhein nahin maloom ke yeh mutawakkileen ka giroh hai un ka bharosa us par hai jo ghalba ka malik hai, hikmat ka malik hai Allah ke deen ki sakhti Musalmanon mein mehsoos kar ke un ki zaban se yeh kalma nikla ke unhein mazhabi deewangi hai. Dushman-e-Ilahi Abu Jahl mal'oon teele ke oopar se jhaank kar Allah walon ki kami aur be-sar-o-samani dekh kar gadhe ki tarah phool gaya aur kehne laga lo pala maar liya hai, bas aaj se Allah ki ibadat karne walon se zameen khali nazar aaye gi, abhi hum in mein se ek ek ke do do kar ke rakh dein ge. Ibn-e-Juraij kehte hain ke Musalmanon ke deen mein ta'na dene wale Makkah ke munafiq thay. Aamir kehte hain yeh chand log thay jo zabani Musalman huay thay lekin aaj Badr ke maidan mein mushrikon ke saath thay. Unhein Musalmanon ki kami aur kamzori dekh kar ta'ajjub maloom hua aur kaha ke yeh log toh mazhabi fareeb khurda hain. Mujahid kehte hain yeh Quraish ki ek jama'at thi Qais bin Waleed bin Mugheera, Abu Qais bin Faakih bin Mugheera, Haris bin Zam'ah bin Aswad bin Abdul Muttalib aur Ali bin Umayya bin Khalaf aur Aas bin Munabbih bin Hajjaj yeh Quraish ke saath thay lekin yeh mutaraddid thay aur isi mein ruke huay thay yahan Musalmanon ki halat dekh kar kehne lage yeh log toh sirf mazhabi majnoon hain warna mutthi bhar be-rasad aur be-hathyar aadmi itni tiddi dal shaukat-o-shan wali faujon ke saamne kyun khade hojate? Hasan farmate hain ke yeh log Badr ki ladayi mein nahin aaye thay un ka naam munafiq rakh diya gaya. Kehte hain ke yeh qaum Islam ka iqrar karti thi lekin mushrikon ki rau mein beh kar yahan chali aayi yahan aakar Musalmanon ka qaleel sa lashkar dekh kar unhon ne yeh kaha Janab-e-Baari Jalla Shanahu irshad farmata hai ke jo is Maalik-ul-Mulk par bharosa kare usay woh zi-izzat kar deta hai kyunke izzat us ki laundi hai, ghalba us ka ghulam hai woh buland janab hai woh bada zi-shan hai woh sacha Sultan hai. Woh Hakeem hai us ke sab kaam hikmat se hote hain woh har cheez ko us ki theek jagah rakhta hai. Mustahiqeen-e-imdad ki woh madad farmata hai aur mustahiqeen-e-zillat ko woh zaleel karta hai woh sab ko khoob jaanta hai.

Aur riwayat mein hai ke use peeth pherta dekh kar Harith bin Hisham ne pakar liya.

Usne uske munh par thappar mara jis se yeh behosh ho kar gir pada. Dusre logon ne kaha Suraqa tu is haal mein hamain zaleel karta hai? Aur aise waqt hamain dhoka deta hai? Woh kehne laga haan haan main tum se bari-uz-zimma aur be-taluq hoon, main unhein dekh raha hoon jinhein tum nahin dekh rahe. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par thodi si der ke liye ek tarah ki be-khudi si tari ho gayi, phir hoshiyar ho kar farmane lage, "Sahabiyo khush ho jao, yeh hain tumhari dayin janib Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aur yeh hain tumhari bayin taraf Mikaeel (A.S) aur yeh hain Hazrat Israfeel (A.S), teeno ma'a apni apni faujon ke aa-maujood hue hain."

Iblees Suraqa bin Malik bin Ja'sham Mudlaji ki surat mein mushrikon mein tha, un ke dilon ko badha raha tha aur un mein pesh-goiyan kar raha tha ke be-fikr raho aaj tumhein koi hara nahin sakta. Lekin farishton ke lashkar ko dekhte hi us ne to munh moda aur yeh kehta hua bhaga ke main tum se bari hoon, main unhein dekh raha hoon jo tumhari nigah mein nahin aate. Haris bin Hisham chunke use Suraqa hi samjhe hue tha is liye us ne uska hath tham liya, us ne us ke seene mein is zor se ghunsa mara ke yeh munh ke bal gir pada aur shaitan bhag gaya, samundar mein kood pada aur apna kapda uncha kar ke kehne laga, "Ya Allah main tujhe tera woh wada yaad dilata hoon jo tu ne mujh se kiya hai." Tabrani mein Hazrat Rifa'a bin Rafe' se bhi isi ke qareeb qareeb marwi hai.

Hazrat Urwa bin Zubair kehte hain jab Quraishiyon ne Makkah se nikalne ka irada kiya to unhein Bani Bakr ki jang yaad aa gayi aur khayal kiya ke aisa na ho hamari adam-maujoodgi mein yahan chadhai kar dein, qareeb tha ke woh apne irade se dast-bardar ho jayen, usi waqt Iblees-e-La'een Suraqa ki surat mein un ke paas aaya jo Banu Kinana ke sardaron mein se tha, kehne laga apni qaum ka main zimmedar hoon, tum un ka be-khatar sath do aur musalmanon ke muqable ke liye mukammal tayyar ho kar jao. Khud bhi un ke sath chala, har manzil mein yeh use dekhte the, sab ko yaqeen tha ke Suraqa khud hamare sath hai, yahan tak ke ladai shuru ho gayi, us waqt yeh mardood dum daba kar bhaga. Haris bin Hisham ya Umair bin Wahab ne use jate dekh liya, us ne shor macha diya ke Suraqa kahan bhaga ja raha hai? Shaitan unhein maut aur dozakh ke munh mein dhakel kar khud farar ho gaya. Kyunke us ne Allah ke lashkaron ko musalmanon ki imdad ke liye aate hue dekh liya tha, saaf keh diya ke main tum se bari hoon, main woh dekhta hoon jo tum nahin dekhte. Is baat mein woh sacha bhi tha. Phir kehta hai main Allah ke khauf se darta hoon. Allah ke azab sakht aur bhari hain. Us ne Jibraeel (A.S) ko farishton ke sath utarte dekh liya tha, samajh gaya tha ke un ke muqable ki mujh mein ya mushrikon mein taqat nahin. Woh apne is qaul mein to jhoota tha ke main khauf-e-Ilahi karta hoon, yeh to sirf us ki zabani baat thi, darasal woh apne mein taqat hi nahin pata tha.

Yehi us dushman-e-Rabb ki aadat hai ke bharkata aur behkata hai, haq ke muqable mein la-khara kar deta hai phir ro-posh ho jata hai. Quran farmata hai shaitan insaan ko kufr ka hukum deta hai phir jab woh kufr kar chukta hai to yeh kehne lagta hai ke main tujh se bezar hoon, main Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen se darta hoon aur aayat mein hai ke jab haq wazeh ho jata hai to yeh kehta hai Allah ke wade sache hain, main khud jhoota, mere wade bhi sarasar jhoote, mera tum par koi zor dawa to tha hi nahin, tum ne to aap meri aarzu par gardan jhuka di, ab mujhe sarzanish na karo, khud apne tayin malamat karo, na main tumhein bacha sakunga na tum mere kaam aa sakoge. Is se pehle jo tum mujhe shareek-e-Rabb bana rahe thay main to aaj us ka bhi inkari hoon. Yaqeen mano ke zalimon ke liye dozakh ka azab hai. Hazrat Abu Usaid Malik bin Rabia (R.A) farmate hain agar meri aankhein aaj bhi hotin to main tumhein Badr ke maidan mein woh ghati dikha deta jahan se farishtay aate thay, beshak-o-shuba mujhe woh maloom hai. Unhein Iblees ne dekh liya aur Allah ne unhein hukum diya ke mominon ko sabit qadam rakho. Yeh logon ke paas un ke jaan pehchan ke aadmiyon ki shakal mein aate aur kehte khush ho jao, yeh kafir bhi koi cheez hain? Allah ki madad tumhare sath hai, be-khaufi ke sath sher ka sa hamla kar do. Iblees yeh dekh kar bhag khara hua, ab tak woh Suraqa ki shakal mein kuffar mein majood tha. Abu Jahl ne yeh haal dekh kar apne lashkaron mein gasht shuru kiya, keh raha tha ke ghabrao nahin, us ke bhag khare hone se dil tang na ho jao, woh to Muhammad (ﷺ) ki taraf se seekha parha aaya tha ke tumhein ain mauqe par buzdil kar de, koi ghabrane ki baat nahin, Laat-o-Uzza ki qasam! Aaj in musalmanon ko un ke Nabi samet giraftar kar lenge, namardi na karo, dil barhao aur sakht hamla karo. Dekho khabardar inhein qatl na karna, zinda pakarna taake inhein dil khol kar saza dein. Yeh bhi apne zamane ka Firaun hi tha, us ne bhi jadugaron ke imaan lane ko kaha tha ke yeh to sirf tumhara ek makr hai ke yahan se tum hamein nikal do. Us ne bhi kaha tha ke jadugaro! Yeh Musa (A.S) tumhara ustad hai halanke yeh mehez us ka fareb tha. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain Arafah ke din jis qadar Iblees haqeer-o-zaleel, ruswa aur darmanda hota hai utna kisi aur din nahin dekha gaya. Kyunke woh dekhta hai ke Allah Ta'ala ki aam maafi aur aam rehmat utri hai, har ek ke gunah umooman maaf ho jate hain, han Badr ke din us ki zillat-o-ruswai ka kuch mat poocho jab us ne dekha ke farishton ki faujein Jibraeel (A.S) ki mat-huti mein aa rahi hain. Jab dono faujein saf-bandi kar ke aamne samne aa gayin to Allah ki qudrat-o-hikmat se musalman kafiron ko bohat kam nazar aane lage aur kafir musalmanon ki nigah mein kam jachne lage. Is par kafiron ne qehqaha lagaya ke dekho musalman kaise mazhabi deewane hain? Mutthi bhar aadmi hum ek hazar ke lashkar se takra rahe hain, abhi koi dam mein in ka choora ho jayega, pehle hi hamle mein woh chot khayenge ke sar hilate reh jayenge.

Rabb-ul-Aalameen farmata hai unhein nahin maloom ke yeh mutawakkileen ka giroh hai un ka bharosa us par hai jo ghalba ka malik hai, hikmat ka malik hai Allah ke deen ki sakhti Musalmanon mein mehsoos kar ke un ki zaban se yeh kalma nikla ke unhein mazhabi deewangi hai. Dushman-e-Ilahi Abu Jahl mal'oon teele ke oopar se jhaank kar Allah walon ki kami aur be-sar-o-samani dekh kar gadhe ki tarah phool gaya aur kehne laga lo pala maar liya hai, bas aaj se Allah ki ibadat karne walon se zameen khali nazar aaye gi, abhi hum in mein se ek ek ke do do kar ke rakh dein ge. Ibn-e-Juraij kehte hain ke Musalmanon ke deen mein ta'na dene wale Makkah ke munafiq thay. Aamir kehte hain yeh chand log thay jo zabani Musalman huay thay lekin aaj Badr ke maidan mein mushrikon ke saath thay. Unhein Musalmanon ki kami aur kamzori dekh kar ta'ajjub maloom hua aur kaha ke yeh log toh mazhabi fareeb khurda hain. Mujahid kehte hain yeh Quraish ki ek jama'at thi Qais bin Waleed bin Mugheera, Abu Qais bin Faakih bin Mugheera, Haris bin Zam'ah bin Aswad bin Abdul Muttalib aur Ali bin Umayya bin Khalaf aur Aas bin Munabbih bin Hajjaj yeh Quraish ke saath thay lekin yeh mutaraddid thay aur isi mein ruke huay thay yahan Musalmanon ki halat dekh kar kehne lage yeh log toh sirf mazhabi majnoon hain warna mutthi bhar be-rasad aur be-hathyar aadmi itni tiddi dal shaukat-o-shan wali faujon ke saamne kyun khade hojate? Hasan farmate hain ke yeh log Badr ki ladayi mein nahin aaye thay un ka naam munafiq rakh diya gaya. Kehte hain ke yeh qaum Islam ka iqrar karti thi lekin mushrikon ki rau mein beh kar yahan chali aayi yahan aakar Musalmanon ka qaleel sa lashkar dekh kar unhon ne yeh kaha Janab-e-Baari Jalla Shanahu irshad farmata hai ke jo is Maalik-ul-Mulk par bharosa kare usay woh zi-izzat kar deta hai kyunke izzat us ki laundi hai, ghalba us ka ghulam hai woh buland janab hai woh bada zi-shan hai woh sacha Sultan hai. Woh Hakeem hai us ke sab kaam hikmat se hote hain woh har cheez ko us ki theek jagah rakhta hai. Mustahiqeen-e-imdad ki woh madad farmata hai aur mustahiqeen-e-zillat ko woh zaleel karta hai woh sab ko khoob jaanta hai.

Maidan-e-Badr mein Iblees mushrikeen ka hamrahi tha. Jihad mein sabit qadmi, nek niyati, zikr-e-Allah ki kasrat ki nasihat farma kar mushrikeen ki mushabahat se rok raha hai ke jaise woh haq ko mitane aur logon mein apni bahaduri jhatane ke liye fakhr-o-ghuroor ke sath apne shehron se chale, tum aisa na karna. Chunancha Abu Jahl se jab kaha gaya ke qafila toh bach gaya ab laut kar wapas chalna chahiye toh is maloon ne jawab diya ke wah! Kis ka lautna? Badr ke pani par ja kar parao karenge. Wahan sharabein urayenge, kabab khayenge, gana sunenge taake logon mein shohrat ho jaye. Allah ki shan ke qurban jaiye, in ke arman qudrat ne palat diye, yahin in ki lashein giren aur yahin ke garhon mein zillat ke sath thons diye gaye. Allah in ke aamal ka ihata karne wala hai, in ke irade us par khule hain, isi liye inhein bure waqt se pala para. Pas yeh mushrikeen ka zikr hai jo Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) rasoolon ke sartaj se Badr mein larne chale the, in ke sath gane waliyan bhi thin, baje gaje bhi the. Shaitan-e-La'een in ka pusht panah bana hua tha, inhein phusla raha tha. In ke kaam ko khubsurat bhala dikha raha tha, in ke kanon mein phoonk raha tha ke bhala tumhein kaun hara sakta hai? In ke dil se Banu Bakr ka Makkah par charhai karne ka khauf nikal raha tha aur Suraqa bin Malik bin Ja'sham ki surat mein in ke samne khara ho kar keh raha tha ke main toh is ilaqe ka sardar hoon, Banu Mudlij sab mere tabe hain, main tumhara himayati hoon, be-fikr raho. Shaitan ka kaam bhi yahi hai ke jhoote wade de, na pura hone wali ummidon ke sabz bagh dikhaye aur dhoke ke jaal mein phansaye. Badr wale din yeh apne jhande aur lashkar ko sath le kar mushrikeen ki himayat mein nikla, in ke dilon mein dalta raha ke bas tum bazi le gaye, main tumhara madadgar hoon. Lekin jab musalmanon se muqabla shuru hua aur is khabees ki nazrein farishton par parin toh pichle pairon bhaga aur kehne laga main woh dekhta hoon jis se tumhari aankhein andhi hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) kehte hain Badr wale din Iblees apna jhanda buland kiye Mudliji shakhs ki surat mein apne lashkaron samet pohancha aur Shaitan Suraqa bin Malik bin Ja'sham ki surat mein namudar hua aur mushrikeen ke dil barhaye, himmat dilai. Jab maidan-e-jang mein saf bandi ho gayi toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne mitti ki mutthi bhar kar mushrikon ke munh par mari, is se in ke qadam ukhad gaye aur in mein bhagdar mach gayi. Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) Shaitan ki taraf chale, us waqt yeh ek mushrik ke hath mein hath diye hue tha, Aap (A.S) ko dekhte hi us ke hath se hath chura kar apne lashkaron samet bhag khara hua. Us shakhs ne kaha Suraqa! Tum toh keh rahe the ke tum hamare himayati ho, phir yeh kya kar rahe ho? Yeh maloon chunke farishton ko dekh raha tha, kehne laga main woh dekhta hoon jo tum nahin dekhte, main toh Allah se darne wala aadmi hoon, Allah ke azab bare bhari hain. Haqq yeh hai ke yeh ayat Badr ke saath makhsoos to nahin alfaz aam hain har kafir ka yehi haal hota hai. Surah Qital mein bhi is baat ka bayan hua hai aur Surah Al-An'am ki (Wa lau taraa iziz-zalimoona fee ghamaratil mauti wal-mala'ikatu basitoo aidihim, akhrijoo anfusakum, al-yauma tujzauna azabal-hooni bima kuntum taqooloona 'alallahi ghairal haqqi wa kuntum 'an ayatihi tastakbiroon) (6. Al-An'am: 93) mein bhi is ka bayan ma' tafsir guzar chuka hai. Chunke yeh nafarman log thay un ki maut se badan mein chupti phirti hain jinhein farishte jabran ghaseeta jata hai jis tarah kisi zinda shakhs ki khaal ko utara jaye isi ke saath ragein aur patthe bhi aa jate hain. Farishte is se kehte hain ab jalne ka maza chakkho. Yeh tumhari dunyawi bad-a'mali ki saza hai Allah Ta'ala zalim nahin woh to Aadil Haakim hai. Barakat-o-bulandi, ghina, pakeezgi wala buzurg aur tareefon wala hai. Chunancha Sahih Muslim Sharif ki Hadith-e-Qudsi mein hai ke mere bando Maine apne upar zulm haram kar liya hai aur tum par bhi haram kar diya hai pas aapas mein koi kisi par zulm-o-sitam na kare mere ghulamon mein to sirf tumhare kiye hue a'maal hi ko ghere hue hoon bhalayi paakar Meri tareefein karo aur is ke siwa kuch aur dekho to apne taeen hi malamat karo.

Kuffar ke liye sakrat-e-maut ka waqt bada shadeed hai. Kaash ke tu ae Paighambar dekhta ke farishte kis buri tarah kafiron ki rooh qabz karte hain woh is waqt un ke chehron aur kamaron par maarte hain aur kehte hain aag ka azab apni bad-a'maliyon ke badle chakkho. Kuffar Allah ke azli dushman hain in kafiron ne bhi tere saath wahi kiya jo un se pehle kafiron ne apne nabiyon ke saath kiya tha pas Hum ne bhi un ke saath wahi kiya jo Hum ne un se guzashta logon ke saath kiya tha jo un hi jaise the. Maslan Firauni aur un se pehle ke log jinhon ne Allah ki aayaton ko na mana jis ke ba'is Allah ki pakad un par aayi. Tamam quwwatein Allah hi ki hain aur us ke azab bhi bade bhaari hain koi nahin jo us par ghalib aa sake koi nahin jo us se bhaag sake.

Allah zalim nahin log khud apne upar zulm karte hain. Allah Ta'ala ke adl-o-insaf ka bayan ho raha hai ke woh apni di hui nematein gunahon se pehle nahin cheenta. Jaisa ke ek aur ayat mein hai Allah Ta'ala kisi qaum ki halat nahin badalta jab tak ke woh apni un baaton ko na badal dein jo un ke dilon mein hain. Jab woh kisi qaum ki baaton ki wajah se unhein burai pahunchana chahta hai to us ke irade koi badal nahin sakta. Na us ke pas koi himayati khara ho sakta hai. Tum dekh lo ke Firauniyon aur un jaise un se guzashta logon ke sath bhi yehi hua. Unhein Allah ne apni nematein dein woh siyah-kariyon mein mubtala ho gaye to Allah Ta'ala ne apne diye hue baghat, chashme, khetiyan, khazane, mahallat aur nematein jin mein woh bad-mast ho rahe thay sab cheen lein. Is bare mein unhon ne apna bura aap kiya. Allah ne un par koi zulm nahin kiya tha.

Zameen ki bad-tareen makhlooq wa'da khilaf kuffar hain. Zameen par jitne bhi chalte phirte hain un sab se bad-tar Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek be-imaan kafir hain jo ahad kar ke tor dete hain. Idhar qaul-o-qarar kiya idhar phir gaye, idhar qasmein khayein idhar tor dein. Na Allah Ta'ala ka khauf na gunah ka khatka. Pas jo un par larai mein ghalib aa jaye to aisi saza ke baad aane walon ko bhi ibrat hasil ho. Woh bhi khauf-zada ho jayein phir mumkin hai ke apne aise kartoot se baaz rahein.

Allah khainon ko pasand nahin farmata. Irshad hota hai ke ae Nabi agar kisi se tumhara ahd-o-paiman ho aur tumhein khauf ho ke yeh bad-ahdi aur wa'da khilafi karein ge to tumhein ikhtiyar diya jata hai ke barabri ki halat mein ahd-nama tod do aur unhein itte-la kardo taake woh bhi sulah ke khayal mein na rahein. Kuch din pehle hi se unhein khabar do. Allah khayanat ko napasand farmata hai kafiron se bhi tum khayanat na karo. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Ameer Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne lashkariyon ki Room ki sarhad ki taraf pesh-qadmi shuru ki ke muddat-e-sulah khatm hote hi un par achanak hamla kardein to ek sheikh apni sawari par sawar yeh kehte hue aaye ke wa'da wafai karo, uzr durust nahin. Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke jab kisi qaum se ahd-o-paiman ho jayein to na koi girah kholo na bandho jab tak ke muddat-e-sulah khatm na ho jaye ya unhein itte-la de kar ahd-nama chaak na ho jaye. Jab yeh baat Hazrat Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko pahunchi to aap ne isi waqt fauj ko wapsi ka hukm de diya. Yeh sheikh Hazrat Amr bin Anbasah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) the. Hazrat Salman Farsi (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne ek shehr ke qile ke paas pahunch kar apne sathiyon se farmaya tum mujhe bulao mein tumhein bulaun ga jaise ke mein ne Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko unhein bulate dekha hai. Phir farmaya mein bhi unhi mein se ek shakhs tha pas mujhe Allah Azzawajal ne Islam ki hidayat ki agar tum bhi Musalman ho jao to jo hamara haq hai wahi tumhara haq hoga aur jo hum par hai tum par bhi wahi hoga aur agar tum ise nahin mante to zillat ke sath tumhein jizya dena hoga ise bhi qabool na karo to hum tumhein abhi se mutla karte hain jabke hum tum barabri ki halat mein hain Allah Ta'ala khayanat karne walon ko pasand nahin rakhta. Teen din tak unhein isi tarah dawat di aakhir chauthe roz subh hi hamla kar diya. Allah Ta'ala ne fatah di aur madad farmai.

Kuffar ke muqabla ke har waqt tayyar raho. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke kafir log yeh na samajhein ke woh hum se bhaag niklay hum un ki pakad par qadir nahin balkay woh har waqt humare qabza-e-qudrat mein hain woh humein hara nahin sakte aur aayat mein hai buraiyan karne wale hum se aage badh nahin sakte. Farmata hai kafir humein yahan hara nahin sakte wahan ka thikana aag hai jo bad-tareen jagah hai aur farman hai kafiron ka shahron mein aana jaana chalna phirna kahin tujhe dhokay mein na daal dey. Yeh toh sab aani jaani cheezein hain un ka thikana dozakh hai jo bad-tareen god hai. Phir musalmanon ko hukam deta hai ke apni taqat-o-imkaan ke mutabiq un kuffar ke muqablay ke liye har waqt musta'id raho jo quwwat taqat ghode, lashkar rakh sakte hain maujood rakho. Musnad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne minbar par quwwat ki tafseer teer andazi se ki aur do martaba yehi farmaya teer andazi kiya karo sawari kiya karo aur teer andazi ghode sawari se behtar hai. Farmate hain ghodon ke palne wale teen qisam ke hain ek toh ajr-o-sawab pane wale, ek na toh sawab na azab pane wale ek azab bhugatne wale. Jo jihad ke iraday se pale us ke ghode ka chalna phirna tairna, chagna ba'is-e-sawab hai yahan tak ke agar woh apni rassi tod kar kahin chadh jaye toh bhi us ke nishanat-e-qadam aur us ki leed par usay nekiyan milti hain kisi nahar par guzarte hue woh pani pee ley agarcha mujahid ne pilane ka irada na bhi kiya ho taham usay nekiyan milti hain. Pas yeh ghoda toh us ke palne wale ke liye bade ajr-o-sawab ka zariya hai. Aur jis shakhs ne ghoda us niyat se pala ke woh doosron se be-niyaz hojaye phir Allah ka haq bhi us ki gardan aur us ki sawari mein nahin bhoola yeh us ke liye ja'iz hai yani na usay ajr na usay gunah. Teesra woh shakhs jis ne fakhr-o-riya ke taur par pala aur musalmanon ke muqablay ke liye woh us ke zimme wabaal hai aur us ki gardan par bojh hai Aap se daryaft kiya gaya ke achha gadhon ke bare mein kya hukam hai? Farmaya us ke bare mein koi aayat toh utri nahin haan yeh jami' aam aayat maujood hai ke jo shakhs ek zarray ke barabar neki karega woh usay dekh lega aur jo koi ek zarray ke barabar bhi burai karega woh usay dekh lega. Yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai aur hadith mein yeh alfaaz hain ghode teen tarah ke hain: Rehman ke, Shaitan ke aur Insaan ke. Us mein hai ke shaitani ghode woh hain jo ghod daud ki shartein lagane aur juway baazi karne ke liye hon. Aksar ulema ka qaul hai ke teer andazi ghode sawari se afzal hai. Imam Malik is ke khilaaf hain lekin jamhoor ka qaul qawi hai kyunke hadith mein aa chuka hai. Hazrat Muawiyah bin Khadeej (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) Hazrat Abu Zar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke paas gaye us waqt woh apne ghode ki khidmat kar rahe the poochha tumhein yeh ghoda kya kaam aata hai? Farmaya mera khayal hai ke is jaanwar ki dua mere haq mein qabool hogi. Kaha jaanwar aur dua?

Farmaya haan Allah ki qasam har ghora har subh dua karta hai ke ae Allah Tu ne mujhe Apne bandon mein se ek ke hawale kiya hai to mujhe us ki tamam ahl se aur maal se aur aulad se zyada mahboob bana kar us ke paas rakh. Ek marfu hadith mein hai ke har Arabi ghore ko har subh do duaein karne ki ijazat milti hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ghoron ki peshaniyon mein bhalayi bandhi hui hai, ghoron wale Allah ki madad mein hain, ise nek niyati se jihad ke irade se palne wala aisa hai jaise koi shakhs har waqt hath barhakar khairat karta hai. Aur bhi hadithein is bare mein bahut si hain. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein bhalayi ki tafseel hai ke ajr aur ghanimat. Farmata hai is se tumhare dushman khauf-zada aur haibat-khurda rahein ge, in zahiri muqable ke dushmano ke alawa aur dushman bhi hain yaani Banu Qurayzah, Faris aur mahallon ke shayateen. Ek marfu hadith mein bhi hai ke is se murad jinnat hain. Ek munkar hadith mein hai jis ghar mein koi azad ghora ho woh ghar kabhi bad-naseeb nahin hoga lekin is riwayat ki na to sanad theek hai na yeh sahih hai. Aur is se murad munafiq bhi li gayi hai. Aur yahi qaul zyada munasib bhi hai jaise Farman-e-Ilahi hai: (Wa mimman hawlakum minal-A'rabi munafiqun, wa min ahlil-Madinati maradu 'alan-nifaqi la ta'lamuhum, Nahnu na'lamuhum, sanu'azzibuhum marratayni thumma yuradduna ila 'azabin 'azeem) (9: Surah At-Taubah: 101). Tumhare charon taraf dehati aur shehri munafiq hain jinhein tum nahin jante lekin Hum un se khoob waqif hain. Phir irshad hai ke jihad mein jo kuch tum kharch karo ge us ka poora badla pao ge. Abu Dawood mein hai ke ek dirham ka sawab saat sau guna kar ke mile ga jaise ke: (Mathalul-ladheena yunfiquna amwalahum fee sabilillahi kamathali habbatin ambatat sab'a sanabila fee kulli sumbulatim-mi'atu habbah, wallahu yuda'ifu limay-yasha'u wallahu Wasi'un 'Aleem) (2: Surah Al-Baqarah: 261). Utri to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke woh bhi jo sawal kare chahe woh kisi deen ka ho us ke sath husn-e-sulook karo. Yeh riwayat ghareeb hai Ibn Abi Hatim ne ise riwayat kiya hai.

Jis qaum se bad-ahdi ka khauf ho unhein aagah kar ke ahad-nama chaak kar do farman hai ke jab kisi qaum ki khayanat ka khauf ho to barabri se aagah kar ke ahad-nama chaak kar dalo, ladayi ki ittela kardo. Is ke baad agar woh ladayi par aamadgi zahir karein to Allah par bharosa kar ke jihad shuru kardo aur agar woh phir sulah par aamada hojayein to tum phir sulah-o-safayi karlo. Isi ayat ki tameel mein Hudaibiya wale din Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Mushrikeen-e-Makkah se nau saal ki muddat ke liye sulah karli jo sharait ke sath tay hui. Hazrat Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se manqool hai ke Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya anqareeb ikhtelaf hoga aur behtar yeh hai ke ho sake to sulah hi karlena (Musnad Imam Ahmad). Bohat se buzurgon ka khayal hai ke Surah Bara'at ki ayat se (Qātilul-laḏīna lā yu’minūna billāhi wa lā bil-yawmil-ākhiri wa lā yuḥarrimūna mā ḥarramallāhu wa rasūluhū wa lā yadīnūna dīnal-ḥaqqi minal-laḏīna ūtul-kitāba ḥattā yu‘ṭul-jizyata ‘ay-yadin wa hum ṣāghirūn 29) (9. At-Taubah: 29) se mansookh hai lekin is mein bhi nazar hai kyunke is ayat mein jihad ka hukm taqat-o-isteta'at par hai lekin dushmano ki zyadati ke waqt un se sulah karlena bila-shak-o-shubha jaiz hai jaise ke is ayat mein hai aur jaise ke Hudaibiya ki sulah Allah ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ki. Pas is ke bare mein koi nass is ke khilaf ya khusoosiyat ya mansookhiyat ki nahin aayi Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmata hai Allah par bharosa rakh wahi tujhe kafi hai wahi tera madadgar hai. Agar yeh dhoka-baazi kar ke koi fareb dena chahte hain aur is darmiyan mein apni shan-o-shaukat aur aalaat-e-jang badhana chahte hain to tu be-fikr reh Allah tera taraf-dar hai aur tujhe kafi hai is ke muqable ka koi nahin phir apni ek aala nemat ka zikr farmata hai ke Muhajireen-o-Ansar se sirf apne fazl se teri tayeed ki. Unhein tujh par iman lane teri ata'at karne ki taufiq di. Teri madad aur teri nusrat par unhein aamada kiya. Agarche aap ruye-zameen ke tamam khazane kharch kar dalte lekin un mein woh ulfat woh muhabbat paida na karsakta jo Allah ne khud kardi. Un ki sadiyon purani adawatein door kardein aur Aus-o-Khazraj Ansar ke donon qabeelon mein jahiliyat mein aapas mein khoob talwar chala karti thi. Noor-e-Iman ne is adawat ko muhabbat se badal diya. Jaise Quran ka bayan hai ke Allah ke is ehsan ko yaad karo ke tum aapas mein ek doosre ke dushman the us ne tumhare dil mila diye aur apne fazl se tumhein bhai bhai bana diya tum jahannam ke kinare tak pahunch gaye the lekin us ne tumhein bacha liya. Allah Ta'ala tumhari hidayat ke liye isi tarah apni baatein bayan farmata hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Hunain ke maal-e-ghanimat ki taqseem ke waqt Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Ansar se farmaya ke ae Ansariyo kya maine tumhein gumrahi ki halat mein paakar Allah ki inayat se tumhein rah-e-rast nahin dikhayi?

Kya tum faqeer na the? Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein meri wajah se ameer kar diya, juda juda the Allah Ta'ala ne meri wajah se tumhare dil mila diye. Aap ki har baat par insaf kehte jaate the ke beshak Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka is se bhi ziyada ehsan hum par hai. Al-gharaz apne is in'am-o-ikram ko bayan farma kar apni izzat-o-hikmat ka izhar kiya ke woh buland-janab hai us se umeed rakhne wala na-umeed nahin rehta us par tawakkul karne wala sarsabz rehta hai aur apne kaamon mein apne hukmon mein hakeem hai. Ibn Abbas farmate hain is se qarabat-dari ke rishte toot jaate hain aur yeh tab hota hai jab ne'mat ki nashukri ki jaati hai. Janab-e-Bari Subhanahu Wa Ta'ala ka irshad hai ke agar rooy-e-zameen ke khazane bhi khatam kar deta to tere bas mein na tha ke un ke dil mila de. Sha'ir kehta hai tujh se dhoka karne wala tujh se be-parwahi bartne wala tera rishtedar nahin balke tera haqeeqi rishtedar woh hai jo teri aawaz par labbaik kahe aur tere dushmanon ki sarkobi mein tera saath de. Aur sha'ir kehta hai mein ne to khoob mil-jul kar aazma kar dekh liya ke qarabat-dari se bhi barh kar dilon ka mail-jool hai. Imam Baihaqi farmate hain mein na jaan saka ke yeh sab qaul Ibn Abbas ka hai ya un se neeche ke rawiyon mein se kisi ka hai. Ibn Mas'ood farmate hain un ki yeh muhabbat rah-e-haq mein thi tauheed-o-sunnat ki bina par thi. Ibn Abbas farmate hain rishtedariyan toot jaati hain ehsan ki bhi nashukri kar di jaati hai lekin jab Allah ki jaanib se dil mila diye jaate hain unhein koi juda nahin kar sakta hai phir aap ne isi jumlay ki tilawat farma'i. Abdah bin Abi Lubabah farmate hain meri Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah / R.H) se mulaqat hui aap ne mujh se musafaha kar ke farmaya ke jab do shakhs Allah ki rah mein muhabbat rakhne wale aapas mein milte hain ek doosre se khandah-peshani se haath milate hain to donon ke gunah aise jhar jaate hain jaise darakht ke khushk patte mein ne kaha yeh kaam to bahut aasan hai farmaya yeh na kaho yahi ulfat woh hai jis ki nisbat Janab-e-Bari farmata hai ke agar rooy-e-zameen ke khazane kharch kar de to bhi yeh tere bas ki baat nahin ke dilon mein ulfat-o-muhabbat paida kar de. Un ke is farman se mujhe yaqeen ho gaya ke yeh mujh se bahut ziyada samajh-dar hain. Waleed bin Abi Mugheeth kehte hain mein ne Hazrat Mujahid se suna ke jab do musalman aapas mein milte hain aur musafaha karte hain to un ke gunah ma'af ho jaate hain mein ne poochha sirf musafaha se hee? To aap ne farmaya kya tum ne Allah ka yeh farman nahin suna? Phir aap ne isi jumlay ki tilawat ki. To Hazrat Waleed ne farmaya tum mujh se bahut bare aalim ho. Umair bin Ishaq kehte hain sab se pehle cheez jo logon mein se uth jaye gi woh ulfat-o-muhabbat hai. Tabrani mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke musalman jab apne musalman bhai se mil kar us se musafaha karta hai to donon ke gunah aise jhar jaate hain jaise darakht ke khushk patte hawa se. Un ke sab gunah ma'af kar diye jaate hain go woh samundar ki jhaag jitne hon.

Ek ghazi das kuffar pe bhari. Allah Ta'ala apne Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur Musalmanon ko jihad ki raghbat dila raha hai aur unhein itminan dila raha hai ke woh unhein dushmanon par ghalib kare ga chahe woh saz-o-saman aur afradi quwwat mein zyada hon, tiddi dal hon aur go Musalman be-saro-saman aur mutthi bhar hon. Farmata hai Allah kafi hai aur jitne Musalman tere saath hon ge wahi kafi hain. Phir apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukm deta hai ke momino ko jihad ki raghbat dilate raho. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) saf bandi ke waqt muqable ke waqt barabar faujon ka dil barhate. Badr ke din farmaya utho us jannat ko hasil karo jis ki chorayi asman-o-zamin ki hai. Hazrat Umair bin Humam kehte hain itni chorayi? Farmaya haan haan itni hi. Usne kaha wah wah. Aap ne farmaya yeh kis irade se kaha? Kaha is umeed par ke Allah mujhe bhi jannati kar de. Aap ne farmaya meri pesh-goi hai ke tu jannati hai. Woh uthte hain dushman ki taraf barhte hain apni talwar ka miyan tor dete hain kuch khajurein jo paas hain khani shuru karte hain. Phir farmate hain jitni der mein unhein khaoon itni der tak bhi ab yahan theherna mujh par shaq hai. Unhein hath se phenk dete hain aur hamla kar ke sher ki tarah dushman ke beech mein ghus jate hain aur jauhar-e-talwar dikhate hue kafiron ki gardanein marte hain aur hamla karte hue shaheed ho jate hain (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) wa Rajaa. Ibn al-Musayyib aur Sa'id bin Jubair farmate hain yeh ayat Hazrat Umar ke Islam ke waqt utri jabke Musalmanon ki tadad poori chalis ki hui. Lekin is mein zara nazar hai is liye ke yeh ayat Madni hai Hazrat Umar ke Islam ka waqia Makkah Sharif ka hai. Habsha ki hijrat ke baad aur Madinah ki hijrat se pehle ka. Wallahu A'lam. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala momino ko bisharat deta hai aur hukm farmata hai ke tum mein se bees in kafiron mein se do sau par ghalib aaein ge. Ek sau ek hazar par ghalib rahein ge gharaz ek Musalman das kafiron ke muqable ka hai. Phir hukm mansookh ho gaya lekin bisharat baqi hai jab yeh hukm Musalmanon par giran guzra. Ek das ke muqable se zara jhijhka to Allah Ta'ala ne takhfeef kar di aur farmaya. Ab Allah ne bojh halka kar diya. Lekin jitni tadad kam hui utna hi sabr naqis ho gaya pehle hukm tha ke bees Musalman do sau kafiron se peeche na hatein ab yeh hua ke apne se dugni tadad yani sau do sau se na bhagein. Pas girani guzarne par zaifi aur natawani ko qabool farma kar Allah ne takhfeef kar di. Pas dugni tadad ke kafiron se to larayi mein peeche hatna layeq nahin haan is se zyadati ke waqt tarah de jana jurm nahin. Ibn Umar farmate hain yeh ayat hum sahabiyon ke bare mein utri hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ayat parh kar farmaya pehla hukm uth gaya. (Mustadrak Hakim)

Ek ghazi das kuffar pe bhari. Allah Ta'ala apne Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur Musalmanon ko jihad ki raghbat dila raha hai aur unhein itminan dila raha hai ke woh unhein dushmanon par ghalib kare ga chahe woh saz-o-saman aur afradi quwwat mein zyada hon, tiddi dal hon aur go Musalman be-saro-saman aur mutthi bhar hon. Farmata hai Allah kafi hai aur jitne Musalman tere saath hon ge wahi kafi hain. Phir apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukm deta hai ke momino ko jihad ki raghbat dilate raho. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) saf bandi ke waqt muqable ke waqt barabar faujon ka dil barhate. Badr ke din farmaya utho us jannat ko hasil karo jis ki chorayi asman-o-zamin ki hai. Hazrat Umair bin Humam kehte hain itni chorayi? Farmaya haan haan itni hi. Usne kaha wah wah. Aap ne farmaya yeh kis irade se kaha? Kaha is umeed par ke Allah mujhe bhi jannati kar de. Aap ne farmaya meri pesh-goi hai ke tu jannati hai. Woh uthte hain dushman ki taraf barhte hain apni talwar ka miyan tor dete hain kuch khajurein jo paas hain khani shuru karte hain. Phir farmate hain jitni der mein unhein khaoon itni der tak bhi ab yahan theherna mujh par shaq hai. Unhein hath se phenk dete hain aur hamla kar ke sher ki tarah dushman ke beech mein ghus jate hain aur jauhar-e-talwar dikhate hue kafiron ki gardanein marte hain aur hamla karte hue shaheed ho jate hain (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) wa Rajaa. Aseeran-e-Badr aur mashwara Musnad Imam Ahmad mein hai ke Badr ke qaidiyon ke baare mein Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Sahaba-e-Kiram (Rizwanullahi Alaihim Ajma'een) se mashwara liya ke Allah ne unhein tumhare qabze mein de diya hai batao kya irada hai? Hazrat Umar bin Khattab ne khade ho kar arz kiya ke in ki gardanein uda di jayein Aap ne un se munh pher liya phir farmaya Allah ne tumhare bas mein kar diya hai yeh kal tak tumhare bhai band hi thay. Phir Hazrat Umar ne khade ho kar apna jawab doharaya Aap ne phir munh pher liya aur phir wahi farmaya ab ki dafa Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) khade hue aur arz kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamari raye mein to Aap in ki khata se darguzar farma lijiye aur unhein fidya le kar azad kijiye ab Aap ke chehre se gham ke aasar jaate rahe afw-e-aam kar diya aur fidya le kar sab ko azad kar diya is par Allah Azzawajal ne yeh ayat utari. Isi Surah ke shuru mein Ibn Abbas ki Riwayat guzar chuki hai Sahih Muslim mein bhi isi jaisi hadith hai ke Badr ke din Aap ne daryaft farmaya ke in qaidiyon ke baare mein tum kya kehte ho? Hazrat Abu Bakr ne arz kiya Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki qaum ke hain, Aap wale hain unhein zinda chhoda jaye un se tauba kara li jaye gi ajab ke kal Allah ki un par mehrbani ho jaye lekin Hazrat Umar ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jhutlane wale Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko nikal dene wale hain hukm dijiye ke in ki gardanein maari jayein. Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawaha (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) isi maidan mein darakht bakasrat hain aag lagwa dijiye aur unhein jala dijiye Aap khamosh ho rahe kisi ko koi jawab nahin diya aur uth kar tashreef le gaye logon mein bhi in teeno buzurgon ki raye ka saath dene wale ho gaye itne mein Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) phir tashreef laye aur farmane lage baaz dil narm hote hote doodh se bhi zyada narm ho jate hain aur baaz dil sakht hote hote patthar se bhi zyada sakht ho jate hain. Ae Abu Bakr tumhari misal Aan-Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam / A.S) jaisi hai ke Allah se arz karte hain ke mere tabedar to mere hain hi lekin mukhalif bhi Teri maafi aur bakhshish ke matahat hain aur tumhari misal Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) jaisi hai jo kahein ge Ya Allah agar Tu unhein azab kare to woh Tere bande hain aur agar unhein bakhsh de to Tu Aziz-o-Hakeem hai aur ae Umar tumhari misal Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam / A.S) jaisi hai jinhon ne apni qaum par bad-dua ki ke Ya Allah zameen par kisi kafir ko basta hua baqi na rakh. Suno tumhein is waqt ehtiyaj hai in qaidiyon mein se koi bhi baghair fidiye ke raha na ho warna in ki gardanein maari jayein. Is par Ibn Mas'ood (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne darkhwast ki ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Suhail bin Baiza ko is se makhsoos kar liya jaye is liye woh Islam ka zikr kiya karta tha is par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khamosh ho gaye Wallah mein sara din khauf-zada raha ke kahin mujh par aasman se patthar na barsaye jayein yahan tak Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya magar Suhail bin Baiza isi ka zikr is ayat mein hai yeh hadith Tirmidhi Musnad Ahmad waghaira mein hai.

In qaidiyon mein Abbas bhi thay unhein ek Ansari ne giraftar kiya tha Ansar ka khayal tha ke usay qatl kardein aap ko bhi yeh haal maloom tha Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya raat ko mujhe is khayal se neend nahin aayi. Is par Hazrat Umar ne farmaya agar Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ijazat dein to mein Ansar ke paas jaon Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ijazat di Hazrat Umar Ansar ke paas aaye aur kaha Abbas ko chhor do unhon ne jawab diya Wallah hum isay na chhorein aap ne farmaya go Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki razamandi isi mein ho? Unhon ne kaha ke agar aisa hai to aap ab unhein le jayein hum ne bakhushi chhora. Ab Hazrat Umar ne un se kaha ke Abbas ab Musalman ho jao Wallah tumhare Islam laane se mujhe apne baap ke Islam laane se bhi zyada khushi hogi is liye ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tumhare Islam laane se khush ho jayein ge. In qaidiyon ke baare mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Abu Bakr se mashwara liya to aap ne to farmaya yeh sab hamare hi kunbe qabile ke log hain unhein chhor dijiye Hazrat Umar se jab mashwara liya to aap ne jawab diya ke in sab ko qatl kar diya jaye. Aakhir aap ne fidya le kar unhein azad kiya. Hazrat Ali farmate hain Hazrat Jibraeel (Alaihis Salam / A.S) aaye aur farmaya ke apne Sahaba ko ikhtiyar dijiye ke woh in do baaton mein se ek ko pasand kar lein agar chahein to fidya le lein aur agar chahein to in qaidiyon ko qatl kar dein lekin yeh yaad rahe ke fidya lene ki surat mein agle saal un mein itne hi shaheed hon ge. Sahaba ne kaha humein yeh manzoor hai aur hum fidya le kar chhorein ge (Tirmidhi Nasai waghera) lekin yeh hadith bahut hi ghareeb hai. In Badri qaidiyon ke baare mein Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke ae Sahabiyo agar chaho to unhein qatl kar do aur agar chaho un se zar-e-fidya wasool kar ke unhein raha kar do lekin is surat mein itne hi aadmi tumhare shaheed kiye jayein ge. Pas in sattar shaheedon mein sab se aakhir Hazrat Thabit bin Qais (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) thay jo Jang-e-Yamama mein shaheed huye (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) yeh riwayat Hazrat Ubaidah se mursalan bhi marwi hai Wallahu A'lam. Agar pehle hi se Allah ki kitab mein tumhare liye maal-e-ghanimat se halal na likha hua hota aur jab tak hum bayan na farma dein tab tak azab nahin kiya karte aisa dastoor hamara na hota to jo maal-e-fidya tum ne liya us par tumhein bada bhaari azab hota isi tarah pehle se Allah tay kar chuka hai ke kisi Badri Sahabi ko woh azab nahin kare ga. Un ke liye maghfirat ki tehreer ho chuki hai. Umm-ul-Kitab mein tumhare liye maal-e-ghanimat ki hillat likhi ja chuki hai. Pas maal-e-ghanimat tumhare liye halal tayyib hai shauq se khao piyo aur apne kaam mein lao. Pehle likha ja chuka tha ke is ummat ke liye yeh halal hai yahi qaul Imam Ibn Jareer ka pasandida hai aur isi ki shahadat Bukhari Muslim ki hadith se milti hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe paanch cheezein di gayin jo mujh se pehle kisi nabi ko nahin di gayin mahine bhar ke faasle tak meri madad raub se ki gayi.

Mere liye poori zameen masjid, paaki aur namaz ki jagah bana di gayi, mujh par ghanimatein halal ki gayin jo mujh se pehle kisi par halal na theen, mujhe shafa'at ata farmai gayi, har nabi khassatan apni qaum ki taraf hi bheja jata tha lekin mein aam logon ki taraf Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bana kar bheja gaya hoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain kisi siyah sar wale insan ke liye mere siwa ghanimat halal nahin ki gayi. Pas Sahaba ne in Badri qaidiyon se fidiya liya aur Abu Dawood mein hai har ek se char sau ki raqam bator-e-tawan-e-jang ke wasool ki gayi. Pas jumhoor ulama-e-kiram ka mazhab yeh hai ke Imam-e-waqt ko ikhtiyar hai ke agar chahe qaidi kuffar ko qatl kar de, jaise Banu Quraiza ke qaidiyon ke sath Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kiya. Agar chahe badle ka maal le kar unhein chhor de jaise ke Badri qaidiyon ke sath Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kiya ya Musalman qaidiyon ke badle chhor de jaise ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne qabila Salama bin Akwa ki ek aurat aur uski larki mushrikon ke paas jo Musalman qaidi the unke badle mein diya aur agar chahe unhein ghulam bana kar rakhe. Yehi mazhab Imam Shafi'i ka aur ulama-e-kiram ki ek jama'at ka hai. Go auron ne iska khilaf bhi kiya hai yahan iski tafseel ki jagah nahin.

Agar pehle hi se Allah ki kitab mein tumhare liye maal-e-ghanimat se halal na likha hua hota aur jab tak hum bayan na farma dein tab tak azab nahin kiya karte aisa dastoor hamara na hota to jo maal-e-fidya tum ne liya us par tumhein bada bhaari azab hota isi tarah pehle se Allah tay kar chuka hai ke kisi Badri Sahabi ko woh azab nahin kare ga. Un ke liye maghfirat ki tehreer ho chuki hai. Umm-ul-Kitab mein tumhare liye maal-e-ghanimat ki hillat likhi ja chuki hai. Pas maal-e-ghanimat tumhare liye halal tayyib hai shauq se khao piyo aur apne kaam mein lao. Pehle likha ja chuka tha ke is ummat ke liye yeh halal hai yahi qaul Imam Ibn Jareer ka pasandida hai aur isi ki shahadat Bukhari Muslim ki hadith se milti hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe paanch cheezein di gayin jo mujh se pehle kisi nabi ko nahin di gayin mahine bhar ke faasle tak meri madad raub se ki gayi.

Mere liye poori zameen masjid, paaki aur namaz ki jagah bana di gayi, mujh par ghanimatein halal ki gayin jo mujh se pehle kisi par halal na theen, mujhe shafa'at ata farmai gayi, har nabi khassatan apni qaum ki taraf hi bheja jata tha lekin mein aam logon ki taraf Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bana kar bheja gaya hoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain kisi siyah sar wale insan ke liye mere siwa ghanimat halal nahin ki gayi. Pas Sahaba ne in Badri qaidiyon se fidiya liya aur Abu Dawood mein hai har ek se char sau ki raqam bator-e-tawan-e-jang ke wasool ki gayi. Pas jumhoor ulama-e-kiram ka mazhab yeh hai ke Imam-e-waqt ko ikhtiyar hai ke agar chahe qaidi kuffar ko qatl kar de, jaise Banu Quraiza ke qaidiyon ke sath Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kiya. Agar chahe badle ka maal le kar unhein chhor de jaise ke Badri qaidiyon ke sath Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kiya ya Musalman qaidiyon ke badle chhor de jaise ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne qabila Salama bin Akwa ki ek aurat aur uski larki mushrikon ke paas jo Musalman qaidi the unke badle mein diya aur agar chahe unhein ghulam bana kar rakhe. Yehi mazhab Imam Shafi'i ka aur ulama-e-kiram ki ek jama'at ka hai. Go auron ne iska khilaf bhi kiya hai yahan iski tafseel ki jagah nahin.

Aseeran-e-Badr aur mashwara Musnad Imam Ahmad mein hai ke Badr ke qaidiyon ke baare mein Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Sahaba-e-Kiram (Rizwanullahi Alaihim Ajma'een) se mashwara liya ke Allah ne unhein tumhare qabze mein de diya hai batao kya irada hai? Hazrat Umar bin Khattab ne khade ho kar arz kiya ke in ki gardanein uda di jayein Aap ne un se munh pher liya phir farmaya Allah ne tumhare bas mein kar diya hai yeh kal tak tumhare bhai band hi thay. Phir Hazrat Umar ne khade ho kar apna jawab doharaya Aap ne phir munh pher liya aur phir wahi farmaya ab ki dafa Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) khade hue aur arz kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamari raye mein to Aap in ki khata se darguzar farma lijiye aur unhein fidya le kar azad kijiye ab Aap ke chehre se gham ke aasar jaate rahe afw-e-aam kar diya aur fidya le kar sab ko azad kar diya is par Allah Azzawajal ne yeh ayat utari. Isi Surah ke shuru mein Ibn Abbas ki Riwayat guzar chuki hai Sahih Muslim mein bhi isi jaisi hadith hai ke Badr ke din Aap ne daryaft farmaya ke in qaidiyon ke baare mein tum kya kehte ho? Hazrat Abu Bakr ne arz kiya Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki qaum ke hain, Aap wale hain unhein zinda chhoda jaye un se tauba kara li jaye gi ajab ke kal Allah ki un par mehrbani ho jaye lekin Hazrat Umar ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jhutlane wale Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko nikal dene wale hain hukm dijiye ke in ki gardanein maari jayein. Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawaha (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) isi maidan mein darakht bakasrat hain aag lagwa dijiye aur unhein jala dijiye Aap khamosh ho rahe kisi ko koi jawab nahin diya aur uth kar tashreef le gaye logon mein bhi in teeno buzurgon ki raye ka saath dene wale ho gaye itne mein Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) phir tashreef laye aur farmane lage baaz dil narm hote hote doodh se bhi zyada narm ho jate hain aur baaz dil sakht hote hote patthar se bhi zyada sakht ho jate hain. Ae Abu Bakr tumhari misal Aan-Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam / A.S) jaisi hai ke Allah se arz karte hain ke mere tabedar to mere hain hi lekin mukhalif bhi Teri maafi aur bakhshish ke matahat hain aur tumhari misal Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) jaisi hai jo kahein ge Ya Allah agar Tu unhein azab kare to woh Tere bande hain aur agar unhein bakhsh de to Tu Aziz-o-Hakeem hai aur ae Umar tumhari misal Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam / A.S) jaisi hai jinhon ne apni qaum par bad-dua ki ke Ya Allah zameen par kisi kafir ko basta hua baqi na rakh. Suno tumhein is waqt ehtiyaj hai in qaidiyon mein se koi bhi baghair fidiye ke raha na ho warna in ki gardanein maari jayein. Is par Ibn Mas'ood (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne darkhwast ki ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Suhail bin Baiza ko is se makhsoos kar liya jaye is liye woh Islam ka zikr kiya karta tha is par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khamosh ho gaye Wallah mein sara din khauf-zada raha ke kahin mujh par aasman se patthar na barsaye jayein yahan tak Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya magar Suhail bin Baiza isi ka zikr is ayat mein hai yeh hadith Tirmidhi Musnad Ahmad waghaira mein hai.

In qaidiyon mein Abbas bhi thay unhein ek Ansari ne giraftar kiya tha Ansar ka khayal tha ke usay qatl kardein aap ko bhi yeh haal maloom tha Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya raat ko mujhe is khayal se neend nahin aayi. Is par Hazrat Umar ne farmaya agar Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ijazat dein to mein Ansar ke paas jaon Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ijazat di Hazrat Umar Ansar ke paas aaye aur kaha Abbas ko chhor do unhon ne jawab diya Wallah hum isay na chhorein aap ne farmaya go Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki razamandi isi mein ho? Unhon ne kaha ke agar aisa hai to aap ab unhein le jayein hum ne bakhushi chhora. Ab Hazrat Umar ne un se kaha ke Abbas ab Musalman ho jao Wallah tumhare Islam laane se mujhe apne baap ke Islam laane se bhi zyada khushi hogi is liye ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tumhare Islam laane se khush ho jayein ge. In qaidiyon ke baare mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Abu Bakr se mashwara liya to aap ne to farmaya yeh sab hamare hi kunbe qabile ke log hain unhein chhor dijiye Hazrat Umar se jab mashwara liya to aap ne jawab diya ke in sab ko qatl kar diya jaye. Aakhir aap ne fidya le kar unhein azad kiya. Hazrat Ali farmate hain Hazrat Jibraeel (Alaihis Salam / A.S) aaye aur farmaya ke apne Sahaba ko ikhtiyar dijiye ke woh in do baaton mein se ek ko pasand kar lein agar chahein to fidya le lein aur agar chahein to in qaidiyon ko qatl kar dein lekin yeh yaad rahe ke fidya lene ki surat mein agle saal un mein itne hi shaheed hon ge. Sahaba ne kaha humein yeh manzoor hai aur hum fidya le kar chhorein ge (Tirmidhi Nasai waghera) lekin yeh hadith bahut hi ghareeb hai. In Badri qaidiyon ke baare mein Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke ae Sahabiyo agar chaho to unhein qatl kar do aur agar chaho un se zar-e-fidya wasool kar ke unhein raha kar do lekin is surat mein itne hi aadmi tumhare shaheed kiye jayein ge. Un ke liye maghfirat ki tehreer ho chuki hai. Umm-ul-Kitab mein tumhare liye maal-e-ghanimat ki hillat likhi ja chuki hai. Pas maal-e-ghanimat tumhare liye halal tayyib hai shauq se khao piyo aur apne kaam mein lao. Mere liye poori zameen masjid, paaki aur namaz ki jagah bana di gayi, mujh par ghanimatein halal ki gayin jo mujh se pehle kisi par halal na theen, mujhe shafa'at ata farmai gayi, har nabi khassatan apni qaum ki taraf hi bheja jata tha lekin mein aam logon ki taraf Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bana kar bheja gaya hoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain kisi siyah sar wale insan ke liye mere siwa ghanimat halal nahin ki gayi. Pas Sahaba ne in Badri qaidiyon se fidiya liya aur Abu Dawood mein hai har ek se char sau ki raqam bator-e-tawan-e-jang ke wasool ki gayi. Pas jumhoor ulama-e-kiram ka mazhab yeh hai ke Imam-e-waqt ko ikhtiyar hai ke agar chahe qaidi kuffar ko qatl kar de, jaise Banu Quraiza ke qaidiyon ke sath Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kiya. Agar chahe badle ka maal le kar unhein chhor de jaise ke Badri qaidiyon ke sath Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kiya ya Musalman qaidiyon ke badle chhor de jaise ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne qabila Salama bin Akwa ki ek aurat aur uski larki mushrikon ke paas jo Musalman qaidi the unke badle mein diya aur agar chahe unhein ghulam bana kar rakhe. Yehi mazhab Imam Shafi'i ka aur ulama-e-kiram ki ek jama'at ka hai. Go auron ne iska khilaf bhi kiya hai yahan iski tafseel ki jagah nahin.

Fidya tay ho gaya. Badr wale din Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tha ke mujhe yaqinan maloom hai ke baaz Banu Hashim waghera zabardasti is ladayi mein nikale gaye hain, unhein hum se ladayi karne ki khwahish na thi. Pas Banu Hashim ko qatl na karna. Abu al-Bakhtari bin Hisham ko bhi qatl na kiya jaye. Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib ko bhi qatl na kiya jaye. Isay bhi ba-dil-e-nakhwasta in logon ne apne saath khincha hai. Is par Abu Huzaifa bin Utbah ne kaha ke kya hum apne baap dadon ko, apne bacchon ko, apne bhaiyon ko aur apne qabile ko qatl karein aur Abbas ko chhod dein? Wallah! Agar woh mujhe mil gaya to mein us ki gardan maroon ga. Jab yeh baat Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko pahunchi to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Ae Abu Hafsa! Kya Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke chacha ke munh par talwar mari jaye gi?" Hazrat Umar Farooq (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain yeh pehla mauqa tha ke Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne meri kuniyat se mujhe yaad farmaya. Hazrat Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne farmaya, "Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Mujhe ijazat dijiye ke mein Abu Huzaifa ki gardan uda doon, Wallah woh to munafiq ho gaya." Hazrat Abu Huzaifa (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain, "Wallah! Mujhe apne is din ke qaul ka khatka aaj tak hai, mein is se abhi tak darr hi raha hoon. To mein us din chain paoon ga jis din is ka kaffara ho jaye aur woh yeh hai ke mein rah-e-haqq mein shaheed kar diya jaoon." Chunanche Jang-e-Yamama mein aap shaheed huye (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) wa Riza. Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) kehte hain jis din Badri qaidi giraftar ho kar aaye, Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko us raat neend na aayi. Sahaba ne sabab poocha to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Mere chacha ki aah-o-buka ki awaz mere kanon mein in qaidiyon mein se aa rahi hai." Sahaba ne us waqt un ki qaid khol di tab Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko neend aayi. Unhein ek Ansari Sahabi ne giraftar kiya tha. Yeh bahut maldar thay, unhon ne sau auqiya sona apne fidiye mein diya. Baaz Ansariyon ne Sarkar-e-Nabuwwat mein guzarish bhi ki ke hum chahte hain apne bhanjay Abbas ko baghair koi zar-e-fidya liye azad kar dein, lekin musawat ke alam-bardar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Ek chuanni bhi kam na lena, poora fidya lo." Quraish ne fidiye ki raqmein de kar apne aadmiyon ko bheja tha, har ek ne apne apne qaidi ki man-mani raqam wasool ki. Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne kaha bhi ke, "Ae Allah ke Rasul (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Mein to Musalman hi tha." Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Mujhe tumhare Islam ka ilm hai, agar yeh tumhara qaul sahih hai to Allah tumhein iska badla de ga, lekin chunke ahkaam zahir par hain is liye aap apna fidya ada kijiye, balke apne donon bhatijon ka bhi." Naufal bin Haris bin Abdul Muttalib ka aur Aqeel bin Abi Talib bin Abdul Muttalib ka aur apne haleef Utbah bin Amr ka jo Banu Haris bin Fihr ke qabile se hai. Unhon ne kaha ke, "Ya Rasulullah! Mere paas to itna maal nahin." Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Woh maal kahan gaya jo tum ne aur Umm-ul-Fazl ne zameen mein dafnaya hai aur tum ne kaha hai ke agar apne is safar mein kamyab raha to yeh maal Banu al-Fazl aur Abdullah aur Qusham ka hai?" Ab to Hazrat Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki zaban se be-sakhta nikal gaya ke, "Wallah! Mere ilm hai ke Aap Allah Ta'ala ke sacche Rasul (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain, is maal ko bajuz mere aur Umm-ul-Fazl ke koi nahin jaanta."

Achhaiyon kijiye ke mere paas se bees oqiya sona Aap ke lashkariyon ko mila hai isi ko mera zar-e-fidya samajh liya jaye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hargiz nahin woh maal to hamein Allah ne apne fazl se dilwa hi diya. Chunanche ab aap ne apna aur apne donon bhatijon ka aur apne haleef ka fidya apne paas se ada kiya aur is bare mein Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari ke agar tum mein bhalai hai to Allah is se behtar badla dega. Hazrat Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ka bayan hai ke Allah ka yeh farman poora utra aur in bees oqiya ke badle mujhe Islam mein Allah ne bees ghulam dilwaye jo sab ke sab maaldar thay saath hi mujhe Allah Azzawajal ki maghfirat ki bhi umeed hai. Aap farmate hain mere bare mein yeh ayat nazil hui hai mein ne apne Islam ki khabar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko di aur kaha ke mere bees oqiya ka badla mujhe dilwaye jo mujh se liye gaye hain. Aap ne inkar kiya Alhamdulillah ke Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne aur aap ke sathiyon ne Huzoor se kaha tha ke hum to Aap ki wahi par iman la chuke hain Aap ki risalat ke gawah hain hum apni qaum mein Aap ki khair khwahi karte rahe is par yeh ayat utri ke Allah dilon ke haal se waqif hai jis ke dil mein naiki hogi us se jo liya gaya hai us se bahut zyada de diya jaye ga aur phir agla shirk bhi maaf kar diya jaye ga. Farmate hain ke sari duniya mil jaane se bhi zyada khushi mujhe is ayat ke nazil hone se hui hai mujh se jo liya gaya Wallah us se sau hisse zyada mujhe mila. Aur mujhe umeed hai ke mere gunah bhi dhul gaye. Mazkoor hai ke jab Bahrain ka khazana Sarkar-e-Risalat Ma'ab (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein pahuncha woh assi hazar ka tha Aap namaz-e-zohar ke liye wuzu kar chuke thay pas Aap ne har ek shikayat karne wale ki aur har ek sawal karne wale ki daad rasi aur namaz se pehle hi sara khazana rah-e-Allah luta diya. Hazrat Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko hukm diya ke le is mein se le aur gathri baandh kar le jao pas yeh un ke liye bahut behtar tha. Aur Allah Ta'ala gunah bhi maaf farmaye ga. Yeh khazana Ibn al-Hazrami ne bheja tha itna maal Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas is se pehle ya is ke baad kabhi nahin aaya. Sab ka sab boriyon par phaila diya gaya aur namaz ki azan hui. Aap tashreef laye aur maal ke paas khare ho gaye masjid ke namazi bhi aa gaye phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne har ek ko dena shuru kiya na to us din naap tol thi na ginti aur shumar tha, pas jo aaya woh le gaya aur dil khol kar le gaya. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne to apni chadar mein gathri baandh li lekin utha na sake to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se arz ki Ya RasoolAllah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) zara ooncha kar dijiye Aap ko besakhta hansi aa gayi itni ke daant chamakne lage. Farmaya kuch kam kar do jitna uthe itna hi lo. Chunanche kuch kam liya aur utha kar yeh kehte hue chale ke Alhamdulillah Allah Ta'ala ne ek baat to poori hoti dikha di aur doosra wa'da bhi Insha'Allah poora ho kar hi rahe ga. Is se behtar hai jo hum se liya gaya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) barabar is maal ko taqseem farmate rahe yahan tak ke is mein se ek pai bhi na bachi Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne ahl ko is mein se ek phooti kauri bhi nahin di.

Phir namaz ke liye aage badhe aur namaz padhayi doosri hadith. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas Bahrain se maal aaya itna ke is se pehle ya is ke baad itna maal kabhi nahin aaya. Hukm diya ke masjid mein phaila do phir namaz ke liye aaye kisi ki taraf se iltifat na kiya namaz padha kar baith gaye phir to jisay dekhte dete itne mein Hazrat Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) aa gaye aur kehne lage Ya Rasulullah mujhe dilwaiye maine apna aur Aqeel ka fidya diya hai Aap ne farmaya apne hath se le lo. Unhon ne chadar mein gathri bandhi lekin wazni hone ke baais utha na sake to kaha Ya Rasulullah kisi ko hukm dijiye ke mere kandhe par chadha de Aap ne farmaya mein to kisi se nahin kehta, kaha accha Aap hi zara uthwa dijiye Aap ne is ka bhi inkar kiya ab to ba-dil-e-nakhwasta is mein kuch kam karna pada phir utha kar kandhe par rakh kar chal diye. Un ke is lalach ki wajah se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nigahein jab tak yeh Aap ki nigah se ojhal na ho gaye unhi par rahein pas jab kul maal bant chuke ek kodi bhi baqi na bachi tab Aap wahan se uthe Imam Bukhari Sharif mein ta'liqan jazm ke seeghe ke sath warid ki hai. Agar yeh log khiyanat karna chahenge to yeh koi nayi baat nahin is se pehle woh khud Allah ki khiyanat bhi kar chuke hain. To un se yeh bhi mumkin hai ke ab jo zahir karein is ke khilaf apne dil mein rakhein. Is se to na ghabra jaise Allah Ta'ala ne is waqt unhein tere qabu mein kar diya hai. Aise hi woh hamesha qadir hai. Allah ka koi kaam ilm-o-hikmat se khali nahin. Un ke aur tamam makhlooq ke sath jo kuch woh karta hai apne azli abdi poore ilm aur kamil hikmat ke sath Hazrat Qatadah kehte hain yeh ayat Abdullah bin Sa'd bin Abi Sarh katib ke baare mein utri hai jo murtad ho kar mushrikon mein ja mila tha. Ata Khurasani ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Abbas aur un ke sathiyon ke baare mein utri hai jabke unhon ne kaha tha ke hum Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khair-khwahi karte rahenge. Suddi ne isay aam aur sab ko shamil kahi yehi theek bhi hai Wallahu A'lam.
