Isay bhi ba-dil-e-nakhwasta in logon ne apne saath khincha hai. Is par Abu Huzaifa bin Utbah ne kaha ke kya hum apne baap dadon ko, apne bacchon ko, apne bhaiyon ko aur apne qabile ko qatl karein aur Abbas ko chhod dein? Wallah! Agar woh mujhe mil gaya to mein us ki gardan maroon ga. Jab yeh baat Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko pahunchi to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Ae Abu Hafsa! Kya Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke chacha ke munh par talwar mari jaye gi?" Hazrat Umar Farooq (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain yeh pehla mauqa tha ke Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne meri kuniyat se mujhe yaad farmaya. Hazrat Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne farmaya, "Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Mujhe ijazat dijiye ke mein Abu Huzaifa ki gardan uda doon, Wallah woh to munafiq ho gaya." Hazrat Abu Huzaifa (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain, "Wallah! Mujhe apne is din ke qaul ka khatka aaj tak hai, mein is se abhi tak darr hi raha hoon. To mein us din chain paoon ga jis din is ka kaffara ho jaye aur woh yeh hai ke mein rah-e-haqq mein shaheed kar diya jaoon." Chunanche Jang-e-Yamama mein aap shaheed huye (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) wa Riza. Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) kehte hain jis din Badri qaidi giraftar ho kar aaye, Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko us raat neend na aayi. Sahaba ne sabab poocha to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Mere chacha ki aah-o-buka ki awaz mere kanon mein in qaidiyon mein se aa rahi hai." Sahaba ne us waqt un ki qaid khol di tab Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko neend aayi. Unhein ek Ansari Sahabi ne giraftar kiya tha. Yeh bahut maldar thay, unhon ne sau auqiya sona apne fidiye mein diya. Baaz Ansariyon ne Sarkar-e-Nabuwwat mein guzarish bhi ki ke hum chahte hain apne bhanjay Abbas ko baghair koi zar-e-fidya liye azad kar dein, lekin musawat ke alam-bardar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Ek chuanni bhi kam na lena, poora fidya lo." Quraish ne fidiye ki raqmein de kar apne aadmiyon ko bheja tha, har ek ne apne apne qaidi ki man-mani raqam wasool ki. Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne kaha bhi ke, "Ae Allah ke Rasul (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Mein to Musalman hi tha." Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Mujhe tumhare Islam ka ilm hai, agar yeh tumhara qaul sahih hai to Allah tumhein iska badla de ga, lekin chunke ahkaam zahir par hain is liye aap apna fidya ada kijiye, balke apne donon bhatijon ka bhi." Naufal bin Haris bin Abdul Muttalib ka aur Aqeel bin Abi Talib bin Abdul Muttalib ka aur apne haleef Utbah bin Amr ka jo Banu Haris bin Fihr ke qabile se hai. Unhon ne kaha ke, "Ya Rasulullah! Mere paas to itna maal nahin." Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Woh maal kahan gaya jo tum ne aur Umm-ul-Fazl ne zameen mein dafnaya hai aur tum ne kaha hai ke agar apne is safar mein kamyab raha to yeh maal Banu al-Fazl aur Abdullah aur Qusham ka hai?" Ab to Hazrat Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki zaban se be-sakhta nikal gaya ke, "Wallah! Mere ilm hai ke Aap Allah Ta'ala ke sacche Rasul (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain, is maal ko bajuz mere aur Umm-ul-Fazl ke koi nahin jaanta."

Achhaiyon kijiye ke mere paas se bees oqiya sona Aap ke lashkariyon ko mila hai isi ko mera zar-e-fidya samajh liya jaye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hargiz nahin woh maal to hamein Allah ne apne fazl se dilwa hi diya. Chunanche ab aap ne apna aur apne donon bhatijon ka aur apne haleef ka fidya apne paas se ada kiya aur is bare mein Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari ke agar tum mein bhalai hai to Allah is se behtar badla dega. Hazrat Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ka bayan hai ke Allah ka yeh farman poora utra aur in bees oqiya ke badle mujhe Islam mein Allah ne bees ghulam dilwaye jo sab ke sab maaldar thay saath hi mujhe Allah Azzawajal ki maghfirat ki bhi umeed hai. Aap farmate hain mere bare mein yeh ayat nazil hui hai mein ne apne Islam ki khabar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko di aur kaha ke mere bees oqiya ka badla mujhe dilwaye jo mujh se liye gaye hain. Aap ne inkar kiya Alhamdulillah ke Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne aur aap ke sathiyon ne Huzoor se kaha tha ke hum to Aap ki wahi par iman la chuke hain Aap ki risalat ke gawah hain hum apni qaum mein Aap ki khair khwahi karte rahe is par yeh ayat utri ke Allah dilon ke haal se waqif hai jis ke dil mein naiki hogi us se jo liya gaya hai us se bahut zyada de diya jaye ga aur phir agla shirk bhi maaf kar diya jaye ga. Farmate hain ke sari duniya mil jaane se bhi zyada khushi mujhe is ayat ke nazil hone se hui hai mujh se jo liya gaya Wallah us se sau hisse zyada mujhe mila. Aur mujhe umeed hai ke mere gunah bhi dhul gaye. Mazkoor hai ke jab Bahrain ka khazana Sarkar-e-Risalat Ma'ab (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein pahuncha woh assi hazar ka tha Aap namaz-e-zohar ke liye wuzu kar chuke thay pas Aap ne har ek shikayat karne wale ki aur har ek sawal karne wale ki daad rasi aur namaz se pehle hi sara khazana rah-e-Allah luta diya. Hazrat Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko hukm diya ke le is mein se le aur gathri baandh kar le jao pas yeh un ke liye bahut behtar tha. Aur Allah Ta'ala gunah bhi maaf farmaye ga. Yeh khazana Ibn al-Hazrami ne bheja tha itna maal Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas is se pehle ya is ke baad kabhi nahin aaya. Sab ka sab boriyon par phaila diya gaya aur namaz ki azan hui. Aap tashreef laye aur maal ke paas khare ho gaye masjid ke namazi bhi aa gaye phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne har ek ko dena shuru kiya na to us din naap tol thi na ginti aur shumar tha, pas jo aaya woh le gaya aur dil khol kar le gaya. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne to apni chadar mein gathri baandh li lekin utha na sake to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se arz ki Ya RasoolAllah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) zara ooncha kar dijiye Aap ko besakhta hansi aa gayi itni ke daant chamakne lage. Farmaya kuch kam kar do jitna uthe itna hi lo. Chunanche kuch kam liya aur utha kar yeh kehte hue chale ke Alhamdulillah Allah Ta'ala ne ek baat to poori hoti dikha di aur doosra wa'da bhi Insha'Allah poora ho kar hi rahe ga. Is se behtar hai jo hum se liya gaya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) barabar is maal ko taqseem farmate rahe yahan tak ke is mein se ek pai bhi na bachi Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne ahl ko is mein se ek phooti kauri bhi nahin di.

Phir namaz ke liye aage badhe aur namaz padhayi doosri hadith. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas Bahrain se maal aaya itna ke is se pehle ya is ke baad itna maal kabhi nahin aaya. Hukm diya ke masjid mein phaila do phir namaz ke liye aaye kisi ki taraf se iltifat na kiya namaz padha kar baith gaye phir to jisay dekhte dete itne mein Hazrat Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) aa gaye aur kehne lage Ya Rasulullah mujhe dilwaiye maine apna aur Aqeel ka fidya diya hai Aap ne farmaya apne hath se le lo. Unhon ne chadar mein gathri bandhi lekin wazni hone ke baais utha na sake to kaha Ya Rasulullah kisi ko hukm dijiye ke mere kandhe par chadha de Aap ne farmaya mein to kisi se nahin kehta, kaha accha Aap hi zara uthwa dijiye Aap ne is ka bhi inkar kiya ab to ba-dil-e-nakhwasta is mein kuch kam karna pada phir utha kar kandhe par rakh kar chal diye. Un ke is lalach ki wajah se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nigahein jab tak yeh Aap ki nigah se ojhal na ho gaye unhi par rahein pas jab kul maal bant chuke ek kodi bhi baqi na bachi tab Aap wahan se uthe Imam Bukhari Sharif mein ta'liqan jazm ke seeghe ke sath warid ki hai. Agar yeh log khiyanat karna chahenge to yeh koi nayi baat nahin is se pehle woh khud Allah ki khiyanat bhi kar chuke hain. To un se yeh bhi mumkin hai ke ab jo zahir karein is ke khilaf apne dil mein rakhein. Is se to na ghabra jaise Allah Ta'ala ne is waqt unhein tere qabu mein kar diya hai. Aise hi woh hamesha qadir hai. Allah ka koi kaam ilm-o-hikmat se khali nahin. Un ke aur tamam makhlooq ke sath jo kuch woh karta hai apne azli abdi poore ilm aur kamil hikmat ke sath Hazrat Qatadah kehte hain yeh ayat Abdullah bin Sa'd bin Abi Sarh katib ke baare mein utri hai jo murtad ho kar mushrikon mein ja mila tha. Ata Khurasani ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Abbas aur un ke sathiyon ke baare mein utri hai jabke unhon ne kaha tha ke hum Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khair-khwahi karte rahenge. Suddi ne isay aam aur sab ko shamil kahi yehi theek bhi hai Wallahu A'lam.

Mujahideen-e-Badr ki shaan, Musalmanon ki qismein bayan ho rahi hain ek toh Muhajir jinhon ne Allah ke naam par watan tark kiya apne ghar baar, maal, tijarat, kunba, qabila, dost ahbab chhode, Allah ke deen par qaim rehne ke liye na jaan ko jaan samjha na maal ko maal. Dusre Ansar, Madni jinhon ne in Muhajiron ko apne haan thehraya apne maalon mein un ka hissa laga diya un ke saath mil kar un ke dushmanon se ladayi ki yeh sab aapas mein ek hi hain. Isi liye Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un mein bhai chara kara diya ek Ansari ek Muhajir ko bhai bhai bana diya. Yeh bhai bandi qarabati dari se bhi muqaddam thi ek dusre ka waris banta tha aakhir mein yeh mansookh ho gayi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Muhajireen aur Ansar sab aapas mein ek dusre ke wali waris hain aur Fatah-e-Makkah ke baad ke azad karda Musalman log Quraishi aur azad shuda Thaqeef aapas mein ek dusre ke wali hain Qayamat tak. Aur riwayat mein hai dunya aur aakhirat mein Muhajir-o-Ansar ki tareef mein aur bhi bahut si aayatein hain farman hai. (Was-saabiqoonal awwaluna minal Muhajireena wal Ansaari wallazeena-ttaba'oohum bi-ihsaanin-raziyallahu 'anhum wa razu 'anhu wa a'adda lahum jannaatin tajree tahtahal anhaaru khaalideena feeha abada, zaalikal fawzul 'azeem) (Surah At-Tawbah: 100). Pehle pehal sabqat karne wale Muhajireen-o-Ansar aur un ke ihsan ke tabedar woh hain jin se Allah khush hai aur woh us se khush hain us ne un ke liye jannatein tayyar kar rakhi hain jin ke darakhton ke neeche chashme beh rahe hain. Aur aayat mein hai (Laqad taaballahu 'alan-Nabiyyi wal Muhajireena wal Ansaaril-lazeena-ttaba'oohu fee saa'atil 'usrah) (Surah At-Tawbah: 117). Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par aur in Muhajireen-o-Ansar par Allah Ta'ala ne apni rahmat ki tawajjo farmayi jinhon ne sakhti ke waqt bhi Aap ki ittiba na chhodi. Aur aayat mein hai (Lil fuqaraa'il Muhajireenal lazeena ukhriju min diyaarihim wa amwaalihim yabtaghoona fazlam-minallahi wa rizwana-wa yansuroonallaha wa Rasoolahu, ulaa'ika humus-saadiqoon) (Surah Al-Hashr: 8). In Muhajir muhtajon ke liye jo apne maalon se aur apne shehron se nikaal diye gaye jo Allah ke fazl aur us ki razamandi ki justuju mein hain jo Allah ki aur Rasul ki madad mein lage hue hain yahi sacche log hain. Aur jinhon ne un ko jagah di un se mohabbat rakhi unhein kushada dili ke saath diya balke apni zaroorat par un ki haajat ko muqaddam rakha. Yani jo hijrat ki فضیلت Allah ne Muhajireen ko di hai un par woh un ka hasad nahin karte. In aayaton se maloom hota hai ke Muhajir Ansar par muqaddam hain. Ulama ka is mein ittefaq hai. Musnad-e-Bazzar mein hai Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Huzaifa (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko hijrat aur nusrat mein ikhtiyar diya toh Aap ne hijrat ko pasand farmaya. Phir farmate hain hai jo iman laye lekin unhon ne tark-e-watan nahin kiya tha unhein un ki rafaqat hasil nahin.

Yeh momino ki teesri qism hai jo apni jagah thehre huay thay unka maal-e-ghaneemat mein koi hissa na tha na khums mein haan kisi ladayi mein shirkat karein to aur baat hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab kisi ko kisi fauji dasta ka sipah salar bana kar bhejte to usay nasihat farmate ke dekho apne dil mein Allah ka darr rakhna, Musalmano ke saath hamesha khair-khwahana bartao karna. Jao Allah ka naam le kar Allah ki raah mein jihad karo, Allah ke saath kufr karne walon se lado, apne dushman mushriko ke samne teen baatein pesh karo, un mein se jo bhi woh manzoor karlein unhein ikhtiyar hai. Un se kaho ke Islam qabool karein, agar maan lein to phir un se ruk jao aur un mein se jo is par qaim ho jayenge aur jo Muhajiro par hai un par bhi hoga. Warna yeh dehat ke aur Musalmano ki tarah honge iman ke ahkam un par jari rahein ge. Fay aur ghaneemat ke maal mein unka koi hissa na hoga haan yeh aur baat hai ke woh kisi fauj mein shirkat karein aur koi ma'arka sar karein. Yeh na manein to unhein kaho ke jizya dein agar yeh qabool karlein to tum ladayi se ruk jao aur un se jizya le liya karo. Agar in dono baaton ka inkar karein to Allah ki madad ke bharose par Allah se nusrat talab kar ke un se jihad karo. Jo dehati Musalman wahin muqeem hain hijrat nahin ki yeh agar kisi waqt tum se madad ki khwahish karein, dushmanan-e-deen ke muqable mein tumhein bulayein to un ki madad tum par wajib hai lekin agar muqable par koi aisa qabila ho ke tum mein aur un mein sulah ka mu'ahida hai to khabardar tum ahd-shikni na karna. Qasmein na todna.

Do mukhtalif mazahib wale aapas mein dost nahin ho sakte. Oopar momino ke karname aur rafaqat-o-wilayat ka zikr hua ab yahan kafiro ki nisbat bhi bayan farma kar kafiro aur momino mein se dostana kaat diya. Mustadrak Hakim mein hai Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain woh mukhtalif mazhab wale aapas mein ek doosre ke waris nahin ho sakte na Musalman kafir ka waris aur na kafir Musalman ka waris phir Aap ne isi ayat ki tilawat farmai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai Musalman kafir ka aur kafir Musalman ka waris nahin ban sakta. Sunan waghera mein hai do mukhtalif mazhab wale aapas mein ek doosre ke waris nahin. Isay Imam Tirmidhi (Rahimahullah / R.H) hasan kehte hain. Ibn Jarir mein hai ke ek naye Musalman se Aap ne ahad liya ke namaz qaim rakhna, zakat dena, Baitullah Sharif ka hajj karna, Ramazan-ul-Mubarak ke roze rakhna aur jab aur jahan shirk ki aag bharak utthe to apne aap ko un ka muqabil aur un se barsar-e-jang samajhna. Yeh riwayat mursal hai aur mufassal riwayat mein hai Aap farmate hain mein har us Musalman se bari-uz-zimma hoon jo mushrikeen mein thehra rahe. Kya woh dono jagah lagi hui aag nahin dekhta? Abu Dawood mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo mushriko se khila mila rakkhe aur un mein thehra rahe woh unhi jaisa hai. Ibn Marduwayh mein hai Allah ke Rasul, rasulo ke sartaj Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jab tumhare paas woh aaye jis ke deen aur akhlaq se tum razamand ho to us ke nikah mein de do agar tum ne aisa na kiya to mulk mein zabardast fitna fasad barpa hoga. Logo ne daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) chahe woh unhi mein rehta ho Aap ne phir farmaya jab tumhare paas kisi aise shakhs ki taraf se paigham-e-nikah aaye jis ke deen aur akhlaq se tum khush ho to us ka nikah kar do teen baar yehi farmaya. Ayat ke in alfaz ka matlab yeh hai ke agar tum ne mushriko se alaihgi ikhtiyar na ki aur imandaro se dostiyan na rakhein to ek fitna barpa ho jayega. Yeh ikhtilat bure nateejay dikhaye ga logo mein zabardast fasad barpa ho jayega.

Muhajir aur Ansar mein wahdat, momino ka dunyawi hukm zikr farma kar ab akhirat ka haal bayan farma raha hai, unke iman ki sachayi zahir kar raha hai jaise ke surat ke shuru mein bayan hua hai, unhein bakhshish milegi, unke gunah maaf honge, unhein izzat ki paak rozi milegi jo barkat wali, hamesha-gi wali, tayyib-o-tahir hogi, qism qism ki lazeez, umdah aur na khatm hone wali hogi. Unki ittiba karne wale iman-o-amal-e-salih mein unka saath dene wale akhirat mein bhi darjon mein unke saath hi honge. (Was-saabiqoonal awwaloon minal Muhajireena wal Ansaari wallazeena-ttaba'oohum bi-ihsaanin-raziyallahu 'anhum wa razu 'anhu wa a'adda lahum jannaatin tajree tahtahal anhaaru khaalideena feeha abada, zaalikal fawzul 'azeem) (9. At-Taubah: 100) aur (Wallazeena ja'oo mim ba'dihim yaqooloona Rabbanagh-fir lana wa li-ikhwaninal lazeena sabaqoona bil-imani wa la taj'al fee quloobina ghillal-lillazeena amanoo Rabbana innaka Ra'oofur-Raheem) (59. Al-Hashr: 10) mein hai. Muttafaqun Alaih balki mutawatir hadith mein hai ke insan uske saath hoga jis se muhabbat rakhta hai. Dusri hadith mein hai jo kisi qaum se muhabbat rakhe woh un mein se hi hai. Ek riwayat mein hai uska hashr bhi unhi ke saath hoga. Musnad Ahmad ki hadith guzar chuki hai ke Muhajir-o-Ansar aapas mein ek dusre ke wali hain, Fath-e-Makkah ke baad Musalman Quraishi aur Saqeef ke azad shuda aapas mein ek hain, Qayamat tak yeh sab aapas mein wali hain. Phir Ulul Arham ka bayan hua, yahan unse murad wahi qarabat-dar nahin jo ulama-e-fara'iz ke nazdeek is naam se yaad kiye jaate hain yaani jinka koi hissa muqarrar na ho aur jo asbah bhi hon jaise khala, mamu, phuphi, nawasiyan, bhanje, bhanjiyan waghairah. Baaz ka yehi khayal hai, ayat se hujjat pakadte hain aur ise is baare mein sarahat wali batate hain. Yeh nahin balki haq yeh hai ke yeh ayat aam hai, tamam qarabat-daron ko shamil hai jaise ke Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A), Mujahid (Rahimahullah / R.H), Ikrimah (R.H), Hasan (R.H), Qatadah (R.H) waghairah kehte hain ke yeh nasikh hai aapas ki qasmon par waris banne ki aur bhai-chare par waris banne ki jo pehle dastoor tha, pas yeh ulama-e-fara'iz ke Zawil Arham ko shamil hogi khaas naam ke saath. Aur jo unhein waris nahin banate unke paas kai daleelein hain, sab se qawi yeh hadith hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne har haq-dar ko uska haq dilwa diya hai, pas kisi waris ke liye koi wasiyat nahin. Woh kehte hain ke agar yeh bhi haq-dar hote to unke bhi hisse muqarrar ho jaate, jab yeh nahin to woh bhi nahin, Wallahu A'lam.

Al-Hashr: 10) mein hai. Muttafaqun Alaih balki mutawatir hadith mein hai ke insan uske saath hoga jis se muhabbat rakhta hai. Dusri hadith mein hai jo kisi qaum se muhabbat rakhe woh un mein se hi hai. Ek riwayat mein hai uska hashr bhi unhi ke saath hoga. Phir Ulul Arham ka bayan hua, yahan unse murad wahi qarabat-dar nahin jo ulama-e-fara'iz ke nazdeek is naam se yaad kiye jaate hain yaani jinka koi hissa muqarrar na ho aur jo asbah bhi hon jaise khala, mamu, phuphi, nawasiyan, bhanje, bhanjiyan waghairah. Baaz ka yehi khayal hai, ayat se hujjat pakadte hain aur ise is baare mein sarahat wali batate hain. Yeh nahin balki haq yeh hai ke yeh ayat aam hai, tamam qarabat-daron ko shamil hai jaise ke Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A), Mujahid (Rahimahullah / R.H), Ikrimah (R.H), Hasan (R.H), Qatadah (R.H) waghairah kehte hain ke yeh nasikh hai aapas ki qasmon par waris banne ki aur bhai-chare par waris banne ki jo pehle dastoor tha, pas yeh ulama-e-fara'iz ke Zawil Arham ko shamil hogi khaas naam ke saath. Aur jo unhein waris nahin banate unke paas kai daleelein hain, sab se qawi yeh hadith hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne har haq-dar ko uska haq dilwa diya hai, pas kisi waris ke liye koi wasiyat nahin. Woh kehte hain ke agar yeh bhi haq-dar hote to unke bhi hisse muqarrar ho jaate, jab yeh nahin to woh bhi nahin, Wallahu A'lam.
